entries.title: A Certain Dark Item Release Date & Where to Watch
entries.description: A Certain Dark Item premieres October 9, 2026 and streams on Crunchyroll. See the release date, where to watch, studio and confirmed details.
entries.content: OCTOBER 9, 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE A Certain Dark Item Release Date & Where to Watch A Certain Dark Item begins its Japanese television run on October 9, 2026. Here are the confirmed broadcast details, streaming guidance, story and official trailer. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official A Certain Dark Item key visual. © Kamachi/KADOKAWA/PROJECT-ITEM. Source: official anime website . RELEASE October 9, 2026 STREAMING Crunchyroll STUDIO J.C.STAFF Release at a glance Japanese premiere: October 9, 2026. Japanese TV schedule: AT-X lists Friday at 10:30 p.m. JST; Tokyo MX and BS11 list 24:30, which means 12:30 a.m. on October 10. International streaming: Crunchyroll includes the series in its Fall 2026 lineup and lists a Friday 8:30 a.m. PT subtitled airtime. Check your local catalog for availability. Animation studio: J.C.STAFF. A Certain Dark Item is now airing in Japan. The series began on October 9, 2026. Its late-night schedule can be confusing because Japanese listings sometimes use a 24-hour clock that runs past midnight: 24:30 on October 9 is 12:30 a.m. on October 10. The official schedule lists the Japanese stations and services; Crunchyroll's Fall 2026 lineup is the source for its international subtitled airtime. Where can you watch A Certain Dark Item? Crunchyroll lists the show as part of its Fall 2026 season. The listed Friday 8:30 a.m. Pacific subtitled slot is a useful guide for viewers whose region receives the simulcast, but streaming catalogs and release timing can differ between countries. Search the title in the Crunchyroll app or website while signed in from your location before planning around that time. In Japan, the official anime site lists AT-X, Tokyo MX and BS11 for television. It also lists ABEMA and ABEMA Premium around the premiere, followed by additional subscription services from October 16, including d Anime Store, DMM TV, Hulu, U-NEXT and Prime Video. Those Japanese service listings do not establish availability in other countries. A platform's brand name can appear in more than one market with a different catalogue, so the local service page is the best check. What is the story about? The anime follows ITEM, a covert team operating in Academy City's criminal underworld. Its established members are Shizuri Mugino, Rikou Takitsubo, Frenda Seivelun and Saiai Kinuhata. An official introduction brings in Hanano Choubi, a new girl connected to the group as its fifth member. The premise shifts attention from the schools and public heroics often associated with the wider A Certain setting to the dangerous assignments carried out in its shadows. Related reading: BLEACH × Graniph: 17-Item Collection Launches in Japan on October 20 . The official first-episode synopsis gives readers a concrete starting point: ITEM is sent to investigate a company conducting ability-development research under the cover of medical treatment. That setup explains the team's role without giving away later turns. The story's central question is not simply whether ITEM can complete a job; the series also puts pressure on how a team stays together when its members work in a system that treats people as tools. How does this fit into the A Certain franchise? A Certain Dark Item is based on the ITEM-focused light novels by Kazuma Kamachi, with illustrations by Nilitsu, and belongs to the broader A Certain franchise. Its focus on Mugino and her team offers a different entry point from stories centered on Academy City's students. Viewers who already know the setting may recognize the city's split between its polished public image and its hidden operations. The anime's own official story and character pages introduce the people and conflict it needs; they do not publish a required watch order for the wider franchise. Cast, staff and music J.C.STAFF is producing the television anime. Tatsuyuki Nagai directs, Shogo Yasukawa handles series composition, and Shigeki Kimoto designs the characters. The official staff and cast page lists Ami Koshimizu as Shizuri Mugino, Aya Suzaki as Rikou Takitsubo, Maaya Uchida as Frenda Seivelun, Chinatsu Akasaki as Saiai Kinuhata and Hana Hishikawa as Hanano Choubi. Related reading: DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION Release Date & Time . East Of Eden performs the opening theme, “Ghost Sequence,” and Kishida Kyoudan & The Akeboshi Rockets performs the ending theme, “Genshi Kuzushi (Meltdowner).” Official teaser and main trailer The official site has released multiple videos. The embedded March teaser introduces the project, while the July main trailer reveals the premiere date and theme songs. For new episode announcements and schedule changes, use the official news page alongside the broadcast schedule. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER A Certain Dark Item official teaser PV Watch the official teaser on YouTube . What to check before watching If you are outside Japan, use Crunchyroll's listing to confirm the show appears in your regional catalogue; the Japanese television timetable is not a worldwide streaming schedule. If you are following the broadcast in Japan, remember that the 24:30 entries fall just after midnight on the next calendar day. These distinctions answer the two practical questions readers often have after seeing the October 9 premiere date: which local service carries the show, and whether a late-night listing refers to Friday or Saturday in Japan. AniNextUp: Broadcast times and streaming catalogues may change. We use the official anime site for Japanese schedule, story, cast and staff details, and Crunchyroll for the international lineup information. entries.content: FALL 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season- Cour 2 Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season- Cour 2 began October 11, 2026. Check Japanese broadcast times, streaming regions and how to continue the episode order. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official series visual. Source: Ace of the Diamond official website . Release at a glance Japan premiere October 11, 2026; Sundays at 5:30 p.m. JST on TV Tokyo’s six-station network and 9:00 p.m. JST on AT-X Animation OLM Team Yoshioka Where to watch Netflix after the Japanese broadcast; other Japanese services follow. Crunchyroll lists the series in supported international regions. Schedule: official broadcast and streaming schedule . Why the second cour matters to the season The October return is the second broadcast block of Ace of the Diamond act II -Second Season- , not a newly numbered third season. The season began in April 2026, and the October schedule resumes the same adaptation. Viewers who stopped after the spring episodes can continue with the next episode in sequence; there is no separate reboot or new cast announcement attached to this cour transition. That distinction is useful when searching streaming services. Catalogs may keep the episodes under the existing season page and continue the episode numbering, instead of creating a new title for “Cour 2.” If a service appears not to list a new season, check the current act II -Second Season- page and its latest episode row before assuming the episodes are missing. When does Cour 2 begin? The second cour began in Japan on October 11, 2026 . TV Tokyo’s six-station network schedules it for Sundays at 5:30 p.m. JST ; AT-X lists a Sunday 9:00 p.m. JST broadcast with repeat showings. These are Japanese broadcast times. They should not be converted into a universal streaming time, because local services and time zones can differ. The official series site says Netflix receives the episodes after the Japanese broadcast, with other listed services following. Its schedule includes ABEMA, DMM TV, d Anime Store, Disney+, FOD, Hulu, J:COM STREAM, Lemino, milplus and music.jp. The platform list is Japan-specific. Crunchyroll separately lists the title for supported international regions, but territory and episode availability should be checked in each viewer’s local catalog. What the story is carrying forward The continuing season follows Eijun Sawamura and Seido High as they pursue a place at Koshien. Sawamura’s move into the ace role gives the team a different pressure point: the position is not only a personal milestone but also a responsibility that affects how the whole pitching staff and defense prepare. The series’ appeal comes from showing that work through practice, selection and games rather than treating one successful performance as a complete arrival. The October schedule therefore makes most sense as a continuation of the existing team arc. Returning viewers can track how Seido responds to its opponents and how Sawamura handles expectations around the ace number. This is a reading of the confirmed premise and character setup, not a claim about a particular game’s result. Related reading: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Cour 2 Release Date & Time . Where should returning viewers resume? Start with the remaining episodes from the April cour and then follow the October episodes in order. That keeps the match context and player relationships intact, especially for viewers who are catching up after a break. A service’s “new season” label is less reliable than its episode list when a season is split into cours, so compare the episode numbers and release dates if the catalog layout is unclear. For the latest episode timing, use the official Japanese schedule and the current listing on the streaming service available in your country. A Japanese Sunday broadcast does not guarantee a same-hour international simulcast, and the official announcement does not provide one single global time. What does the official second-cour PV confirm? The official YouTube page records the main promotional video’s upload at 1:00:20 a.m. PDT (UTC−7) on September 15, 2026 . It promotes the October 11 return and foregrounds the Seido versus Inashiro rivalry, while the official description identifies GLAY’s “NEVER SAY NEVER AGAIN” as the opening theme. That makes the PV useful for confirming the season’s immediate matchup and music. It is still a promotional preview: edited scenes do not establish a game result or reveal a complete episode-by-episode synopsis. Where does the streaming information apply? Japan’s official schedule places Netflix immediately after the television broadcast and lists other Japanese services for later availability. That lineup is specific to Japan. Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 guide lists the series for North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East and CIS, but it does not promise one simultaneous clock time across those markets. Viewers outside Japan should check the title page in their own catalog for current episode timing, language options and territory access. Official schedule and trailer The official broadcast and streaming schedule lists Japanese television times and local services. Watch the official second-cour main PV on the series channel. For other Fall 2026 releases, browse the AniNextUp calendar and streaming guide . ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER ON YOUTUBE TV Anime “Ace of the Diamond” Series Open the official second-cour PV on YouTube if the embedded player does not load. For other Fall 2026 premieres, browse the AniNextUp calendar and our streaming guide . Availability and episode timing can change by country, so the local platform listing remains the final check. Release dates and streaming availability are based on official announcements available on October 23, 2026. Regional catalogs may differ. entries.content: OCTOBER 18, 2026 · MOVIE RELEASE NEWS Aikatsu Stars! Movie: January 22, 2027 Release Date & Trailer Aikatsu Stars! ~Hoshiboshi no Progress~ will open in Japan on January 22, 2027. BN Pictures has released the main trailer and a new key visual for Yume and her friends’ next story. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional artwork · ©BNP/AIKATSU STARS 10TH PROJECT. Source: BN Pictures’ press release . Release at a glance Japan release January 22, 2027 Format New theatrical anime film Production BN Pictures International streaming No platform or date announced in the cited sources Verified October 18, 2026 · Official movie website When does the new Aikatsu Stars! movie release? Aikatsu Stars! ~Hoshiboshi no Progress~ opens in Japanese cinemas on January 22, 2027. BN Pictures announced the date at its October 17 fan meeting in Ikebukuro, alongside the main trailer and key visual. The Japanese title is アイカツスターズ！ ～星々のProgress～; “Progress of the Stars” is an English rendering of the subtitle. Watch the official main trailer The full promotional video is linked by both the film’s website and BN Pictures’ press release. It previews the main theme, “Five stars,” performed by Sena, Rie, Miki, Nanase and Kana. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Aikatsu! series · Official main trailer Watch the official trailer on YouTube → What is Hoshiboshi no Progress about? With graduation approaching, Yume and her friends receive an invitation from Elza of Neo Venus Ark to perform at Venus Jamboree, an event gathering leading idols from around the world. A mysterious passenger ship, Petit Venus Ark, arrives as the girls face decisions about their dreams and futures. Returning cast and production staff The official film website lists: Miyu Tomita as Yume Nijino Ayaka Asai as Laura Sakuraba Megumi Yamaguchi as Koharu Nanakura Natsumi Murakami as Ako Saotome Yume Miyamoto as Mahiru Kasumi Yoko Hikasa as Elza Forte BN Pictures handles production, with Teruo Sato directing, Yuko Kakihara writing the screenplay and Yukiko Aikei designing the characters. Is it a new film or an anniversary rerelease? This is the new film announced as part of the franchise’s tenth-anniversary project. BN Pictures first revealed it in July with an early-2027 window; the October announcement supplies the exact opening date. It should be distinguished from the separate anniversary screening of the original movie. International release, streaming and tickets The sources checked for this guide announce a Japanese theatrical opening. They do not name an international release date or streaming service. For Japanese screenings, use the official theater list ; the newly announced second round of advance ticket cards goes on sale October 23. Official sources BN Pictures: October 17 release-date and main-trailer announcement Official film website: story, cast, staff and trailer BN Pictures: July 3 new-film announcement Follow more confirmed anime release news and AniNextUp’s release calendar . What the film’s story adds to Aikatsu Stars! The official synopsis places Yume and her friends near graduation, when Elza of Neo Venus Ark invites them to perform at the Venus Jamboree. The event brings leading idols together, while the arrival of the passenger ship Petit Venus Ark adds a new setting to the story. The announcement frames the film around choices about dreams and the future; it does not say that the characters leave the franchise’s idol-performance focus behind. The main theme, “Five stars,” is performed by Sena, Rie, Miki, Nanase and Kana, the voices associated with the Aikatsu Stars! cast, according to the official film announcement . The trailer and official materials are the best way to identify what is newly introduced, while the synopsis provides the confirmed premise. The title’s subtitle, Hoshiboshi no Progress, is presented in Japanese as 星々のProgress; “Progress of the Stars” is an explanatory English rendering, not an announced official international title. entries.content: ROBLOX CODES Anime Mysterious Codes (October 2026): New Halloween Codes & How to Redeem The four newest Halloween and Update 0.75 codes are reported active as of October 17. Here is the redemption route, the Level 5 requirement, and what to check if Roblox rejects a code. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify updates Game artwork credited to Anime Mysterious by Pro Game Guides. GAME Anime Mysterious · Roblox Codes at a glance Latest reported codes HAPPYHALLOWEEN, IAMATOMIC, UPDATE075, HALLOWEENEVENT Requirement Join the Roblox community and reach Level 5 before redeeming. Last checked October 17, 2026; the codes have not been tested inside a live game session. If you searched for “Anime Mysterious code,” you are looking for redeem codes for the Roblox tower-defense game Anime Mysterious . The newest batch reported on October 16 is tied to the Halloween and Update 0.75 rollout. Two current code roundups list the same four strings, but describe their rewards only as “free rewards.” Because codes can be turned off without notice, treat them as reported codes and use the in-game response as the final check. New Anime Mysterious codes for October 2026 Code Reported status Rewards listed by current sources HAPPYHALLOWEEN Reported new on October 16 Free rewards; exact item counts were not published in the code lists we checked. IAMATOMIC Reported new on October 16 Free rewards; exact item counts were not published in the code lists we checked. UPDATE075 Reported new on October 16 Free rewards; exact item counts were not published in the code lists we checked. HALLOWEENEVENT Reported new on October 16 Free rewards; exact item counts were not published in the code lists we checked. Copy each code exactly as shown, including its capital letters. The current public lists agree on these four new strings; they do not provide an independently verified item-by-item reward breakdown. We have left the reward details general instead of guessing. How to redeem Anime Mysterious codes Open the official Anime Mysterious experience on Roblox . Join the official Roblox community if the game asks you to. Reach Level 5. Current guides report this as the redemption requirement. In the spawn lobby, look for the code character and interact to open the redemption box. Paste one code at a time and select Redeem. Read the game’s message to confirm whether it was accepted. Guides disagree on the code character’s name: some call the NPC Naruto, while others spell it Naruta. Follow the character and interaction prompt shown in the current lobby rather than relying on the spelling alone. Why an Anime Mysterious code may not work It expired: seasonal and milestone codes can be disabled after an update. A fresh in-game “invalid” response takes priority over an older list. Your account has not reached Level 5: level up and try again after the requirement is met. The code was already redeemed: these codes are generally described as one-use per account. The game server is out of date: leave and rejoin a current server after a major update. There is a typo or extra space: paste the exact uppercase string and remove spaces before or after it. Where new codes are announced The Anime Mysterious Discord and the official Roblox community are the best places to check after updates and player milestones. Do not install a script, browser extension, or third-party tool to redeem a code; the claim process happens inside Roblox. How we checked this list We compared the new-code lists updated October 16 by Beebom and October 17 by Pro Game Guides . Both name the same four codes. Neither source provides an exact reward breakdown for this batch, and AniNextUp could not validate them inside a live Roblox session at the time of this check. We will update this page when the game or its official channels confirm a change. Update note: Status reflects third-party reports available on October 17, 2026. Code validity can change at any time; the Roblox experience is the final test. entries.content: OCTOBER 2026 Anime News: October 2026 — Releases, Sequels & Streaming Updates A running overview of October anime releases, sequels and streaming updates tracked by AniNextUp. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases WHERE TO WATCH Multiple platforms Release at a glance Release October 2026; dates are title-specific Where to watch Crunchyroll, Netflix and other licensed regional services Region and timing Nia Liston is on HIDIVE from October 6 in supported territories; Japan’s schedule is separate. Release details checked October 12, 2026 · HIDIVE’s October 2026 anime schedule · Netflix’s October anime lineup · Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 anime lineup October marks the start of the Fall 2026 anime season, with a dense run of sequels, new adaptations and streaming premieres across Crunchyroll, Netflix, Disney+ and other services. This guide groups the month's releases by returning series, new adaptations and streaming updates. Open the linked title guides for the original announcement, local broadcast schedule and any territory-specific caveats. Big returns The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 returns October 2. Black Clover Season 2 begins October 3. Blue Box Season 2 returns October 4 on Netflix. New adaptations PSYREN arrives October 5, Reborn as a Space Mercenary brings sci-fi isekai to the seasonal lineup, and Suikoden: The Anime adapts Konami’s RPG world. Major October releases TANK CHAIR premiered October 4, while Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is set for October 11 and Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 arrives October 20 on Netflix. Related reading: Manchuria Opium Squad Anime: Release Date, Story and Latest News . New October premieres to track Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden premieres October 6 in Japan with a two-cour run from KONAMI animation. HIDIVE is streaming the series in supported international territories from October 6; availability varies by country. Streaming updates to watch Netflix has confirmed October dates for The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 , Blue Box Season 2 and My Happy Marriage Season 2 Special Episodes . Crunchyroll’s Fall lineup includes titles such as Firefly Wedding and The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 . Related reading: Naruto: Shadow Rising — Kishimoto's New Manga Announced, Official Teaser and Release Updates . October's releases: a practical way to choose what to watch Rather than treating every date as an interchangeable premiere, AniNextUp groups this month's entries by the question a viewer needs answered. Returning shows such as Blue Box Season 2 and The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 are most useful to viewers checking when an existing story continues. New adaptations such as PSYREN are better starting points for readers looking for a new series. These are editorial navigation categories, not official genre or quality rankings. Three release-date traps to avoid Japanese premiere versus local availability: an announced Japanese broadcast date does not by itself establish the same-day release of an English-subtitled episode in every country. Check the distributor and territory in each linked guide. A platform announcement versus an exact hour: a service may confirm a series without publishing the hour when it becomes available in a specific timezone. Do not convert an unspecified time into a countdown. New season versus new episode: a sequel premiere, a special episode and a theatrical release answer different viewing questions. The season calendar is a cross-check for the release type, while the individual guide gives the available detail. How to use this guide after a premiere has passed October's dates remain useful as a record of when releases were scheduled, even after the calendar day has passed. If you are catching up, open the title's guide to confirm its streaming platform and any regional limitations. If you are planning ahead, use this week's schedule or the full Fall calendar rather than interpreting an earlier premiere date as a new episode airing today. Related reading: Anime Mysterious Codes (October 2026): New Halloween Codes & How to Redeem . Editorial note: The comparisons and viewing advice in these sections are AniNextUp's own analysis of the linked release guides. They do not introduce new premiere dates or claim that a platform has confirmed information it has not published. How AniNextUp handles updates We separate confirmed premiere dates from unannounced simulcast times and territory-specific availability. When a platform, studio or official anime site publishes a change, the relevant release guide is updated rather than treating speculation as a schedule. AniNextUp: Release dates and streaming availability can vary by region. This guide will be updated when new official information is confirmed. entries.content: DECEMBER 2026 Anime Releasing in December 2026: Confirmed Dates A living guide to anime releases officially scheduled for December 2026. More titles will be added as studios and distributors confirm exact dates. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases December currently has a smaller confirmed anime calendar than October and November. AniNextUp lists only releases with an official date rather than filling the month with unconfirmed schedules. Why is the December calendar shorter? Most fall television anime begin earlier in the season, while this December list tracks only titles with an explicitly announced release day. The confirmed Apothecary Diaries film date refers to Japanese cinemas, not a worldwide streaming launch. A shorter table is more useful than adding speculative premieres or treating unannounced international dates as confirmed. Date Anime Release Dec. 11 The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure: The Late Consort's Secret Treasure Japan theatrical The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure — December 11 The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure opens in Japanese theaters on December 11, 2026 . The film tells a completely original story conceived by original author Natsu Hyuuga, with Maomao and Jinshi traveling south as a mystery involving a deceased consort and hidden treasure unfolds. The movie follows the franchise's 2026 television return. See our The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 guide for the TV schedule and streaming information. How to use this December release calendar The table shows only titles with a confirmed day in December, not every anime expected during the month. Its single current entry is a Japanese cinema premiere , so December 11 should not be interpreted as a Netflix, Crunchyroll or worldwide streaming date. The film and the television Season 3 have separate release schedules; readers looking for weekly episodes should use the linked Season 3 guide instead. Will more December 2026 anime be added? Yes. This calendar will expand when official anime sites, studios or distributors announce exact December dates. Titles without a confirmed day are intentionally excluded from the dated table until their schedules are official. Where to watch December 2026 anime The December 11 date refers to the Japanese theatrical opening of The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure. Crunchyroll has separately announced international theatrical distribution, but local cinema dates and a streaming launch are not established by the Japanese opening date. Browse the Fall 2026 anime calendar or where-to-watch hub for additional releases. What is confirmed for December, and what is not? The December 11 Japanese opening for The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure is a confirmed theatrical date. It does not establish an international cinema opening or an at-home streaming premiere on that day. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment have announced plans for international theatrical distribution, with country-specific dates to follow. The movie also has a different schedule from the television series. Viewers catching up with Maomao's story should use our Season 3 guide for television episodes and the movie guide for theatrical updates. A film release is not automatically a new weekly television episode. AniNextUp: Release dates and availability can change. This page is updated when new information is confirmed by official sources. Sekiro’s dedicated guide also explains its announced Crunchyroll regions. Those service announcements do not establish a common worldwide release hour or identical language options. For titles whose sources only establish Japanese television, the safest viewing plan is to wait for a regional distributor’s schedule. A domestic list of Japanese services should not be read as a worldwide license announcement. January anime movies: Japan and overseas dates Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO opens in Japan on January 15. Its North American announcement gives February 2027 as a separate theatrical window. Aikatsu Stars! Hoshiboshi no Progress opens in Japan on January 22; an overseas date or streaming premiere should not be inferred from that opening. How to build your Winter 2027 watchlist Start with the titles whose service is available in your country, then add January-only projects as provisional plans until their first-day schedules are published. Keep cinema releases separate from at-home viewing. Episode totals also need their own confirmation: a two-cour run describes television blocks, while Hasunosora’s seven-episode plan and Sekiro’s eight-episode version are explicit counts. Frequently asked questions Is this every anime airing in January 2027? No. It is a selection of 14 confirmed releases with existing AniNextUp guides and linked primary sources. Other series and continuing weekly episodes may also air that month. Does a Japanese premiere date mean I can stream it that day? Only if your local distributor confirms it. The television schedule, international streaming timetable, dub release and theatrical opening can all differ. Where are the trailers? Open each title’s guide for its verified official videos. This roundup does not present a compilation video as an official trailer for all 14 productions. Looking for something sooner? Browse this week’s premieres , the November 2026 guide or our release calendar . Official sources are linked next to each entry so that you can distinguish confirmed announcements from dates still to be announced. entries.description: Aoashi Season 2 began October 4, 2026. Check Japan’s schedule, Crunchyroll regions and the local release time in Santo Domingo.
entries.content: FALL 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE Aoashi Season 2: Release Date and Where to Watch Aoashi Season 2 began October 4, 2026. Check Japan’s schedule, Crunchyroll regions and the local release time in Santo Domingo. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Release at a glance Japan premiere October 4, 2026, on NHK E-Tele at 5:00 p.m. JST every Sunday Animation TMS Entertainment Where to watch Crunchyroll in listed international regions; Japanese services have separate schedules. Episode plan 24 episodes across two cours, according to the official series site. Schedule: official Aoashi Season 2 schedule . What changes for Ashito in Season 2? Season 2 begins after Aoi Ashito earns promotion to Tokyo City Esperion’s A team. That promotion changes the central challenge: he is now training alongside players with more experience and competing for a place in a stronger squad. The official first-cour visual brings together members of the youth A team, while the production describes Ashito as entering a new phase of competition. It sets up a clear question for viewers—how will he adjust his field awareness and decision-making when the standard around him rises? This is a continuation of Ashito’s development, not a reset. His instincts remain important, but football at this level asks him to connect what he sees with the movement and responsibilities of his teammates. The season’s premise points toward that learning curve without confirming match outcomes or a specific endpoint for his progress. When did Aoashi Season 2 premiere? The season premiered in Japan on October 4, 2026 . NHK E-Tele broadcasts it on Sundays at 5:00 p.m. JST . The official site lists Japanese subscription streaming on Hulu, Netflix, U-NEXT and Anime Times from 11:00 p.m. JST on Sundays. A wider group of services begins staggered Thursday releases from October 8 at 7:30 p.m. JST. These are domestic Japanese schedules, not universal times. Where can international viewers watch? Crunchyroll lists Season 2 for a set of international territories, including North America, Central and South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, India and Southeast Asia. Its Sunday simulcast listing is 2:00 a.m. Pacific Time in supported regions. Availability can vary by territory and subscription, so confirm that the show and the newest episode appear in the catalog for your account. Japanese services such as Hulu Japan or U-NEXT should not be assumed to have the same access rules as services with similar names abroad. The different Japanese release windows also explain why episode listings can look inconsistent. Some services carry the Sunday subscription stream, while other platforms begin on Thursday or offer transactional rentals. If an episode is not visible on a service, check its own schedule and region settings before treating the delay as a series-wide postponement. What should new viewers know first? The first season establishes Ashito’s move from a small local setting into Esperion’s youth system and introduces the coaches and teammates who shape his development. Season 2’s A-team promotion makes more sense after those earlier relationships and decisions. Watching Season 1 first is the clearest route for anyone who wants the competitive stakes and team dynamics to land as intended. Returning viewers can use the promotion as the simple recap point: Ashito has reached a higher level, but that achievement is the start of another adjustment rather than proof that he has mastered the role. The series remains a sports drama about learning to read the game and work within a team, so the new squad creates both opportunity and pressure. How many episodes are planned, and what does “cour” mean? The official Aoashi site describes the first cour as the first 12 episodes out of 24 planned for Season 2. A cour is a broadcast block, so that announcement helps explain why the season has separate first- and second-cour schedules. It does not mean a streaming service must create a separate season page for each block. If you are catching up, compare the episode list and dates rather than relying only on a “new season” label. The official schedule and your service’s episode page are the best places to confirm the next release. What time is the simulcast in the Dominican Republic? Crunchyroll lists the international simulcast for Sunday at 2:00 a.m. Pacific Time. For Santo Domingo, that corresponds to 5:00 a.m. while Pacific Time is on daylight time. The United States ends daylight saving time on November 1, 2026; after the Pacific clock moves back to standard time, the same 2:00 a.m. Pacific listing corresponds to 6:00 a.m. in Santo Domingo. These are time-zone conversions, not a separate Dominican release announcement. Check the episode page in your local Crunchyroll catalog in case the service changes its schedule. Official schedule and related Fall releases The official Aoashi Season 2 schedule lists Japanese broadcast and streaming times. The official ShoPro YouTube page records the main PV upload at 4:00:12 p.m. PDT (UTC−7) on September 1, 2026 . Its first-cour visual announcement confirms the October 4 NHK E-Tele start and describes the A-team setting. The official channel’s first-cour main PV offers a quick look at the new season. Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 lineup is the source for international streaming details. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER ON YOUTUBE ShoPro Anime Channel Open the official first-cour PV on YouTube if the embedded player does not load. Aoashi shares its October 4 premiere date with other series, including Blue Box Season 2 . For more confirmed dates, see the AniNextUp Fall 2026 calendar . The anime’s weekly rhythm and service availability can vary by location; consult the official or local platform listing when planning a watch schedule. Dates and times above distinguish the Japanese broadcast and platform schedule from Crunchyroll’s regional simulcast listing. entries.description: The Apothecary Diaries movie opens in Japan on December 11, 2026. Meet Luoqing and Yinshan, watch the official character PV and check international theater and streaming status.
entries.content: DECEMBER 11 · ANIME MOVIE The Apothecary Diaries Movie: Luoqing and Yinshan Character PV A new official character video introduces Luoqing and Yinshan, two figures at the center of the movie’s mystery, ahead of the December 11, 2026 Japanese theatrical opening. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official film key visual · ©2026 The Apothecary Diaries Movie Production Committee. Source: official movie website . Release at a glance Japan release December 11, 2026 · Japanese theaters; opening time not announced Format and studio Original theatrical anime film · TOHO animation STUDIO Latest video Luoqing and Yinshan character PV · official announcement dated October 14, 2026 International release International theatrical distribution announced by Crunchyroll; local dates and streaming launch still require separate confirmation Official movie website · Latest official video announcement Latest confirmed update: Luoqing and Yinshan The official portal’s October 14 character PV introduces Luoqing and Yinshan, two figures connected to the movie’s central mystery. Luoqing was a consort who died five years earlier; Yinshan served as her head attendant and now cares for Muqing in the Bi household. The accompanying announcements cast Miyuki Sawashiro as Luoqing and Ai Mikami as Yinshan. These reveals add characters and voice actors, but do not change the Japanese release date or establish a date outside Japan. The official video is a character promotional clip, not a new full-length film trailer. It follows earlier October videos introducing Maomao and Jinshi, then the Bi household and the Kaja-dan river pirates. Those announcements add context to the ensemble and the mystery, while the production’s confirmed theatrical date remains December 11. YouTube records the Luoqing and Yinshan PV as uploaded at 4:00:35 p.m. PDT (UTC−7) on October 13, 2026 ; that timestamp is October 14 in Japan. It is the video upload time, not the date the film opens. Related reading: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Schedule & Where to Watch . Official October 14 character PV announcement · Luoqing cast announcement · Yinshan cast announcement . ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL CHARACTER PV ON YOUTUBE TOHO animation Open the official Luoqing and Yinshan character PV on YouTube . This direct link works if an embedded preview is unavailable. When does The Apothecary Diaries movie release? The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure opens in Japanese theaters on December 11, 2026. The official announcement calls it a new theatrical film with an original story concept by series author Natsu Hyuuga. It is not a recap of the television episodes and is not Season 3. The film follows Maomao and Jinshi as they travel to a southern water city to return the remains of a consort who died five years earlier. A mystery involving her past, a hidden treasure and river pirates draws them into the story. The Japanese date is confirmed, but it should not be treated as a worldwide release. Crunchyroll announced international theatrical distribution; that confirms an overseas distributor, not one common date for every country. Local cinema dates and any later streaming launch require separate announcements. Who is making the film? Norio Naganuma directs, Yuko Kakihara writes the screenplay and TOHO animation STUDIO produces the animation. Aoi Yuki returns as Maomao and Takeo Otsuka as Jinshi. The recently announced supporting roles broaden the group connected to the southern province and the film’s investigation. The character videos give viewers a first look at that setting, but do not disclose the full solution to the mystery. Do you need to watch the TV anime first? No official prerequisite viewing order has been announced. The movie is presented as a new story centered on Maomao and Jinshi, so a newcomer can follow the central investigation from its own setup. Watching the television seasons first is still a useful choice if you want the character relationships, palace politics and Maomao’s investigative habits to feel familiar before the film begins. That is a viewing recommendation, not a stated admission requirement or a claim that the movie continues a specific season finale. What details are still unconfirmed? As of October 23, the official release information confirms the Japanese opening date, core staff, returning leads and the new character cast. A runtime, ticket-sale schedule, age rating, international cinema dates by country, subtitle options and a home-streaming date should not be assumed from the Japanese listing. Those details can arrive later from local distributors or theaters. If you are planning a cinema visit outside Japan, check your country’s exhibitor or distributor listing instead of converting December 11 into a worldwide date. How the movie fits beside Season 3 Season 3 and the movie are separate projects with separate release schedules. Season 3 began in October 2026, while the film is scheduled for Japanese theaters in December. The movie has its own original mystery, so its release should be tracked separately from the television cour and its weekly episodes. A theatrical date also says nothing by itself about home video or streaming. Where to find confirmed viewing information Check the official movie staff and cast page for production details and TOHO’s theatrical release lineup for the Japanese opening. Crunchyroll’s international distribution announcement is relevant for overseas cinema availability. Neither source confirms a universal streaming date. For the TV installment, see our Season 3 schedule guide . To compare other December premieres, browse the December 2026 anime calendar . Release information in this guide reflects official announcements available on October 23, 2026. The December 11 date applies to Japanese theaters. International theatrical dates and streaming availability remain region-specific and should be reported only when separately confirmed. Official sources Release date and story details: official film announcement . For current cast and staff, use the official staff and cast page ; for the latest character video, see the official PV update . entries.content: SEASON 3 · OCTOBER 2, 2026 The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Schedule & Where to Watch The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 is in its first cour: overall episode 52 aired October 23, and the official calendar lists episode 53 for October 30 at 11:40 p.m. JST. Here’s how the split-cour plan, April 2027 return and streaming schedule fit together. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official Season 3 key visual. Source: the anime’s Season 3 portal . © Natsu Hyūga, Imagica Infos / The Apothecary Diaries Production Committee. Release at a glance Season 3 premiere October 2, 2026 in Japan Next listed episode Overall episode 53 · October 30 at 11:40 p.m. JST Studio and broadcaster OLM · Nippon TV Friday Anime Night, nationwide 30-network broadcast Second cour April 2027 · exact date not announced Where to watch Japanese platforms after broadcast; Crunchyroll in supported international territories Schedule checked October 24, 2026 · Official broadcast and streaming schedule When is the next episode of The Apothecary Diaries Season 3? The official October calendar lists overall episode 53 for Friday, October 30, 2026, at 11:40 p.m. Japan Standard Time . Episode 52 aired on October 23. The series numbering continues from the first two seasons, so episode 53 is the fifth episode of Season 3, not the 53rd episode of this season. The October 30 slot is later than the regular Friday 11:00 p.m. Japanese broadcast listed for Season 3. That distinction matters if you are matching an episode page to a local clock: the Japanese television time and a streaming service’s regional release time may differ. Japan Standard Time is UTC+9; October 30 at 11:40 p.m. JST is 10:40 a.m. in the Dominican Republic and US Eastern Daylight Time. This is the Japanese broadcast conversion, not a promise of the exact time your app will publish the episode. What is the Season 3 release schedule? Season 3 is planned as a split cour . The first cour began on October 2, 2026, while the second cour is scheduled to begin in April 2027 . The official site has not announced the second cour’s exact date, number of episodes or weekly time slot yet. Related reading: The Apothecary Diaries Movie: Luoqing and Yinshan Character PV . A split cour is a planned break within the same season. The April return does not mean that a separately numbered Season 4 has been ordered, and it does not tell viewers the exact week the second block will start. The calendar marks the Season 3 premiere on October 2, then lists overall episode 50 on October 9, #51 on October 16, #52 on October 23 and #53 on October 30; the final listing carries the 11:40 p.m. time change. Check the official schedule again before relying on later dates, since the portal says broadcast times can change. Where can you watch the new episodes? In Japan, the official Season 3 page says episodes stream progressively after the television broadcast. Its streaming section lists Japanese services including ABEMA Premium, Amazon Prime Video, Disney+, Hulu, Netflix, U-NEXT and others; the list is for Japan and should not be read as a global licensing announcement. Related reading: Black Clover Season 2 Schedule & Where to Watch . For international viewers, Crunchyroll’s official Season 3 guide lists the series in supported territories and announced the first episode for October 2 at 8:00 a.m. Pacific Time. The service’s individual episode listing showed episode 52 on October 23. Catalog rights, language options and release clocks can differ by country, so search the app while signed into your own region. Do not assume that the 11:40 p.m. JST broadcast slot is the local Crunchyroll release time. What is the story about this season? The new season carries Maomao and Jinshi’s story beyond the rear palace, widening the setting to the common world and a neighboring country. Official material teases signs of a disaster, a mysterious shrine maiden and new responsibilities placed on Jinshi. Those are the season’s announced story hooks; the production has not published a complete episode-by-episode adaptation outline. Related reading: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode Schedule & Where to Watch . For new viewers, the court mysteries build on relationships and discoveries from the earlier seasons. Watching Seasons 1 and 2 first makes the political stakes and Maomao’s changing relationship with Jinshi easier to follow. Season 3 is a continuation, not a reset or a standalone entry. What do the trailer and theme songs confirm? The official main trailer is on the verified TOHO animation channel. It introduces the season’s atmosphere and features the opening theme by Yorushika, titled 雲を抜け風下へ私だけ . The video’s original upload timestamp is August 15, 2026, at 04:23:17 PDT (11:23:17 UTC) ; AniNextUp records the exact timestamp and offset in the VideoObject metadata. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Opens on YouTube A later second promotional video announced Eve’s ending theme, AIYOU . These are separate music credits: Yorushika performs the opening, while Eve performs the ending. The official music page and October announcement are linked in the sources below. Who returns in the main cast? Aoi Yūki returns as Maomao and Takeo Ōtsuka as Jinshi, the two central performances listed on the official Season 3 cast page. OLM handles the animation. These credits come from the Season 3 production page; the separate movie has its own announcements, so its cast updates should not be mistaken for a TV-season change. How does the December movie connect to Season 3? The franchise’s first theatrical film, The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure , is scheduled for December 11, 2026 in Japan. It is a separate film project with an original story concept by Natsu Hyūga, not the second cour of Season 3. See our movie guide for its trailer, characters and theatrical release details. Frequently asked questions When does episode 53 air? The official calendar lists October 30, 2026, at 11:40 p.m. JST. Check your streaming service for its own regional time. When does Season 3 return after the first cour? The second cour is scheduled for April 2027. An exact day has not been announced. How many episodes are in Season 3? The official split-cour announcement does not give a total episode count. Episode 53 is the overall series number, not the season’s episode count. Is Season 3 available on Crunchyroll? Yes, in territories where Crunchyroll carries it. Availability and language options vary by country. entries.title: Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 Anime Officially Announced
entries.description: Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4, the Royal Academy arc, is officially getting a TV anime from WIT Studio. Release date and streaming are still TBA.
entries.content: SEQUEL ANNOUNCED · OCTOBER 7, 2026 Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 Anime Officially Announced Ascendance of a Bookworm is continuing into the story's Part 4, the Royal Academy arc. The new TV anime is officially confirmed, and WIT Studio will continue handling animation production. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases RELEASE TV ANIME · DATE TBA Is Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 getting an anime? Yes. The official anime site confirmed that the story will continue with a TV anime adaptation of the Royal Academy's Self-Proclaimed Library Committee arc, the next major part of Rozemyne's story after Adopted Daughter of an Archduke . When is Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 coming out? No release date or broadcast window has been announced yet. The announcement confirms the TV anime itself and its returning animation studio, but fans should treat any specific premiere date circulating online as unconfirmed until the production publishes one. Which studio is making Part 4? WIT Studio will continue as the animation production studio. That gives the new arc production continuity with the 2026 Adopted Daughter of an Archduke anime, rather than returning to the studio configuration used for the earlier seasons. What will the Royal Academy arc cover? The official synopsis begins after Rozemyne awakens from roughly two years of sleep. She is soon sent to the Royal Academy, where nobles study magic, magic tools and the skills expected of future rulers. For Rozemyne, however, the discovery of a large academy library immediately becomes a major attraction. The setting matters because it expands the series beyond Ehrenfest's familiar circles: new teachers, students from other duchies and the academy's political structure give Rozemyne a much larger world to navigate while she continues pursuing books. Why the Royal Academy changes the setting Rozemyne's move to the Royal Academy places her among nobles from other duchies and introduces an institution devoted to magical education. The academy library is an immediate attraction for her, but the larger setting also means unfamiliar social rules and political relationships. The announcement identifies the arc; it does not yet supply an episode count. Related reading: One-Punch Man Season 3 Part 2: January 2027 Release, New Trailer and JAM Project Opening . What newcomers should know about the arc title The Royal Academy's Self-Proclaimed Library Committee is the name of the announced story arc, not a confirmation of a particular international season number. Rozemyne's earlier experiences in Ehrenfest and her adoption into noble society provide the context for the academy's new social environment. Viewers starting here may therefore miss why her love of books can clash with expectations placed on a noble student. The official announcement identifies the next arc but does not specify its episode count or how international platforms will label it. Is this Season 5? English-language naming for Ascendance of a Bookworm can be confusing because the novels' “Parts” and the anime's seasons are not the same numbering system. The official announcement identifies the adaptation by its Part 4 / Royal Academy arc story title rather than announcing an English “Season 5” label. AniNextUp will use the official naming until international distributors establish their own season numbering. Will Part 4 stream on Crunchyroll? International streaming for the new Part 4 anime has not been announced. Previous anime installments are available through Crunchyroll in supported territories, but that does not by itself confirm the platform for this sequel. We will update this page when an official distributor announces streaming rights. Why this sequel announcement matters The franchise has surpassed 14 million copies in circulation, including digital editions , and the new announcement arrived directly after the latest anime moved Rozemyne toward the Royal Academy. Confirming WIT Studio at the same time makes this more than a vague sequel tease: the next story arc and animation production are both established. What remains unconfirmed? The production has not announced a premiere date, episode count, international streaming platform or a dedicated Part 4 trailer. Additional cast and detailed staff information for the new arc also remain subject to future announcements. Related reading: Armored Trooper VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1 . Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 FAQ Has Part 4 been officially confirmed? Yes. The official anime production announced a new TV anime adapting the Royal Academy arc. Is WIT Studio returning? Yes. WIT Studio is officially confirmed to continue animation production. Does Part 4 have a release date? No. A release date and broadcast window are still TBA. Is there an official Part 4 trailer? Not yet. The announcement currently confirms the adaptation and studio rather than a new promotional video. AniNextUp status: TV anime adaptation and WIT Studio are confirmed. Release date, episode count and international streaming remain TBA. Updated: October 16, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error Release announcement: sequel confirmed at WIT Studio; release date still unannounced . Primary production announcement: WIT Studio continuation confirmation .

entries.content: NOVEMBER 3 · NETFLIX Bass X Machina: Official Full Trailer, Netflix Release Date & Cast Bass X Machina premieres globally on Netflix on November 3, 2026. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official full trailer thumbnail · Netflix. Release at a glance Release November 3, 2026 Where to watch Netflix worldwide, as announced by Netflix Applies to Global Netflix release Still pending Exact release hour Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Official source RELEASE November 3, 2026 STREAMING Netflix · Worldwide announced STUDIO Studio Mir How the frontier setting sharpens the central dilemma Bass X Machina combines a lawless Western landscape with machines and supernatural dangers, but its family-protection premise gives those elements a personal cost. The father's decisions may protect the people closest to him while also threatening their trust in him. That tension is a useful way to approach the story without predicting events not described in the official synopsis. When does Bass X Machina release? Bass X Machina premieres on Netflix on November 3, 2026. Netflix's official Annecy announcement lists November 3, 2026 as the release date. Netflix Japan's worldwide launch announcement separately announces the same date for a worldwide exclusive launch, so viewers elsewhere should check their local catalog. Where to watch Bass X Machina is a Netflix series. Availability is tied to Netflix's regional catalogs, so AniNextUp will keep the release guide updated if the service publishes territory-specific differences. Related reading: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers: Premiere, Cast, Streaming and Official Trailer . What is Bass X Machina about? The story takes place in a lawless steampunk West populated by violent outlaws, machines and supernatural threats. A father is forced into the roles of judge, jury and executioner while trying to protect his family, even as every violent decision risks pushing those same people away. Who is making the series? LeSean Thomas created the series and Studio Mir handles animation. Brian Tyree Henry stars and is also an executive producer alongside Thomas, Jennifer Wiley-Moxley and Chad Handley. The cast also includes Tati Gabrielle and Cree Summer. Watch the new official Netflix trailer Netflix has released a longer trailer ahead of the November 3 premiere. Its official title page now lists both the new full trailer and the earlier teaser separately. The release date remains unchanged. Related reading: In a World Full of Zombies Anime: January 2027 Premiere, New Trailer, Cast and Music . Official full trailer Bass X Machina — Official Full Trailer — watch on YouTube → Watch the full trailer on Netflix . Earlier official teaser ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Netflix See all confirmed November 2026 releases → What the announced story and credits actually confirm Netflix describes Bass X Machina as a series set in a lawless steampunk West, where outlaws, machines and supernatural threats surround a father trying to protect his family. The premise gives the action a conflict beyond survival: his role as judge, jury and executioner may create distance between him and the people he wants to save. That is the central tension the official synopsis offers; it does not reveal how the family responds or how the story resolves it. LeSean Thomas created the series and Studio Mir is the animation studio. Brian Tyree Henry is both a star and an executive producer; Tati Gabrielle and Cree Summer are also in the announced cast. The executive producers listed by Netflix include Thomas, Henry, Jennifer Wiley-Moxley and Chad Handley. These credits help readers distinguish the creative roles: Thomas is the series creator, Studio Mir produces the animation, and Henry’s involvement extends beyond voice performance. Trailer, teaser and release date are separate updates Netflix has published an earlier teaser and a later full trailer. A local catalog remains the final check for viewing in a specific country. At the time of this update, Netflix has not posted an exact release hour or a detailed episode rollout in the cited announcements. AniNextUp therefore lists the confirmed day and leaves the hour open. The phrase “worldwide” describes Netflix’s announced launch plan; it does not tell viewers what time the title becomes playable in every time zone or whether every language track is ready at the same moment. entries.content: JANUARY 2027 · NEW ANIME · OCTOBER 24, 2026 The True Saint Was Banished Anime: January 2027 & Trailer Because I, the True Saint, Was Banished, That Country Is Done For! begins Japanese television broadcasts in January 2027. The official announcement includes a teaser introducing Eliane and Nigel, with Masumi Tazawa and Taku Yashiro leading the cast. An exact premiere day and international streaming release have not been established by the cited announcements. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases ©Shikiso Utsuzawa, Kodansha / True Saint Production Committee. Official promotional image from the production website . Release at a glance Release window January 2027 · exact day TBA Studio Tsumugi Akita Anime Lab Lead Japanese cast Masumi Tazawa as Eliane; Taku Yashiro as Nigel Where to watch Japanese TV announced; overseas streaming TBA Official sources checked October 24, 2026 · Official website When does The True Saint Was Banished anime come out? The production confirmed a January 2027 television window in its October 3 official update . The notice also introduced the teaser and named the music composer. Bandai Namco Filmworks' V-STORAGE report reproduces the release information and production credits. A month-level announcement does not identify January 1 or any other first-episode day. Japanese broadcast times and any overseas release schedule still need their own confirmed listings. Related reading: The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All Anime: January 8, 2027 Premiere and Trailer . Official teaser trailer The teaser uses Eliane's narration to introduce her circumstances and her meeting with Nigel. It also previews music credited to Harakanako. The video below is the exact teaser linked by the production's official news page. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER Because I, the True Saint, Was Banished Watch the official teaser on YouTube if the embedded player is unavailable. Video availability may vary by region. What is the story about? Eliane supports her kingdom as a saint, but Prince Claude breaks off their engagement and expels her. She decides to leave that relationship behind. After helping Nigel, a prince from a neighboring country, she is invited to stay at his castle and starts putting her abilities to use in a different setting. The official introduction frames the story around Eliane's fresh start. Her healing power matters, but the premise also centers on rebuilding her life after rejection. Confirmed Japanese cast and animation studio Masumi Tazawa voices Eliane, while Taku Yashiro plays Nigel. The production's character profiles describe Eliane as a capable, determined saint and Nigel as a considerate prince. Tsumugi Akita Anime Lab is producing the animation. Tsukasa Sakurai directs, Naoki Tozuka handles series composition and Naru Nishikori designs the characters. The music credit is Harakanako. These credits are listed on the official staff and cast section ; they do not specify an episode total. Which original work is being adapted? The source novels are written by Shikiso Utsuzawa with original character designs by Pukyunosuke. Mokuba Matsu draws the manga adaptation. The official books section distinguishes the novel and comic editions. Readers may also encounter the Japanese title Shin no Seijo de Aru Watashi wa Tsuihou Saremashita. Dakara Kono Kuni wa Mou Owari desu . Where will it stream? The cited production materials confirm Japanese television in January. They do not establish a worldwide Netflix, Crunchyroll or HIDIVE release. An international platform, territorial restrictions, subtitle languages and an English dub timetable need separate distributor confirmation. What information is still to come? The premiere day, full broadcast schedule and episode count are not established by these sources. Once additional details are announced, they should be incorporated into this guide, keeping the same article URL. For more confirmed announcements, browse our latest anime news and January 2027 anime guide . A Japanese broadcast announcement does not establish international streaming availability. How to read the teaser and source-material credits The official teaser introduces Eliane through her narration and shows her meeting Nigel, while the production notice confirms the composer and January 2027 window. Those promotional details help identify the project, but they do not reveal an episode total or how much of the source story the television season will adapt. The official books section lists the original novels and the manga separately; that distinction matters because a manga credit does not replace the novelist or establish that the anime follows a particular comic volume. Until the production names a story endpoint, readers should avoid using the number of published books to predict a finale or cour split. What to watch for in future release notices The next useful updates would be an exact Japanese premiere day, station and airtime, then any separate announcement from an international distributor. A date for the Japanese broadcast would not automatically set the time a subtitled stream appears in another territory. The official site and Bandai Namco Filmworks notice are the references used here; a regional service listing should be added only when that distributor confirms it. Why does Eliane leave her former kingdom? The official introduction adds context beyond the short “banished saint” premise. Eliane had served Belkaim as its true saint, but Prince Claude suddenly ends their engagement and expels her. The same introduction says she is tired of his mistreatment and infidelity, so leaving is also her decision to begin a different life. She later helps Nigel, the neighboring kingdom’s prince, after he is injured in a monster fight. His invitation to stay at his castle gives her a place to use her abilities without returning to the relationship she left. That setup makes the title’s promise of a happy restart more than a simple story of a royal punishment. Do you need to read the novels before watching? No prerequisite reading is named in the anime announcements. The official books section identifies Utsuzawa’s novels, Pukyunosuke’s original character designs and Matsu Mokuba’s manga adaptation as separate parts of the franchise. That is useful context if you want to compare versions, but it does not confirm that the anime will adapt a specific volume or follow every manga scene. New viewers can begin with the television series when it airs; readers interested in the source can choose the novels or manga according to the format they prefer. A later episode or adaptation announcement would be needed to map the anime to a precise book or chapter. Published: October 24, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.content: OFFICIAL ANIME NEWS · OCTOBER 15, 2026 Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 Confirmed for 2027: New Trailer and Streaming Details Fate Graphite's dark-fantasy journey continues in 2027. The anime's official website has posted a Season 2 teaser, while Crunchyroll has identified the regions where it plans to stream the sequel. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official Season 2 teaser video thumbnail, © Ichika Isshiki / Micro Magazine / Berserk of Gluttony production committee. Official announcement . Release at a glance Premiere 2027; exact date not announced Streaming Crunchyroll in announced territories New teaser Published October 9, 2026 on the official Japanese website Still pending Premiere day, broadcast time and regional simulcast schedule Details checked October 15, 2026 · Crunchyroll's NYCC announcement · Official anime website When is Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 coming out? Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 is scheduled for 2027. The official anime website announced the 2027 broadcast window on August 23, 2026, and Crunchyroll repeated that window at New York Comic Con on October 8. Neither announcement specifies a month or day. A particular premiere date circulating online should not be treated as confirmed until the production announces it. Where to watch Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 Crunchyroll has announced Season 2 streaming for North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East and the CIS. That regional list comes from Crunchyroll's October 8 announcement; it does not establish the precise launch hour or guarantee that every individual country has identical availability. Check your local Crunchyroll catalog when the premiere approaches. The distinction matters: a Japanese television broadcast window and an international streaming schedule are not automatically the same. At the time of this update, Crunchyroll has not supplied a universal episode release time. Related reading: Anime Releasing in December 2026: Confirmed Dates . What should viewers remember before Season 2? The continuation follows Fate and Greed after their earlier journey, so their partnership is useful context when approaching the new teaser. The footage promotes the next stage of their story, but it does not establish a precise 2027 premiere month or how many episodes the sequel will contain. Viewers catching up should treat Season 2 as a continuation rather than assuming the teaser explains the earlier character relationship. Watch the new official Season 2 teaser The official teaser released October 9, 2026 shows Fate and Greed preparing for the story's next stage. Watch the promotional video below, linked from the anime production's own announcement. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Season 2 teaser PV · Official production Watch the official Season 2 teaser on YouTube · Read the original October 9 announcement . What is the sequel about? The series follows Fate Graphite, whose seemingly worthless Gluttony skill turns out to let him absorb the abilities and attributes of enemies he defeats. The new-season synopsis circulated by Crunchyroll places Fate back in the royal capital after dangerous battles alongside Greed, his sentient black sword. It also emphasizes the tension between his extraordinary powers and his desire for an ordinary life. This is a premise-level description, not an episode-by-episode account. The October announcements do not establish how many episodes Season 2 will have or precisely which light-novel volumes it will adapt. What has actually been confirmed? Production of Season 2 was announced on April 27, 2026, with a commemorative visual. The 2027 broadcast window followed in August, and the official website added a teaser in October. Crunchyroll's New York Comic Con presentation separately confirmed its planned streaming territories. These are different milestones; the October teaser should not be mistaken for an announcement of an exact release date. Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 FAQ Is Season 2 officially confirmed? Yes. The production announced a second season in April 2026 and later confirmed a 2027 broadcast window. Is there an exact release date? No. As of October 15, 2026, the official announcements identify 2027 but not a specific month or day. Will Season 2 be on Crunchyroll? Yes, Crunchyroll has announced the sequel for multiple regions. Exact local availability and timing may vary. Is the new trailer official? Yes. The anime's Japanese production website lists a Season 2 teaser update dated October 9, 2026. Official sources and related anime news Berserk of Gluttony official anime website — teaser and broadcast announcements Crunchyroll — October 8, 2026 NYCC streaming and release-window announcement Crunchyroll — April 27, 2026 Season 2 production announcement For other officially announced upcoming series, read our One-Punch Man Season 3 Part 2 guide and The Boxer anime announcement , or browse the anime release calendar . This article will be updated when the production confirms the exact premiere date or additional distribution details. Updated: October 16, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.content: SEASON 2 · OCTOBER 3, 2026 Black Clover Season 2 Schedule & Where to Watch Episode 4 (overall #174) arrived October 24. See Black Clover Season 2’s Saturday broadcast and streaming schedule, dub timing, episode order and official trailer. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official Season 2 campaign visual. Source: Black Clover anime portal . © Yūki Tabata / Shueisha, TV Tokyo, Black Clover Production Committee. Release at a glance Japanese premiere October 3, 2026 · Saturdays at 11:00 p.m. JST Current listed episode Episode 4 · #174 overall · October 24, 2026 Studio and director Studio Pierrot · Ayataka Tanemura Subtitled stream Crunchyroll · Saturdays at 8:00 a.m. Pacific in supported regions English dub Started October 17, 2026 · weekly on Crunchyroll Checked October 24, 2026 · Official broadcast and streaming schedule When did Black Clover Season 2 premiere? Black Clover Season 2 premiered in Japan on Saturday, October 3, 2026, at 11:00 p.m. JST on TV Tokyo and affiliated stations. The official broadcast page also lists BS TV Tokyo on October 7 at midnight. These are Japanese television times; a service in another country can publish an episode on a different local date or hour. Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 schedule lists subtitled episodes on Saturdays at 8:00 a.m. Pacific Time in the territories where it carries the series. The first episode became available there on October 3. On October 24, the anime’s official story page listed episode 4, numbered episode 174 in the overall series. That is the current episode as of this guide’s check date, not a forecast for later weeks. Check your own Crunchyroll catalog for regional rights, subtitle options and any schedule notice before watching. Why is the new season on episode 174? The original television anime ran for 170 episodes. The current season continues that count: its first four listed installments are episodes 171, 172, 173 and 174. Some platforms or fan databases may label them Season 2 episodes 1–4, while the Japanese production site uses the continuing story numbers. Both labels can refer to the same episode, so look for the title and release date as well as the number when searching. The season is a continuation, not a reboot or a recap. Crunchyroll’s synopsis places Asta and the Magic Knights in a raid on the Spade Kingdom as they try to save their captains from the Dark Triad. New viewers will get more from that conflict if they first see the earlier anime, which introduces the squads, rivalries and magic system that drive the stakes. Related reading: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Schedule & Where to Watch . Where can you stream it? Crunchyroll is the international option listed for supported territories across North and South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, the CIS, the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. This regional list does not mean the show is available in every country; licensing can differ, so check the service while signed into your location. The Japanese portal lists a separate domestic rollout. Anime Times, Lemino, U-NEXT and Anime Hodai began advance streaming on October 4 at noon JST. Other Japanese services began rolling out episodes from October 8 at noon, with additional free and rental listings. These details describe Japan’s platforms; they do not establish access outside Japan. The TV Tokyo broadcast, Japanese streaming windows and Crunchyroll’s international schedule are separate release clocks. Is the English dub available? Yes. Crunchyroll announced the Season 2 English dub with its first episode on October 17, followed by weekly dubbed episodes. The dub is a separate track and schedule from the Saturday subtitled simulcast; do not assume both versions appear at the same time. The initial English dub cast includes Dallas Reid as Asta, Micah Solusod as Yuno and Bryce Papenbrook as Liebe. Check the show’s episode selector to see which language tracks are available in your region. Related reading: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode Schedule & Where to Watch . What are the story and production details? Season 2 moves into the conflict with the Spade Kingdom and the Dark Triad, while Asta’s anti-magic and the Magic Knights’ teamwork remain central to the story. The official synopsis is a useful spoiler-light guide: the mission is to rescue captured captains. The episode list currently shows four entries, but the production site has not announced a total episode count in the material checked for this update. Treat claims about a 26-episode or split-cour run as unconfirmed unless the anime’s official channels publish them. Studio Pierrot continues the animation. Ayataka Tanemura directs, Keiichiro Ochi handles series composition, Itsuko Takeda designs the characters and Minako Seki composes the music. The official music page credits WANIMA with the opening theme “消えない理由” and ONE OR EIGHT with the ending theme “Yellow Brick Road.” These details help distinguish confirmed production information from speculation about how much manga material the season will adapt. Where can I watch the official trailer? Crunchyroll’s verified channel released “Black Clover Second Season | Official Trailer 3” on July 4, 2026. The original upload time shown on YouTube is 8:03:40 p.m. PDT (July 5 at 3:03:40 a.m. UTC). The trailer gives a look at the return without confirming the season’s total episode count. Use the linked official video rather than reuploads, which may have different dates or regional edits. Related reading: Fall 2026 Anime Release Schedule & Calendar: October–December 2026 . Black Clover Season 2 FAQ Is episode 174 the fourth episode of this season? Yes. The official site lists episodes 171 through 174 for the first four installments of the second season. Does the season have a confirmed episode count? The official materials checked here do not state a total. A reported or predicted count is not confirmation. When do new subtitled episodes arrive on Crunchyroll? Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 lineup lists Saturday at 8:00 a.m. Pacific Time in supported regions. Local availability and schedule changes can vary. Related reading: Nia Liston Anime Release Date, Schedule & Where to Watch . Should I watch the first season first? Yes. Season 2 continues the existing story and relies on the Magic Knights, their squads and the conflict built earlier. Start with the original run if you want the character relationships and stakes in context. For more seasonal listings, see AniNextUp’s Fall 2026 calendar and our guide to A Returner’s Magic Should Be Special Season 2 . Release schedules can change; use the official broadcast and streaming pages linked below for the latest regional details. BLEACH and Graniph reveal a 17-item Shikai-inspired collection The BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War anime and Japanese apparel brand Graniph have announced their first collaboration.
