entries.description: Find BLEACH THE LAST PV's exact upload time, Japan TV dates for episodes 49 and 50, subtitle and dub schedules, and where to check availability.
entries.content: OFFICIAL TRAILER NEWS · OCTOBER 16, 2026 BLEACH: THE LAST PV, Episode 50 Date & Where to Watch. What is BLEACH: THE LAST PV? BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War released “THE LAST PV” on October 16, 2026. It is a promotional video for the closing stretch of the television adaptation, not an announcement of another season. The official anime site presents it alongside the final two episode dates: episode 49 and episode 50. The subtitle “The Calamity” is used for the final part in VIZ’s viewing guide, while the Japanese broadcast page identifies the numbered episodes and their Japanese TV times. The original video is on the official BLEACH anime channel and is linked from the anime website’s October 16 notice . YouTube’s published metadata records its upload at 4:00:38 a.m. PDT (UTC−07:00) on October 16 , or 11:00:38 UTC. This is the video’s timestamp, not an estimate from the article’s date. The PV runs 1 minute 42 seconds on the official video page. It promotes the final conflict without changing the confirmed broadcast schedule. When do episodes 49 and 50 air in Japan? The official Japan broadcast schedule lists episode 49 for Monday, October 19, 2026 at 24:00 JST on the TV Tokyo network. Japanese schedules sometimes use 24:00 to mean midnight at the end of the named date: viewers should read this slot as the start of Tuesday, October 20. Episode 50 is listed for Monday, October 26 at 24:00 JST, which is midnight at the start of Tuesday, October 27. BS TV Tokyo’s corresponding slots are October 20 and 27 at 24:30 JST. That distinction matters when searching for “BLEACH episode 50 release date.” The date printed beside the Japanese weekday is October 26, but the clock crosses into October 27. If a local guide converts the slot to a different calendar date, it may be expressing the same broadcast time rather than reporting a postponement. The official page also notes that other Japanese stations publish their own schedules, so the TV Tokyo listing should not be assumed to cover every channel. Where can viewers stream the final two subtitled episodes? For the United States, VIZ says episodes 49 and 50 stream on Hulu on Disney+ at 8:30 a.m. PDT on October 19 and October 26, respectively. VIZ’s guide lists Disney+ internationally for subtitles in English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, German and French. Platform catalogs can differ by territory, so “Disney+ internationally” does not guarantee that every language or episode appears at the same local time in every country. As of October 25, episode 49’s scheduled subtitled release date has passed. Episode 50 is due the next day on the schedule published by VIZ. Check the service available in your country and its episode listing if the title does not appear at the U.S. time; AniNextUp cannot infer regional access from a Japan broadcast listing. When do the English and other dubs arrive? The dub schedule is separate from the subtitled release. VIZ lists the English and Spanish Hulu dubs of episode 49 for Monday, November 23, at 8:30 a.m. PDT and episode 50 for Monday, November 30, at the same time. For Disney+, VIZ lists English, Spanish, Portuguese and German dubs on those November dates, with French dubs scheduled for December 14 and 21. VIZ describes the Disney+ availability as applying in select international markets; check the local catalog rather than assuming all language tracks are offered in each country. These later dub dates do not mean the Japanese broadcast has moved. They are localization release windows for the same episodes. The page currently gives dates for the final two dubbed installments but does not supply a single universal launch time for every Disney+ territory, so the exact local clock time remains dependent on the service’s regional listing. What does the PV confirm about the story? The title and official caption frame the footage as Ichigo Kurosaki’s final battle, involving the Human World, Soul Society and Hueco Mundo. The premise is consistent with the final part’s endgame conflict, but a trailer is not a scene-by-scene episode synopsis. It does not verify every fan interpretation of a shot, nor does it establish changes to the manga’s ending. Viewers avoiding spoilers can watch the short PV for its promotional footage, while readers looking for a complete plot summary should wait for the episodes or consult an official synopsis. Is episode 50 the series finale? The production’s October 16 post calls the broadcast schedule the final two episodes, and VIZ labels episodes 49 and 50 the final two subtitled episodes of The Final Part . Taken together, the official notices identify episode 50 as the closing installment of this television adaptation. They do not announce an additional episode after it. Separate commemorative events or merchandise announcements are not evidence of more story episodes. What is still unknown? The official sources confirm the PV, its date and exact upload time, Japan’s final two broadcast slots, VIZ’s subtitled schedule and several dub dates. They do not provide a universal streaming launch time for all countries, confirm that every territory carries every language, or announce a new BLEACH production after episode 50. Any claim of a follow-up anime or film needs a separate official announcement. For the most reliable updates, use the official BLEACH anime news page for Japanese announcements, the official broadcast schedule for Japan, and VIZ’s Part 4 streaming guide for regional subtitle and dub information. AniNextUp will update this page if those sources publish a revised schedule or new project details. Updated: October 25, 2026.

entries.title: Bless Anime Reveals Koki Uchiyama as Akiharu Nakano Ahead of January 2027 Premiere
entries.description: The Bless anime has cast Koki Uchiyama as Akiharu Nakano and released a new character preview. Here's what is confirmed about its January 2027 debut.
entries.content: OFFICIAL CAST NEWS · JANUARY 2027 Bless Anime Reveals Koki Uchiyama as Akiharu Nakano Ahead of January 2027 Premiere The upcoming fashion-and-makeup drama Bless has introduced another character ahead of its Japanese television premiere in January 2027. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Published: October 15, 2026 · Our editorial policy Official teaser visual · © Yukino Sonoyama, Kodansha / Bless Production Committee. Source: official anime website . Release at a glance Premiere January 2027 in Japan; exact day not announced Broadcast Fuji TV's noitaminA programming block Studio A-1 Pictures New cast Koki Uchiyama as Akiharu Nakano Streaming Crunchyroll — worldwide excluding Japan and China; January 2027 What is new in the Bless anime announcement? On October 15, 2026, the production introduced Akiharu Nakano (Nakano Akiharu), a first-year high-school student who studies makeup with the Mirror group. Koki Uchiyama voices the character. A new character promotional video featuring his voice was released alongside the casting news. This is a character-focused preview, not a new full-series trailer. According to the character profile distributed with the announcement, Nakano is quiet, highly skilled and fast at makeup application. He greatly admires Hikaru Oya, another figure associated with the academy. The update is part of the production's series of weekly character introductions. Is the Akiharu Nakano video a new series trailer? No. The October 15 announcement from Aniplex identifies this as a character PV that reveals Koki Uchiyama's performance as Akiharu Nakano. It does not replace a full-series trailer or establish a specific first-episode date. The separately confirmed television window remains January 2027 in Japan. When does Bless premiere? Bless is scheduled to begin airing in January 2027 on Fuji TV’s noitaminA block in Japan. An exact day is not specified in the official production listings checked for this October 26 update. International streaming is now confirmed: Crunchyroll announced on October 22 that it will stream the series worldwide excluding Japan and China. This supersedes the earlier version of this article, which said no platform had been announced. What is Bless about? Based on Yukino Sonoyama's manga, the story follows Aia Udagawa, a former model who has lost confidence in his dream of becoming a makeup artist, and Jun Sumisaki, a student who wants to model but struggles to take the first step. A school festival competition becomes a turning point for both, as they begin pursuing their ambitions through makeup and fashion. The series is being animated by A-1 Pictures . Shotaro Kitamura directs, with series composition and scripts credited to Fukuro Kamiza , character designs by Honoka Yokoyama and music by Ryo Yoshimata . Watch Akiharu Nakano's official character PV ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL CHARACTER PV Akiharu Nakano · Koki Uchiyama Watch the official Akiharu Nakano character PV on YouTube . Where can fans watch the official character video? The latest character promotional video is reported in the October 15 casting announcement. Readers can follow the video and casting update through the official Bless anime website and the October 15 announcement coverage . The official character PV is embedded above. What happens next? The next scheduling detail to watch for is a specific January premiere day. The month, Japanese programming block and Crunchyroll license are confirmed; a complete episode timetable, dubbing schedule and total episode count are not established by the announcements cited here. Official sources Bless TV anime official website · A-1 Pictures official production listing · October 15 cast announcement and character preview report . Explore more verified announcements in AniNextUp Anime News and upcoming premieres in the anime release calendar . What Uchiyama says about playing Nakano In his comment published by Aniplex on October 15 , Uchiyama says the makeup and modeling world was unfamiliar territory for him when he encountered the manga. He describes enjoying that fresh perspective and being pleased to join an anime dealing with an unusual subject. He also identifies Nakano as a high-school student learning makeup at Mirror who deeply respects Hikaru Oya. His acting approach centers on expressing what the reserved character carries inside. That is a useful distinction for readers meeting Nakano through a short preview: saying little does not mean having little motivation. The announcement offers a starting point for understanding the performance, without revealing how Nakano's relationships or ambitions will develop across the adaptation. Why Mirror matters to the story Kodansha's official description of the second manga volume introduces Mirror as a school for aspiring makeup artists. For Aia, entering that environment means encountering other people with the same professional goal, including potential rivals. Jun's modeling ambitions continue alongside his training, with the publisher describing her attempts to enter casting calls and build on their work together. This background explains why a supporting student's introduction matters beyond adding another name to the cast. Mirror broadens the story's focus from an individual dream to the pressures of learning a craft around talented peers. These are elements of the source manga's published premise, rather than confirmation that the anime will adapt a particular volume in full or follow an announced chapter-by-chapter schedule. Hikaru Oya has also received a cast announcement There has been another relevant update since Nakano's introduction. Aniplex announced on October 22 that Tarusuke Shingaki voices Hikaru Oya, accompanied by Oya's own character PV. Keeping the announcements separate avoids confusing the two roles: Uchiyama plays Nakano, while Shingaki plays the figure Nakano admires. In his accompanying comment, Shingaki describes Oya watching Aia with feelings that include admiration and frustration. That provides another official perspective on the cast's relationships while leaving their development for the series itself. Neither casting update establishes a new premiere day. Reading Bless before the anime Kodansha USA publishes the manga in English in print and digital formats. Its series introduction emphasizes Aia and Jun challenging other people's expectations of their appearance and abilities. Readers interested in the underlying story can begin with the first volume; the character PV is promotional material for the adaptation, rather than a substitute for that opening narrative. entries.content: NEW ANIME FILM · OCTOBER 6, 2026 Cosmoship Yamato √2199 Anime Film Announced With Hideaki Anno Directing Cosmoship Yamato √2199 (Root 2199) is officially in production as a feature-length theatrical anime, bringing Hideaki Anno and Yutaka Izubuchi together as directors and marking the first animation co-production between Production I.G and Khara. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases RELEASE THEATRICAL ANIME FILM · DATE TBA Why the new project should not be confused with the older series The √2199 title and its connection to the Yamato franchise do not make this a newly announced television season of Space Battleship Yamato 2199. The confirmed format is a feature-length animated film, and its first announcement emphasizes the creative leadership and Production I.G–Khara partnership. A premiere date and overseas distribution remain open questions. What was announced for Cosmoship Yamato √2199? On October 6, the 52nd anniversary of the original Space Battleship Yamato TV premiere, the production formally announced Cosmoship Yamato √2199 and unveiled its first teaser visual. The project is a new feature-length theatrical animation rather than a TV season. Who is directing the new Yamato movie? Hideaki Anno serves as planner, executive producer, director and design-works contributor. Yutaka Izubuchi also directs and handles design work. Mitsuhisa Ishikawa is credited with planning, while the original work is credited to Yoshinobu Nishizaki. Which studios are making it? Production I.G and Khara are jointly handling animation production. The official announcement describes this as the studios' first animation co-production, making the production partnership one of the most notable parts of the reveal. When does Cosmoship Yamato √2199 release? No release date or release window has been announced. The official site says further information will follow. There is also no confirmed international theatrical or streaming plan yet. Is √2199 the same as Space Battleship Yamato 2199? No. The title deliberately echoes Yamato 2199, but this is a newly announced theatrical project. Fans should not assume it is a conventional continuation of the existing remake line until the production provides story and continuity details. What can the creative credits tell us? The announced collaboration places Hideaki Anno and Yutaka Izubuchi in directing roles, with Production I.G and Khara handling animation. Those credits are meaningful production facts, but they cannot by themselves establish the film's narrative continuity, visual style or intended release year. The distinction is especially important because the title resembles Space Battleship Yamato 2199 while the official reveal describes a separate theatrical project. Which details are still missing? The announcement establishes a feature film and its creative leadership, but not the story's place in the existing Yamato continuities. A release date, cast, runtime and overseas distribution are also unannounced. Until the production publishes those details, the shared number in the title should not be treated as proof of a direct sequel. AniNextUp status: The film, core staff, Production I.G × Khara collaboration and teaser visual are confirmed. Release timing, cast and distribution remain TBA. It should not be interpreted as 81 brand-new productions, 81 global premieres, or 81 exclusives. Does this mean 81 exclusive anime? No. A lineup count is different from an exclusive-title count. The service's fall selection can include simulcast series, catalog availability, and titles with different release arrangements. Viewers should consult each title's listing for exact start times, subscription conditions and any early or exclusive distribution notes. Can viewers outside Japan watch these anime? This is a Japan-specific streaming announcement . It does not confirm that the same 81 titles are available internationally, nor does it establish distribution rights on Crunchyroll, Netflix, Disney+ or other services. Regional availability varies by title and must be checked separately against each platform's official listings. What this means for anime fans The announcement offers a useful snapshot of the breadth of the fall season on one Japanese service. Those labels answer different questions. “Exclusive” is a rights description for a specific distribution window or service set; “early” indicates timing relative to other platforms; “rental” can involve a separate payment. See the confirmed release details, studio and official trailer below. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Release at a glance Release November 6, 2026 Where to watch Prime Video worldwide exclusive Applies to Global streaming announcement Still pending Exact episode release hour Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Official source RELEASE November 6, 2026 STREAMING Prime Video · Worldwide STUDIO Production I.G Why the boundary between worlds is the central mystery Yuuma and his classmates enter Actual Magic as a full-dive game, but the announced premise turns on what happens when they try to leave after defeating a boss. If virtual and physical reality no longer remain separate, familiar game rules cannot automatically be treated as safe assumptions. That creates a survival question distinct from simply completing another level. What worldwide exclusivity does and does not mean The official announcement identifies Prime Video as the worldwide exclusive streaming home beginning November 6. That provides a clearer platform answer than a Japan-only television schedule, but viewers should still check their local Prime Video listing for precise availability and release time rather than assume a single global clock time. When does Demon's Crest release? Demon's Crest premieres worldwide on November 6, 2026. Unlike many seasonal anime with separate Japanese and international schedules, the official site explicitly describes the release as a worldwide Prime Video exclusive. Related reading: The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop Anime Premieres January 2027 . Where to watch Demon's Crest Prime Video has worldwide exclusive streaming rights beginning November 6. That makes the platform the confirmed destination for the anime rather than a Japan-only broadcaster followed by an unconfirmed international simulcast. What is Demon's Crest about? Sixth-grader Yuuma Ashihara takes part in a test of Actual Magic, a full-sensory full-dive VRMMO. After Yuuma and his classmates defeat a boss and try to log out, the boundary between the game's world and reality begins to collapse. Who is making the anime? Production I.G is producing the adaptation of Reki Kawahara's light novel series. Kawahara is also known for Sword Art Online and Accel World. The official promotional campaign pairs the virtual-world imagery of Actual Magic with an increasingly unsettling real-world setting. Related reading: Paw & Palaces Releases Creditless Ending Video Featuring “Chill Choose!” . What the November 6 announcement confirms The official Prime Video announcement gives viewers a platform and a worldwide premiere date. It does not by itself establish that every language track will be available on day one, that the complete season arrives at once, or that all countries show the same release hour. For those details, check the local Prime Video episode listing closer to launch. The announced premise also leaves the nature of the game's overlap with reality unresolved; explanations of that mystery would be speculation rather than confirmed story information. Opening and ending themes Ado performs the opening theme “Shinka.” The production later confirmed Soala's “ReaL” as the ending theme alongside its second promotional video. entries.title: Dengeki Daisy Anime Sets January 2027 Premiere, Reveals Trailer and Cast
entries.description: Dengeki Daisy premieres in January 2027 with two consecutive cours. See the official trailer, Studio DEEN staff, cast and streaming details.
entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · JANUARY 2027 Dengeki Daisy Anime Sets January 2027 Premiere, Reveals Trailer and Cast The long-awaited adaptation of Kyousuke Motomi's romance-suspense manga has a confirmed broadcast window, a full promotional video and a two-cour schedule. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Published: October 15, 2026 · How we verify releases Official key visual © Kyousuke Motomi / Shogakukan / Dengeki Daisy Production Committee. Official announcement . Release at a glance Japanese premiere January 2027 (exact date TBA) Run Two consecutive cours Studio Studio DEEN Director Souta Ueno Streaming Crunchyroll announced streaming for 2027; regional details may vary When does the Dengeki Daisy anime premiere? The television anime is scheduled to begin broadcasting in Japan in January 2027. The official announcement describes a two-consecutive-cour run, which means the planned broadcast spans two cours in succession. The production has not announced the exact first episode date, a weekly airtime or an episode total. January is the confirmed start window; it should not be presented as a specific day. “Two cours” is a broadcast-format description, not a guaranteed episode count. It tells viewers the planned run continues across two programming blocks, but the official materials do not say whether the anime will use 24 episodes, 26 episodes or another total. The official series website and Aniplex announcement are the sources to check for a later station schedule. Where will Dengeki Daisy stream? Crunchyroll has announced plans to stream the anime in 2027. That announcement does not yet give a launch day or a complete country-by-country list. Japanese television broadcast and international streaming are separate schedules: a Japanese episode time does not automatically establish when it appears in every regional catalog. Viewers outside Japan should check the Crunchyroll listing for their account region once the title page and schedule are available. Subtitle languages, dubbing and same-day availability have not been confirmed in the current announcements. Related reading: I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World Season 2 Sets January 2027 Premiere, Reveals Trailer and Cast . Who voices Teru and Kurosaki? Yoshino Aoyama voices Teru Kurebayashi, and Taku Yashiro plays Tasuku Kurosaki. The announced supporting cast includes Tomokazu Sugita as Souichirou Kurebayashi, Yuka Terasaki as Riko Onizuka, Setsuji Satou as Masuda and Kouhei Amasaki as Akira. These names and roles appear in the official anime materials. The cast announcement identifies the listed characters; it should not be treated as a complete cast list for every person in the manga. Which studio and staff are producing the series? Studio DEEN is producing the television anime. Souta Ueno directs, Sawako Hirabayashi handles series composition, Ayaka Murakami designs the characters, and Masaru Yokoyama composes the music. The production has confirmed these core credits alongside the main promotional video. It has not published a full production schedule or stated how many manga chapters each episode will cover. What is Dengeki Daisy about? Teru Kurebayashi loses her older brother and is left with a phone he gave her. Messages from a mysterious person using the name “Daisy” become a source of comfort. At school, Teru gets pulled into work for Tasuku Kurosaki, a blunt custodian whose actions show more concern than his manner suggests. Their relationship develops alongside questions about Daisy’s identity and the secrets surrounding Teru’s brother. Related reading: MURCIÉLAGO Anime Sets January 2027 Premiere; Cast Announced . The premise combines a school romance with suspense and a mystery about trust. That mix helps explain why the story is not only a “who is Daisy?” puzzle: Teru and Kurosaki’s changing relationship is also central. The official synopsis sets up those elements, but it does not reveal how the anime will adapt the manga’s later turns. This guide avoids spoilers and does not assume that the series will cover every chapter. Is the original manga complete, and where can readers find it? Kyousuke Motomi’s manga ran in Shogakukan’s Betsucomi magazine from 2007 to 2013. Shogakukan lists the completed work in 16 volumes. This gives anime viewers a clear distinction between the source story, which has an ending, and the television adaptation, whose coverage has not been announced. A two-cour plan alone does not confirm whether the anime will adapt the full manga, skip material or use a different ending. Related reading: Now That We Draw Anime Sets January 2027 Premiere . Readers can check Shogakukan’s official volume 16 listing for the completed Japanese edition. The official anime site also links its story, cast and news updates. Availability of the manga in other languages depends on local publishers and retailers; the Japanese publisher listing does not guarantee an English or Spanish edition in every market. Watch the official main trailer The September 19, 2026 announcement introduced the main promotional video and the January 2027 broadcast window. The official video is useful for seeing the anime’s first extended preview, but the announcement does not attach an exact premiere day to it. YouTube’s original upload metadata lists the trailer as published on September 18, 2026, at 8:40:03 p.m. PDT. That is the video’s upload time, one day earlier than the Japanese announcement date. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Main PV 1 Watch the Dengeki Daisy main PV on YouTube · Read the official trailer announcement . What is confirmed so far? Confirmed: a January 2027 start in Japan, a planned two-cour broadcast, Studio DEEN, the announced cast and staff, and a 2027 Crunchyroll streaming plan. Still pending: the exact first-airing date, episode total, station and time, regional streaming calendar, subtitle and dub details, and the manga chapters the anime will cover. Keeping those answers separate makes it easier to spot the difference between an official update and an estimate repeated online. Official sources Dengeki Daisy official anime website · September 19 official key visual and trailer announcement · Crunchyroll's report on the release window and staff . Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases RELEASE DATE October 7, 2026 STREAMING Crunchyroll STUDIO ENGI Release at a glance Release October 7, 2026 Where to watch Crunchyroll in licensed territories Region and timing International simulcast. Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 anime lineup What returning viewers should remember Kimihiko's choices in the sequel follow the discoveries surrounding Siesta and the detective's legacy. The central question is not merely who will solve the next case, but how the characters act after learning what they know. That makes the first season's revelations relevant context, without assuming the second season's mysteries have already been resolved. Why the sequel is not a reset The second season continues a mystery shaped by the events of the first, including the consequences of Siesta's story. New viewers may understand the premise from a synopsis, but the emotional weight of Kimihiko's decisions depends on earlier revelations. For that reason, this is better approached as a direct continuation than as a standalone detective adventure. When does The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2 premiere? Watch the official trailer What is Season 2 about? Season 2 continues Kimihiko Kimizuka’s story after the truth surrounding Siesta’s death has come into focus. The official introduction makes clear that the mystery is not treated as an ending: Kimihiko and the people around him still have to confront what it means to inherit the legendary detective’s will. entries.title: Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING Anime Announced: Official Artwork, Trailer and Release Status
entries.description: Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING will adapt the manga's Volume 27 epilogue. See the October 2026 official announcement, Senku illustration, teaser and unconfirmed release details.
entries.content: OFFICIAL ANIME NEWS · OCTOBER 12, 2026 Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING Anime Announced: Official Artwork, Trailer and Release Status The Kingdom of Science's story is not finished. A newly announced anime will adapt the post-finale “TERRAFORMING” epilogue from Volume 27 of Riichiro Inagaki and Boichi's manga. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official celebratory illustration of Senku by Yuko Iwasa, shared with the October 10 production announcement. © Riichiro Inagaki, Boichi / Shueisha / Dr. STONE Production Committee. Dr. STONE is continuing after the anime finale On October 10, 2026 , the official Dr. STONE website announced that a new anime titled Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING is in production. The news arrived at STONE FES.2026 , after the television series reached its finale on June 25, 2026. Rather than announcing a remake or an unrelated spin-off, the production confirmed a story that continues beyond the original manga's ending. What story will TERRAFORMING adapt? The source material is the “TERRAFORMING” epilogue story in Volume 27 of the original manga by writer Riichiro Inagaki and artist Boichi. That makes the new project an adaptation of material set after the main story. Readers who have only watched the television anime can expect a further chapter of Senku's scientific adventure, but the production has not revealed a detailed episode-by-episode synopsis. Is TERRAFORMING a remake or a continuation? The announcement presents this as a post-finale continuation, rather than a remake of the television series. Its exact format and adaptation structure have not been announced. Related reading: Naruto × Ninkū Anime: Four Episodes, Official Teaser and Release Status . What remains unannounced? The October 10 production notice confirms development and source material but does not provide a premiere date or broadcast and streaming schedule. The announcement trailer should not be treated as evidence of a particular release season. Further production updates are needed before a calendar date can be listed as confirmed. Watch the official announcement trailer The official announcement video looks back at Senku's scientific inventions and includes newly recorded dialogue from the character. The teaser is a production announcement, not proof of a specific release season or format. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Official production announcement Watch the official announcement on YouTube or visit the production's video page . Official artwork: Senku returns Character designer Yuko Iwasa created a celebratory illustration of Senku for the announcement. The artwork is published directly on the anime's official website and is reproduced above with attribution. The production also revealed the Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING title graphic. Official Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING title graphic. Release date, episode count and streaming There is no confirmed premiere date for Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING as of the October 10 announcement. The production has not said whether the adaptation will be a television series, a special episode, an OVA or another format. Its episode count and the staff roster for this specific project also remain unannounced. Crunchyroll currently carries the earlier Dr. STONE anime, but that does not establish streaming rights for TERRAFORMING . No streaming platform should be listed as confirmed until the distributor announces it. What did the manga creators say? In comments published by the official anime website, writer Riichiro Inagaki expressed his excitement that the story continues after the television finale, while illustrator Boichi thanked fans and welcomed the new adaptation. Their statements reinforce that the project is officially in production; neither comment supplied a release date. Is this Dr. STONE Season 5? The production has announced the project under the title Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING , not as a numbered fifth season. Calling it “Season 5” would be premature until an official format and branding announcement is made. Official sources Dr. STONE official announcement (October 10, 2026) · Official teaser video page · Crunchyroll News confirmation . Dragon Ball Super: Beerus revisits established material with added and redrawn footage and a reconstructed narrative, according to the official description. That makes it relevant both to newcomers looking for this version of the story and to returning viewers interested in how familiar scenes have been reworked. The enhanced-edition label alone does not establish that every sequence is new. What the enhanced edition means for viewers The Beerus release is presented as an enhanced edition of the earlier Dragon Ball Super material, rather than a wholly unrelated Dragon Ball storyline. That distinction matters when deciding whether to watch it as a first introduction or revisit familiar events. The Japanese television debut and the shortly later Japanese streaming window are also separate release steps, not contradictory schedules. The official Dragon Ball pre-broadcast guide published October 9 confirms the broadcast time and the first Japanese streaming services. This is the ENHANCED edition of Dragon Ball Super, with newly added and redrawn footage and a reconstructed narrative, according to the official New York Comic Con report . Related reading: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Schedule & Where to Watch . Should returning fans expect an entirely new story? The official description calls Dragon Ball Super: Beerus an enhanced edition with additional and redrawn material and a reconstructed narrative. That signals a revised presentation of familiar events, not a confirmation of an unrelated sequel storyline. Returning viewers may want to compare how the Beerus material is presented, while newcomers can use the edition as an entry point to this part of the franchise. The announcements do not provide a scene-by-scene inventory of what has changed. entries.description: ELECEED premieres in April 2027. Watch the official English trailer and check the confirmed studio, Crunchyroll plans and details still to come.
entries.content: RELEASE NEWS · OCTOBER 21, 2026 ELECEED Anime Release Date: April 2027 and English Trailer ELECEED premieres in April 2027. Watch the official English trailer and check the confirmed studio, Crunchyroll plans and details still to come. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official promotional visual. © Jeho Son·ZHENA | WEBTOON © ELECEED Animation Partners. · Official source Release at a glance Release April 2027; exact premiere day unannounced Streaming Crunchyroll announced; regional catalog details to be checked Animation DandeLion Animation Studio Still to come Episode count, weekly streaming time and English dub schedule Release details checked October 24, 2026 · Official announcement When does the ELECEED anime come out? ELECEED is scheduled for April 2027. The production confirmed that month on October 21, 2026. Its English-language announcement describes a worldwide April premiere, while the Japanese notice confirms the broadcast month. Neither gives an exact first-episode date. April is therefore the useful date to put on a watchlist. It does not mean April 1, and it does not establish a weekday or an episode release hour. Those details need a separate schedule announcement. This guide keeps the month separate from information that has yet to be published. Where will ELECEED stream? Crunchyroll is the previously announced streaming partner. Its distribution announcement is the platform source; the newer production notice supplies the April window. A streaming licence and a dated episode listing answer different questions, so viewers still need their local service schedule before planning an episode-one watch. The English trailer is not an English dub release announcement. No dubbed launch date or English voice cast is established by the October 21 production notices. Likewise, “worldwide” in promotional wording should not be treated as a promise of identical subtitle choices, release hours or catalogue availability in every location. Related reading: ONE PIECE: Elbaph Arc English Dub Release Date and Crunchyroll Schedule . What is ELECEED about? Jiwoo is a young man who hides his remarkable reflexes while quietly helping other people and animals. Taking in an injured cat introduces him to Kayden, a formidable fighter trapped in feline form. Their unlikely household opens the door to a hidden society of people with extraordinary abilities. The appeal of that setup is the mismatch between the pair: Jiwoo's instinct is to help, while Kayden brings experience of a dangerous world that Jiwoo barely understands. The cat is central to their meeting and partnership, rather than an unrelated mascot. Newcomers can approach the series through that relationship without learning the wider cast in advance. Why is Jiwoo called Yu Kazahaya on the anime website? The official English trailer announcement calls the lead Jiwoo, matching the English WEBTOON synopsis. The Japanese anime site lists him as Yu Kazahaya . Readers moving between the two versions should expect different naming conventions rather than mistake the Japanese character listing for a different protagonist or a sequel. For cast searches, use the names printed in the anime's own credits. For the English comic, start with the names on WEBTOON. This also helps avoid attaching a voice actor to a fan-translated character name without an official match. Related reading: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 English Dub Release Date on HIDIVE . Who is in the Japanese cast, and which studio is making it? The official production website lists Junya Enoki as Yu Kazahaya, Tasuku Hatanaka as Jin Tatsuoka, Setsuji Sato as Dr. Delein, Hayato Dojima as Sota Yanagi and Shizuka Ito as Amane Yanagi. Kayden's voice credit remains a question mark on the current site; this guide does not assign an actor to that role. DandeLion Animation Studio produces the anime, with Hiroshi Nishikiori directing, Yousuke Kuroda handling scripts and series composition, and Minami Sakura designing the characters. These are production credits, not a guarantee of how many comic chapters will be adapted. An episode count and adaptation endpoint remain unannounced. Watch the official English-version trailer The production links the video titled “ELECEED | Official Trailer | Part 1 (English ver.)” from its October 21 notice. The original YouTube page records its upload as October 21, 2026, at 02:00:08 PDT (UTC−07:00) , equivalent to 09:00:08 UTC. That timestamp dates the promotional video, not the anime premiere. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER ON YOUTUBE ELECEED official channel Open the official trailer on YouTube . The poster links directly to the original upload, so viewers have a clear destination if embedded playback is unavailable. Where can you read the original ELECEED comic? The English edition is on WEBTOON , credited to writer Jeho Son and artist ZHENA. Use the series page's “First episode” link to start at the beginning; its default list shows recent chapters, which can reveal later developments before a newcomer meets the characters. Reading the comic is optional background, not a prerequisite for watching an adaptation whose episode coverage is still unknown. Anyone wanting to avoid story spoilers can stop after the opening introduction and wait for the anime. Readers continuing further should follow the official episode order rather than guess where a future television season might finish. Is ELECEED a manga adaptation or a webtoon adaptation? The source is a Korean webtoon, presented in English on WEBTOON as an action comic. That is the original reading option linked by the anime production, rather than a novel that viewers need to find first. The Japanese site credits the source writer as SJH, while WEBTOON uses Jeho Son; ZHENA is credited for the artwork on both. Those credit differences can make searches look inconsistent, but the official pages identify the same source work. What should viewers check next? The remaining practical questions are the premiere day, broadcast slot, episode count, local streaming hour and language-track schedule. None is settled by a month-only release notice. We will update the guide when dated production or distributor announcements answer them. For shows with nearer confirmed schedules, use our anime calendar and streaming guide . entries.description: Firefly Wedding premieres October 9, 2026 on Crunchyroll. See the release date, episode schedule, where to watch and confirmed anime details.
entries.content: FALL 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE Firefly Wedding Anime Release Date, Streaming & Where to Watch Firefly Wedding premieres October 9, 2026 on Crunchyroll. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases RELEASE DATE October 9, 2026 STREAMING Crunchyroll Why the premise is more than a romance setup Satoko's proposal is made under immediate threat, which means the relationship begins as a survival decision rather than a conventional courtship. That tension is central to the story's appeal: readers can expect the romance to develop alongside danger and uncertainty. For release planning, the Fuji TV and Crunchyroll times should be read as separate official schedules, not converted into one another. Release date Firefly Wedding premieres October 9, 2026. The Japanese broadcast begins at 11:30 p.m. JST on Fuji TV’s Noitamina block, while Crunchyroll has confirmed streaming in its announced territories as the anime airs. Japanese broadcast vs. Crunchyroll release Fuji TV's Noitamina block lists the Japanese television premiere for 11:30 p.m. JST. Crunchyroll separately announced an October 9 simulcast at 9:00 a.m. PT. These are platform-specific schedules, not interchangeable time-zone conversions; viewers should check their local Crunchyroll catalog for availability. Animation is handled by david production. Is the manga complete, and where can you read it? Yes. Shogakukan released volume 13, the final collected volume of Oreco Tachibana’s manga, on October 19, 2026. The publisher describes it as the story’s conclusion and notes that it includes a side story and a short bonus manga. Readers looking for the complete ending can follow the manga through that volume. The anime’s confirmed cast, broadcast and streaming announcements do not say how much of the source story the television adaptation will cover. Its episode count and adaptation endpoint have not been announced, so the manga’s completion should not be mistaken for confirmation that the anime will adapt all of it. For English-language readers, VIZ’s Shojo Beat edition is still being released in collected volumes. VIZ lists volume 8 for October 13, 2026, and volume 9 as a preorder, so the English schedule trails the completed Japanese edition. Check VIZ’s official series page for current print and digital availability, and Shogakukan’s volume 13 listing for the Japanese finale. Dates and formats can differ by market and retailer. Related reading: Live-Action Firefly Wedding TV Drama Announced for 2027 . What is Firefly Wedding about? The story follows Satoko, a noblewoman in poor health who becomes the target of an assassin. Trying to survive, she makes an extraordinary marriage proposal to Shinpei, turning a kidnapping into a dangerous relationship built around a false wedding and increasingly complicated feelings. Studio and staff david production is producing the anime. Takahiro Kamei directs, Yuko Kakihara handles series composition and scripts, Yukiko Aikei is credited for character designs, and NOGRID composes the music. Where to watch Crunchyroll has announced streaming in its announced territories as the series airs. Catalog availability can still differ by territory, so viewers should check the local Crunchyroll listing near premiere time. You can also browse the AniNextUp streaming hub for other Fall 2026 releases. Official source View the official announcement → AniNextUp: Release dates and streaming availability can vary by region. This guide will be updated when new official information is confirmed. English dub release and cast Crunchyroll announced the English dub on October 22, with weekly episodes beginning Friday, October 23. Its first-episode cast includes Rowan Gilvie as Satoko, Kieran Flitton as Shinpei, Jason Douglas as Mitsueda, Ben Stegmair as Kotaro, R. Bruce Elliott as Jubei, Jordan Colea as Miwako and Chris Rager as Ozoe. These are English-language performance credits; they should be kept separate from the Japanese voice cast listed in the anime’s earlier production announcements. The same Crunchyroll notice names Samantha Herek as producer and Caitlin Glass as voice director. Those credits identify the English dub team, while the Japanese production remains at david production under director Takahiro Kamei. A localized cast announcement does not change the Japanese broadcast schedule or the original-language simulcast date. What time is the simulcast in the Caribbean? The published times convert to different local clocks even though both announcements give October 9. Fuji TV’s 11:30 p.m. JST broadcast corresponds to 10:30 a.m. Atlantic Standard Time (UTC−4) that same day. Crunchyroll’s 9:00 a.m. Pacific Time simulcast corresponds to noon AST for viewers in Puerto Rico or the Dominican Republic, if the series is available in their local catalog. Pacific Time is on daylight saving time (PDT, UTC−7) on October 9, so do not reuse that conversion in winter without checking the offset. The English dub has its own October 23 weekly start; use the episode’s language label to choose the version you want. Source: Crunchyroll’s official English dub cast and schedule announcement . Updated: October 23, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error October 22 cast update The anime’s official social announcement, reported by Crunchyroll on October 22, added Kazuyuki Okitsu to the cast as Eishin Nitobe. This is a supporting-cast update to the series already airing in Japan; it does not change the October 9 premiere date, the listed Fuji TV schedule or the existing streaming announcement. The casting report identifies the performer and character, but does not provide enough detail to infer how many episodes Nitobe will appear in or what role he will play in later story developments. For viewers keeping track of adaptation news, it is useful to separate this update from the manga’s separate live-action drama announcement for 2027. The anime and the planned drama are distinct projects, with separate casts and distribution arrangements. Crunchyroll’s anime coverage cannot be used to infer the drama’s cast, release date or streaming home. We will add those details only when the relevant production or broadcaster confirms them. Source: Crunchyroll’s October 22 cast report . Official trailer ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Crunchyroll Official release time and territories: Crunchyroll October 6 announcement .

entries.title: The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop Anime Premieres January 2027
entries.description: The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop anime premieres in January 2027. See the new teaser, key visual, confirmed cast, studio and where it will air.
entries.content: The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop Anime Premieres January 2027 January 2027 Japanese TV anime. TOKYO MX, MBS, BS11 and project No.9. Exact premiere day, time and international streaming are unannounced. Release at a glance Release window: January 2027. Confirmed Japanese broadcasters: TOKYO MX, MBS and BS11, among others. Studio: project No.9. Exact premiere date and time: not announced. International streaming: not announced as of October 25, 2026. What is The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop about? The series begins ten years after a hero defeats the Demon Lord and peace returns. In Saisho, a former Level 1 village where adventurers once gathered, Murabito has inherited his late father's item shop, Sudachi-ya. With fewer adventurers setting out, the store is nearly empty. Murabito keeps it open while taking odd jobs, convinced it matters because it was the first shop the legendary hero visited. His routine changes when Mao, a mysterious girl with golden eyes, appears. The official introduction identifies those eyes as a trait of the demon race and says meeting her changes Murabito's ordinary life. The key visual and second teaser introduce her as someone who claims to be the Demon Lord defeated ten years earlier. The premise turns a familiar fantasy ending into a new beginning: what does peace mean to a village whose livelihood depended on adventurers, and what should Murabito do when the past returns? Why the item-shop premise matters Many fantasy stories follow the party that leaves town to fight a monster. This one begins with the person who supplied that party and stayed behind. Fewer battles may be good for the world, yet fewer customers threaten a family business and a village's old role. That is an interpretation of the official setup, not a separate plot claim. It explains how the story can mix shopkeeping and comedy with questions about the old conflict without making Murabito a conventional warrior protagonist. Saisho's nickname, the Level 1 village, places it at the beginning of a game-like adventure route. The shop is more than a backdrop for buying equipment: it represents a community trying to adapt after the hero's journey has supposedly ended. The announcement does not reveal how much of the manga the anime will adapt or how many volumes a season may cover. What did the latest anime announcement confirm? The production committee's October 6, 2026 update confirmed a January 2027 broadcast window, released a new key visual and published teaser PV 2. It also announced Yōhei Azakami as Ash, the hero who defeated the Demon Lord and now lives in Saisho. The visual brings Murabito, Mao and Ash together, but does not resolve Mao's claim or name a premiere episode. The announcement listed 13 collected manga volumes as of October 2026 and said volume 14 was scheduled for October 16. That describes the source material's publication, not the anime's episode count. Cast and production staff Reiji Kawashima voices Murabito, Rumi Ōkubo voices Mao and Yōhei Azakami voices Ash. Confirmed core staff are director Jun Hira, series composer Keiichirō Ōchi, character designer Katsuyuki Satō and music composer Takurō Iga. Project No.9 is producing the animation. The official update does not list episode directors or a complete production schedule. Where can viewers watch it? For Japan, the official announcement names TOKYO MX, MBS and BS11, followed by “and other channels.” It does not list broadcast days, start times, simulcast services or catch-up platforms. No international streaming service or territory list has been announced in the official material checked for this update. A Japanese television announcement does not confirm that a particular overseas platform will carry the series. AniNextUp will update this guide if a distributor publishes territories and a streaming date. Does the second teaser give an exact release date? No. The official wording is January 2027: a month, not a calendar day or time. The teaser introduces the three leads and the new cast member, while the official news post supplies network and staff information. Neither confirms an episode count, theme-song lineup or international release schedule. Is there an official trailer? Yes. The official anime site links teaser PV 2, published on October 6, 2026, and the production committee describes it as a preview focused on Murabito, Mao and Ash. The original video page gives its publication time as October 6 at 01:00:13 PDT (UTC−07:00), the same calendar date as the Japanese announcement. The embedded player below uses that official video. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER YouTube · click to play Where to read the source manga The anime adapts Makoto Morishita's manga, serialized in Kodansha's Monthly Shōnen Magazine. Kodansha's K MANGA service carries the English title and provides an official synopsis: peace after the hero's victory leaves Villager's store empty until a mysterious girl arrives. The publisher listing is a direct place to sample the source and check digital availability. Access, pricing and chapter availability can vary by region; the anime announcement does not promise that either title will be available everywhere. What remains unannounced As of October 25, 2026, the exact premiere day, Japanese broadcast times, episode total, opening and ending songs, international streaming partners, dubbed-language plans and regional release dates remain unconfirmed in the official material reviewed. Until a schedule is published, the accurate answer to “When does it come out?” is January 2027 in Japan. Official sources Read the official anime announcement for the window, key visual, Ash casting and PV; see DeNA's production announcement for the premise, network list and staff. Kodansha's K MANGA listing is the authorized English manga source.

entries.title: Fool Night Release Date: November 26 on Netflix
entries.description: Netflix lists Fool Night for November 26, 2026, in the United States and describes the anime as a global Netflix series.
entries.content: NOVEMBER 26 · 2026 Fool Night Release Date: November 26 on Netflix Netflix lists Fool Night for November 26, 2026, in the United States and describes the anime as a global Netflix series. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional visual. Artwork source: official release announcement . WHERE TO WATCH Netflix · global title Release at a glance Release date November 26, 2026 Availability Netflix; release timing may vary by territory Release format Episode release format not announced Studios SUNRISE and SHAFT Checked October 23, 2026 · Official Netflix Media Center listing When does Fool Night release? Netflix Media Center lists November 26, 2026 as the U.S. release date. Netflix describes Fool Night as a global Netflix series, but the sources reviewed do not confirm that every territory launches on that date. What is Fool Night? The series is a dystopian human drama produced by Sunrise and Shaft. Its future world depends on a technology that transforms people into plants as humanity struggles with a shortage of oxygen. Where can you watch it? Netflix is the announced exclusive streaming home. Check your local Netflix title page for language options and release timing. The announcement does not establish a universal hour or an episode count. Related reading: GROTESQQQUE Release Date: November 6 & Netflix Japan Preview . What the announcement means for viewers What the date confirms. The Netflix Media Center lists November 26, 2026 for the United States, and Netflix describes the anime as a global Netflix series. The available announcements do not state whether episodes arrive weekly or together, give a complete episode count, or specify a local release hour. Check the Netflix title page in your region as launch approaches. Worldwide distribution does not mean identical viewing options. The announcement describes an exclusive global Netflix launch, but it does not provide a country-by-country list of audio, subtitles or local release times for this title. Check the title's Netflix listing in your region rather than assuming the same language catalog everywhere. Related reading: November 2026 Anime Releases: Dates & Where to Watch . Why Fool Night stands out The premise turns oxygen into a social and moral dilemma: people may undergo a transformation into plants in a world where humanity relies on the oxygen those plants produce. That setup makes the series more than a conventional post-apocalyptic survival story. Its central question is whether a person's chance to escape suffering can be separated from the needs of the wider community. This is AniNextUp's interpretation of the officially described premise, not an additional plot revelation. What is confirmed and what remains unknown? Confirmed: November 26, 2026; Netflix distribution; November 26 U.S. release date; animation by Sunrise and Shaft. Not specified in the cited announcement: a precise worldwide release hour, a complete episode count, or a full region-by-region subtitle and dub schedule. Official announcement Netflix’s Anime NYC 2026 announcement presents Fool Night as a global Netflix series and includes the official teaser; it does not specify the episode release format. For the rest of the month, see our November anime schedule , which separates streaming premieres from Japanese cinema openings. Related reading: Inherit the Winds Anime: January 2027 Premiere, November Theater Preview and New Visual . Why the premise calls the technology “Transfloration” Netflix’s description gives the story a concrete dilemma. In the future shown in the official synopsis, thick clouds leave Earth in constant winter and darkness, much of its vegetation has died, and the remaining oxygen shortage has reshaped society. Transfloration implants seeds in people near death and turns them into plants. Toshiro Kamiya, a young man struggling with poverty and the cost of caring for his mother, considers becoming a Spiriflor. That choice connects an individual’s suffering to a system that depends on transformed people for oxygen. This context makes the series’ question more specific than “would you become a plant?” The official synopsis frames survival, poverty and the social use of Transfloration as linked parts of the setting. Any moral conclusion about what Toshiro should do is interpretation; Netflix has not published a complete plot summary that answers it. Related reading: Expelled from Paradise Sequel Reveals Main Trailer and Beyond the Night Theme Song . Confirmed production details and what is still missing Netflix Media Center identifies Kasumi Yasuda’s manga as the source and lists SUNRISE and SHAFT as the animation production partners. It also credits director Atsushi Yukawa, series composition writer Jin Tanaka, character designer Robert Sato, sound director Yota Tsuruoka and composer Tatsuya Kato. The Media Center lists November 26, 2026 as the U.S. release date, while Netflix’s Anime NYC announcement presents the title as a global Netflix series. That supports the platform and date, but neither source supplies a local launch hour for every country. Netflix’s listed title page is the place to check local audio, subtitle and maturity-rating details as launch approaches. The sources reviewed here do not give an episode count or confirm whether all installments will arrive at once, so this guide does not promise a batch release. Readers can treat November 26 as the announced launch date and look to Netflix for the episode format and territory-specific catalog information. entries.content: RETURNING SERIES · RELEASE GUIDE Frieren Season 3 Release Date: October 2027 & Golden Land Arc Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End returns for the Golden Land Arc in October 2027. Here is the confirmed Japanese release window, the official visual and the streaming and trailer details still awaiting confirmation. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official Season 3 teaser visual featuring Macht · ©山田鐘人・アベツカサ／小学館／「葬送のフリーレン」製作委員会. Source: official season announcement . Release at a glance Japan release October 2027; exact day TBA Arc Golden Land Arc Japanese broadcast Nippon TV network International streaming Not confirmed in the cited announcement Checked October 18, 2026 · Official Season 3 announcement When will Frieren Season 3 be released? Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 3 is scheduled to begin broadcasting in Japan in October 2027 on the Nippon TV network. The official March 27, 2026 announcement confirms the month and the Golden Land Arc. It does not give an exact day, broadcast hour or episode count. What is the Golden Land Arc? The next season is titled 黄金郷編, commonly rendered in English as the Golden Land Arc. Its announcement spotlights Macht of the Golden Land, described as the last and strongest of the Seven Sages of Destruction. That is the extent of the story detail needed to understand the teaser without discussing later manga events. What is the latest official update? The production began a Season 3 countdown-art campaign on September 26, 2026. Its first illustration, by character designer Keisuke Kojima, features Frieren, Fern and Stark and marks the year remaining until the planned broadcast. The countdown announcement continues to use the October 2027 window. Related reading: ONE PIECE: Elbaph Arc English Dub Release Date and Crunchyroll Schedule . Is there an official Season 3 trailer? The March announcement released the Macht teaser visual shown above. At this guide’s October 18 check, the official video catalog listed earlier-season promotional videos; we could not verify a Season 3 trailer there. This page will add a playable trailer once a season-specific official video is confirmed. Where will Frieren Season 3 stream? The Japanese announcement names Nippon TV’s network for television. It does not establish an international streaming service or a global simulcast timetable. Crunchyroll’s announcement coverage confirms that it carries the first two seasons; that alone is not a Season 3 distribution confirmation. What should viewers know before the new season? Frieren follows an elven mage’s life after the defeat of the Demon King, exploring what her journey with human companions means across different lifespans. The official introduction places Season 3 after the two completed seasons. Viewers catching up can follow those in release order before this continuation. Related reading: Pokémon Horizons Anime Unseals Treasures of Ruin in Latest Wonder Voyage Arc Trailer . Official sources and remaining details This guide brings together the March season announcement , September countdown update and official series introduction . Exact premiere day, international platform, new-season cast and staff announcements, episode count and trailer will be added when confirmed. Browse more returning anime . Why the subtitle matters The official name for the continuation is Season 3: Golden Land Arc . That subtitle identifies the story segment the production has chosen to adapt; it is more specific than saying only that Frieren is coming back. The announcement introduces Macht of the Golden Land as a key character and describes him as the last and strongest of the Seven Sages of Destruction. It confirms that Frieren and her companions will confront him, but it does not reveal the full shape of the season or its episode count. This is an adaptation update, not a new series with an independent starting premise. Viewers who have not finished the earlier seasons may want to catch up before October 2027, but the current notice does not publish a viewing order or streaming plan. The official Japanese broadcast window is the confirmed detail; the international catalog remains a separate announcement to watch for. Related reading: Anime Mysterious Codes (October 2026): New Halloween Codes & How to Redeem . How precise is the October 2027 date? It is a month, not a day. The anime’s official announcement says the third season will air from October 2027 on the Nippon TV network. It supplies no particular Sunday, weekday or time slot. The teaser visual is official artwork for the Golden Land storyline, but it is not a schedule card and cannot be used to infer the exact premiere. The distinction is practical for calendars and reminders. A page that lists “October 2027” should remain month-level until the broadcaster or production committee posts a date. Likewise, an international service should not be named just because it streamed an earlier season; licenses can differ by season and territory. The official site remains the source to revisit for a day, broadcast slot, cast or staff update. We will update those fields when the production confirms them, rather than turning the current window into a more precise claim. entries.title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers: Premiere, Cast, Streaming and Official Trailer
entries.description: The anime premiered October 11. Check Japan’s weekly schedule, international streaming, story, cast, music and the exact official PV upload time.
entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 10, 2026 Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers: Premiere, Cast, Streaming and Official Trailer The anime began airing in Japan on October 11, 2026. Here is the confirmed weekly schedule, where to check streaming, and what viewers should know about the story, cast and PV. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official key visual. ©大崎アイル・オーバーラップ／信者ゼロ製作委員会 RELEASE DATE October 11, 2026 STREAMING Crunchyroll · Select regions STUDIO HORNETS Release at a glance Japanese premiere Sunday, October 11, 2026 · BS Asahi, 11:30 p.m. JST Japanese simulcast d Anime Store, U-NEXT and Anime Hodai at the same weekly time Other regions Crunchyroll lists the series for select territories; local schedules vary Studio HORNETS Checked October 24, 2026 · Official anime site and schedule · Crunchyroll Fall 2026 lineup Has the anime premiered? Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers began its Japanese television and same-time streaming run on Sunday, October 11, 2026. The confirmed first broadcast is BS Asahi at 11:30 p.m. Japan Standard Time (JST). That is 2:30 p.m. UTC on October 11, but it is not a universal streaming time: platforms in other countries publish their own schedules, and the Japanese time should not be mistaken for a local Crunchyroll listing. The official anime site lists a weekly Sunday 11:30 p.m. JST slot for BS Asahi and the Japanese services d Anime Store, U-NEXT and Anime Hodai. Its schedule also lists TOKYO MX from Monday, October 12 at midnight, AT-X from Tuesday, October 13 at 9 p.m., and additional Japanese services from Saturday, October 17 at 11:30 p.m. Those are Japan schedules. Viewers outside Japan should check the title page in their local service account for current territory, subtitle, dub and episode availability. What is the story about? Makoto Takatsuki is a high-school student and avid role-playing-game player who is transported to another world with his class after an accident. The other students receive powerful abilities; Makoto instead gets weak stats and the lowly designation of apprentice mage. He is not introduced as a secretly unbeatable hero. His game knowledge matters because he studies rules, trains patiently and looks for practical uses for limited skills. Related reading: I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World Season 2 Sets January 2027 Premiere, Reveals Trailer and Cast . That changes when Makoto meets Noah, a minor goddess with no believers. She asks him to become her first follower. The official anime site frames the pair's journey as a difficult fantasy adventure: Makoto must survive in a world where faith has consequences, while Noah has her own hidden past. The unusual title is a plot premise, not a claim that the anime is a game adaptation. It is based on Isle Osaki's light novels; the official site separately credits a manga adaptation by Shiroi Hakuto. What does the first episode set up? The official guide calls episode one “Makoto Takatsuki Becomes a Believer.” Its synopsis explains why Makoto is left behind while classmates with stronger gifts are recruited by different countries, and how the overlooked apprentice mage encounters Noah. Episode two moves him to Macallan, where he registers as an adventurer and takes on quests. The third listing introduces Lucy, an elf mage who becomes his first party companion. These summaries help new viewers understand the starting arc without guessing how much of the books the season adapts. Related reading: In a World Full of Zombies Anime: January 2027 Premiere, New Trailer, Cast and Music . The appeal is the contrast between familiar RPG language and a protagonist who cannot solve every problem with a high-level skill. Makoto approaches danger like a player learning a system: observe, test, prepare and combine modest abilities with help from others. Noah's lack of followers gives the goddess a vulnerable position too. Their relationship ties the adventure's progression to trust and cooperation, rather than treating the “zero believers” hook as a one-line joke. Cast, staff and music Sohei Horikane voices Makoto, Ikumi Hasegawa plays Noah, Yukina Shuto is Lucy and Hitomi Sekine is Aya Sasaki. Supporting cast includes Masaaki Mizunaka as Michio Fujiwara, Lynn as Nina, Kensho Ono as Ryosuke Sakurai, Sayumi Suzushiro as Sophia and Rumi Okubo as Marie. The official site lists Toshinori Fukushima as director, Toko Machida for series composition and scripts, Noriko Ito for character design, AstroNoteS for music and HORNETS for animation production. Related reading: Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO: January 2027 Release Date, Trailer and Cast . The opening song is “Mirai no Ashiato” by 310; the ending is “Fall in Dream” by Suupeas. The official music page credits sabio and Akki for writing, composing and arranging the opening, and jon -YAKITORY for the ending. The first PV offers an early listen to “Mirai no Ashiato,” a useful way to hear how the production presents its fantasy adventure. Official trailer and what it confirms The first promotional video is on the Showgate channel, linked as the movie source by the anime's official site. The original YouTube page records its upload as September 29, 2026 at 8:00:13 p.m. PDT (UTC−07:00), or September 30 at 3:00:13 a.m. UTC; it runs 1 minute and 1 second. This is separate from the Crunchyroll article date and Japanese broadcast time. The PV identifies the October 11 start in its title and previews the opening theme, but does not establish episode count, a worldwide launch hour or an English dub schedule. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER ON YOUTUBE Showgate official channel Open the official first PV on YouTube . The thumbnail links directly to its original upload if embedded playback is unavailable. Light novel, manga and anime: which should you start with? J-Novel Club's official English listing describes the novels as the source: Makoto has weak stats, an apprentice-mage class and a ten-year life limit, while Noah's blessing gives him a goal. The listing is useful if you want the longer prose version and volume-by-volume continuation. The manga is a separate adaptation, illustrated by Hakuto Shitori in English publication; it offers a comics format. The anime adds voice performances, music and a weekly schedule. Official materials do not say it covers every novel volume, so do not assume the season completes the story. What has not been confirmed? The official pages reviewed confirm the Japanese schedule, named cast and staff, theme songs and first episode guide. They do not state a total episode count, final broadcast date, or universal international release time. Nor is an English dub schedule announced. Treat service availability shown in your country as the reliable answer rather than converting Japan's slot into a promise for every region. For updates, use the official anime site for broadcast, story, character and music news; its September 4 schedule notice lists the Japanese times. J-Novel Club provides the official English light-novel listing . For international streaming, check the Fall 2026 Crunchyroll lineup and your local catalog.
