entries.title: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends Anime Delayed to 2028: New Cast, Staff and Streaming Details
entries.description: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends anime moves from 2027 to 2028. Find confirmed cast, studio, Crunchyroll streaming plans and the official teaser.
entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 12, 2026 Ghost of Tsushima: Legends Anime Delayed to 2028: New Cast, Staff and Streaming Details The anime adaptation of the supernatural multiplayer mode is now planned for 2028 instead of 2027, with new voice cast and production credits confirmed. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official teaser image from Crunchyroll’s verified anime trailer. © Sony Interactive Entertainment / Ghost of Tsushima production partners. Release at a glance Release 2028; exact date pending Where to watch Crunchyroll exclusive; detailed regional schedule pending Applies to Announced release year Still pending Exact premiere date, episode count and country schedules Release details checked October 23, 2026 · Official source When will the Ghost of Tsushima: Legends anime premiere? The Ghost of Tsushima: Legends anime has been moved to 2028 , replacing the previously announced 2027 release window. Crunchyroll confirmed the revised year during its New York Comic Con 2026 announcements, alongside additional cast and staff. A specific premiere day or month has not been announced. Read Crunchyroll’s official update. The new schedule is a delay of the release window, not a cancellation. The companies have not publicly given a definitive reason for the change. Claims about production trouble, a particular episode count or a precise 2028 launch date would therefore go beyond the confirmed information. Which new voice actors have joined? Mayumi Saco and Shinya Fukumatsu have joined the cast in roles that remain undisclosed. Saco voiced Tomoe in the original Ghost of Tsushima game, while Fukumatsu is known for voicing Bomb in One-Punch Man . Their participation does not establish which characters they will portray in the anime; in particular, Saco's casting should not be taken as confirmation that she will reprise Tomoe. Who is making the anime? Takanobu Mizuno , known for the Star Wars: Visions short “The Duel,” directs the series at animation studio Kamikaze Douga . Gen Urobuchi handles series composition and co-writes the script with Renji Oki . Takashi Okazaki is credited with character design. Newly named staff include Keiji Inai on music, Yoshikazu Iwanami on sound direction, Yasumasa Koyama on sound effects and Gyousyou Suzuki on title calligraphy. The series is produced by HAYATE with Aniplex and PlayStation Productions, while Sony Music participates as music and soundtrack partner. These roles are distinct from the developer of the original game, Sucker Punch Productions. Will Ghost of Tsushima: Legends stream on Crunchyroll? Yes. The series remains announced as a Crunchyroll exclusive . The 2028 release window applies to the anime’s planned premiere, but the platform has not yet provided a complete country-by-country schedule or confirmed the exact release day. Fans should wait for a further streaming announcement before making plans around a specific date. Does the move to 2028 mean cancellation? No cancellation has been announced. Crunchyroll changed the planned release window from 2027 to 2028 and also named more production staff and cast. The official update does not identify a precise 2028 premiere date or give a definitive reason for the schedule change. How does the anime connect to the game? The anime draws on Legends , the cooperative multiplayer experience introduced to Sucker Punch Productions’ Ghost of Tsushima in 2020. That mode emphasizes Japanese folklore, supernatural threats and cooperative combat, rather than simply retelling the main game’s historical storyline. The adaptation’s production team has described the project as a new animated interpretation of that setting. Sony Music, Crunchyroll, Aniplex and PlayStation Productions first announced the anime project in January 2025. The original announcement targeted 2027, making the latest 2028 update a change to a previously public release plan. Read Sony Music’s original announcement. Watch the official Ghost of Tsushima: Legends teaser Crunchyroll published the official teaser on July 9, 2026. YouTube’s original upload metadata lists 5:00:22 p.m. PDT (UTC−07:00). That is the video upload time, not the anime’s premiere time. The teaser predates the October release-window update and should not be described as a newly released 2028 trailer. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER ON YOUTUBE Opens the official Crunchyroll video Watch the official teaser directly on Crunchyroll’s YouTube channel. The official teaser opens on Crunchyroll’s YouTube channel in a new tab. What remains unconfirmed? As of October 23, 2026, the anime has a confirmed 2028 release year, studio, major creative staff, new cast members and streaming partner. An exact premiere date, episode count, full voice-role assignments and detailed international release times have not been published. AniNextUp will update this report when the production partners confirm further details. Sources: Crunchyroll’s October 2026 announcement ; Sony Music’s original 2025 announcement ; official Crunchyroll teaser . Last reviewed October 23, 2026. What does “Legends” mean in the game? PlayStation described Legends as a co-op mode inspired by Japanese mythology. Its launch formats included two-player Story missions and four-player Survival missions, with supernatural twists on combat from the main game. That context explains why the anime can draw on folklore and a team setting instead of simply retelling Jin Sakai’s solo campaign. It does not reveal the anime’s plot: the production has not named its central characters, confirmed an adaptation of a specific mission or said whether it will use the game’s player classes. PlayStation’s description of the mode is useful background, not a synopsis of the anime. Updated: October 23, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.title: Granite Waves Anime: Story, Cast, Episodes & Where to Watch
entries.description: What is Granite Waves? Meet Tezeze’s vertical animated series, its story and cast, the Ryuu release, free pilot episodes and where to watch.
entries.content: RELEASE NEWS · NOW STREAMING Granite Waves Anime: Story, Cast, Episodes & Where to Watch Granite Waves is Tezeze’s creator-led vertical animated series, combining science fantasy, supernatural danger and a heist story in episodes designed for mobile screens. The series launched with Ryuu’s August 25, 2026 premiere. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Published: October 17, 2026 · How we verify releases Official character artwork of Ing. Artwork and character source: Granite Waves official website . Release at a glance Release Ryuu’s platform premiere was August 25, 2026 Format Original vertical animated series made for mobile viewing Creator, showrunner and director Tezeze Where to watch Ryuu website and app Free viewing The pilot episodes are available in the app without a subscription; regular streaming requires a subscription Latest episode schedule Ryuu promotes regular new episodes; a fixed weekly day and time are not listed on its current series page Visit the official Ryuu series page · Ryuu App on the Apple App Store What is Granite Waves? Granite Waves is an original animated series created by Tezeze and produced with Ryuu. Ryuu describes its shows as vertical anime originals: the episodes are composed for full-screen phone viewing in a tall 9:16 format. That makes Granite Waves different from a conventional Japanese television-anime season, even though its creator and platform present it to anime fans. The series is designed around short installments rather than standard 20-minute television episodes. Ryuu’s current page promotes regular episode drops, but it does not give a fixed day and time for every new episode. We will update this guide if the platform publishes a more specific schedule. What is the story about? The official synopsis describes a world where reality begins to break down and people disappear. Elya arrives in an isolated place while trying to make a new start; elsewhere, Zima and Ing attempt a dangerous heist in the Forbidden Places. They are presented as survivors and outcasts whose plans often go wrong. The story blends dark science fantasy, supernatural threats and heist elements. Related reading: Manchuria Opium Squad Anime: Release Date, Story and Latest News . Ryuu’s character material introduces Elya as a scientist, while its series page names the creator-led team behind the production. The official synopsis does not disclose every connection between the characters, so this guide keeps the premise spoiler-light. Granite Waves cast The official series site identifies several voice actors alongside the characters: Related reading: Red Riding Hood: A Detective Story Premieres January 2027 on Crunchyroll . Sarah Natochenny as Elya Peyton Howard as Blacksmith Scotty Morace as Max Bright Douglas as Ing The official site also features additional characters and cast material. We will add more role credits when the production confirms them clearly. Watch the official Granite Waves pilot The first pilot installment is available through the official Granite Waves channel. It is the series’ pilot episode, rather than a trailer for a Japanese television series. ▶ WATCH THE OFFICIAL PILOT Pilot Part 1 · Granite Waves Watch Granite Waves Pilot Part 1 on YouTube → Where can you watch Granite Waves? Granite Waves streams on Ryuu , the platform backing the series. Ryuu says its app is available on the Apple App Store and Google Play, and its FAQ says viewers can download the app for free and watch the pilot episodes before deciding whether to subscribe. The platform directs viewers to its website to start a subscription and stream the regular episode lineup. Availability, subscription prices and payment options can vary by country and can change. Check Ryuu’s official page and your app store listing for the current offer in your region. AniNextUp does not sell access to the series. Is Granite Waves a Japanese anime? Ryuu markets Granite Waves as a vertical anime original, but it is best described editorially as an independent, creator-led animated series made for mobile viewing. It is not presented by its official sources as a conventional Japanese TV-anime adaptation with a Japanese broadcast schedule. This distinction helps explain why searches for an “anime release date” can lead to information about Ryuu’s platform launch instead of a TV premiere. Granite Waves release date and episode status Ryuu’s official subscription page identifies August 25, 2026 as the platform premiere and says new episodes start after that date. The series is now available through Ryuu. Its current official pages promote regular new episodes, while the free app access is specifically described as covering the pilot episodes. We could not confirm a complete public episode-by-episode schedule or a separate international broadcaster. For the latest availability, check the official Granite Waves site and Ryuu . We will distinguish any future episode date from the original platform launch. Official sources and verification Granite Waves official site — series format, synopsis, creator, character pages and voice-actor credits. Ryuu official series page and FAQ — platform premiere, current streaming access, pilot availability and app information. Ryuu App listing on Apple App Store — official app description and featured series. Granite Waves official Instagram — original pilot announcement and series account. Official Granite Waves pilot part 1 on YouTube . Sources checked October 17, 2026. Ryuu labels August 25 as its platform premiere; current public series materials do not provide a fixed release time for each subsequent episode. entries.content: OCTOBER 19, 2026 · MOVIE RELEASE NEWS GROTESQQQUE Release Date: November 6 & Netflix Japan Preview GROTESQQQUE opens in Japanese cinemas on November 6, 2026. Ahead of the film, its 4649GIRL segment will stream on Netflix in Japan for a limited period, October 23–November 5. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional artwork · ©Atsushi Nishigori, CloverWorks/Project GTQ. Source: Aniplex key visual announcement . The GROTESQQQUE release date is November 6, 2026 in Japan. Aniplex announced the opening date with the film's key visual on July 5. The production's website and CloverWorks' film listing also display the November 6 date. This is an original animated anthology, bringing three different stories together in one theatrical project. The October 19 announcement confirms that 4649GIRL (夜露死駆★少女, Yoroshiku Shoujo) will receive a limited advance release on Netflix in Japan from October 23 through November 5. It identifies this as one segment from GROTESQQQUE, ahead of the complete film's theatrical launch. The preview edition also includes a collaboration music video for METALVERSE's opening theme, “Shoot Shoot Shoot.” Sara Minami, who voices Stella, accompanies the announcement with a message about the segment. entries.content: RELEASE NEWS · OCTOBER 24, 2026 Haru to Gen Anime Premieres January 4, 2027: Cast and Teaser Haru to Gen begins on tvk January 4, 2027. See the Japanese broadcast time, confirmed cast, story, official teaser, manga details and streaming status. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official anime key visual. © Yuka Oshima / KADOKAWA / Haru to Gen Production Committee. · Official source Release at a glance Japanese premiere Monday, January 4, 2027 Broadcaster and time tvk / Television Kanagawa, Mondays at 21:55 JST Director / animation cooperation Kodai Sato / Studio Nanahoshi International streaming Not announced in the sources checked Release details checked October 24, 2026 · Official announcement When does Haru to Gen premiere? Haru to Gen premieres in Japan on Monday, January 4, 2027. AnimationID announced the first broadcast date on October 21, alongside the opening of the anime's official website, a teaser and its main cast. The Japanese title is Haru to Gen: 70-sai, Hajimete no Kosodate , a story about beginning childcare at 70. Unlike an announcement that gives only a season or month, this update provides a specific day and a local television slot. Where can you watch it? The confirmed broadcaster is tvk / Television Kanagawa , with episodes scheduled on Mondays at 21:55 Japan Standard Time . That is a Japanese television schedule. It should not be treated as an international streaming launch time. Related reading: The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop Anime Premieres January 2027 . The official site lists its streaming section as coming soon. No international platform or English dub release has been confirmed in the sources checked for this report. Viewers outside Japan should therefore wait for a distribution announcement before assuming the series will appear in their local catalog. What is the story? Gen is a rigid, work-focused man who has lived alone since his marriage ended. At 70, he takes responsibility for his three-year-old granddaughter Haru following the death of his daughter Sakura. Raising a child forces him to confront a family role he neglected earlier in life. Related reading: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival Anime Premieres July 2027 . The premise follows the daily adjustments of two people with very different needs: an older man learning how to care for someone and a small child bringing energy into his isolated routine. The official introduction presents their relationship as a warm family story shaped by loss and a new beginning. Confirmed Japanese voice cast Bin Shimada as Gen. Hiromi Igarashi as Haru. Mayuko Kazama as Sakura. AnimationID says additional cast information will follow. The three names above are the confirmed main roles in the October 21 announcement; they are not an English dub cast. Related reading: Red Riding Hood: A Detective Story Premieres January 2027 on Crunchyroll . Who is making Haru to Gen? The adaptation is based on Yuka Oshima's comic and is directed by Kodai Sato. The official credits list music by bermei.inazawa and animation production cooperation by Studio Nanahoshi, within the AnimationID project. This wording preserves the production roles rather than assigning every part of the adaptation to a single studio. Watch the official teaser AnimationID has released a short promotional video introducing Gen and Haru. The official announcement links directly to the video below; it is a teaser for the adaptation, rather than a full episode. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER AnimationID Watch on YouTube if the player is unavailable. What to check before January The first Japanese broadcast date is established, but international streaming, subtitle languages and dubbing plans still need separate confirmation. The television schedule is also subject to change, as the official site notes. Keep the local Japanese time separate from any future service-specific release time. Official sources and more upcoming anime The date, main cast and teaser come from AnimationID's October 21 announcement . The official anime website provides the story, credits and on-air information. Browse our anime release calendar and latest anime news for other confirmed premieres. Can you read the original manga before the anime? The anime adapts Yuka Oshima’s manga. KADOKAWA’s official listing identifies Volume 1 as a 184-page comic essay released in Japan on March 28, 2024. Its synopsis describes Gen living alone after his divorce before being entrusted with Haru, the young daughter of his estranged child; at 70, he faces parenting for the first time and discovers that daily life with a child is unpredictable. The listing gives readers a route to the source material and explains why the adaptation begins with a family handoff rather than a newborn. It does not confirm how many volumes or chapters the January anime will cover, and this Japanese listing does not establish an English-language edition. See KADOKAWA’s Volume 1 listing . What tone and format should viewers expect? AnimationID’s official website includes comments from the three main voice actors. Bin Shimada, who plays Gen, describes it as a short drama with installments of about three minutes, and says it balances comic childcare mishaps with emotional moments. Hiromi Igarashi describes Haru as energetic and strong-willed; Mayuko Kazama points to the gradual closeness between the two characters. These are performers’ comments, not a full genre label or episode guide, but they offer useful context: the hook is everyday caregiving, with grief and family repair in the background. Treat the approximate runtime as cast commentary; the confirmed program listing still gives the tvk Monday slot and warns that broadcast times can change. It does not supply an international streaming date or a complete episode schedule. Read the official staff and cast comments . Why the age gap matters to the premise The full Japanese subtitle, “70-sai, Hajimete no Kosodate,” points to the central contrast: Gen is beginning childcare at 70, while Haru is three. The official introduction frames this as a family story built around two people adapting to a new routine after Sakura’s death. That description supports a caregiving and second-chance reading, but it does not establish how every family conflict will resolve. The confirmed synopsis is enough to explain the unusual setup without turning it into a promise about later episodes. Updated: October 24, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.title: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion! Release Date & Where to Watch
entries.description: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion! premiered October 5, 2026 on Crunchyroll. Release time, story, cast and staff.
entries.content: PREMIERED OCTOBER 5 · 2026 Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion! Release Date & Where to Watch The fantasy romance began its October 2026 run on Crunchyroll, following Rose, a solitary witch whose longtime crush asks her to brew a love potion for someone else. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases WHERE TO WATCH Crunchyroll Why the potion request drives the romance Rose's task is emotionally complicated because the person requesting the potion is the same knight she has admired for years. Delaying the ingredients becomes a way to prolong their meetings, creating tension between what she has been asked to do and what she actually wants. That makes the premise a character-driven romantic dilemma rather than simply a story about magical recipes. Why the official story calls this a romance beginning with heartbreak The official Japanese introduction explains that Rose believes Harij wants the love potion for someone else. She cannot bring herself to refuse his request, so the time needed to gather ingredients also becomes time she can spend with him. This is the central tension of the announced premise: making the potion would fulfill her professional task while seemingly bringing her own hopes to an end. That is an interpretation of the synopsis, not a claim about how the relationship eventually resolves. Related reading: Love Live! Hasunosora Release Date: January 10, 2027 & Episodes . When did the anime premiere? Episode 1 premiered October 5, 2026. Crunchyroll's Fall 2026 lineup lists the Monday simulcast at 5:30 a.m. PT . Release displays can vary by territory and local time zone. Official main trailer ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER YouTube · click to play What is it about? Rose lives quietly as the Good Witch of the Lake. Her four-year crush on Royal Knight Harij seems doomed when he asks her to make a love potion. Rose agrees, stretching out the ingredient-gathering process so she can spend more time with him, only for their relationship to begin changing in unexpected ways. Why newcomers can start with Episode 1 The series adapts Eiko Mutsuhana's light novels as a new television anime, not a sequel to an earlier animated season. Its central relationship is introduced through Harij's request for a love potion, so viewers do not need previous anime episodes to understand the premise. Cast and staff Mikako Komatsu voices Rose and Yohei Azakami voices Harij. Keizo Kusakawa directs at Diomedéa , Wataru Watari handles series composition, Masakazu Ishikawa handles character design, and Satoshi Matsumura composes the music. Where to watch Crunchyroll lists the series in its Fall 2026 simulcast catalog. Availability can vary by country, so viewers should check the service in their territory. FAQ Is this a sequel? No. It is a new anime adaptation and can be watched from Episode 1. When is Episode 1 available? October 5, 2026. Crunchyroll's Fall 2026 lineup lists Mondays at 5:30 a.m. PT. What genre is it? It is a fantasy romance adapted from Eiko Mutsuhana's novels. Latest update: October 11, 2026. AniNextUp uses confirmed release information and leaves unannounced details pending. What makes Rose and Harij's story different? The central conflict is not whether Rose knows how to make a potion; it is whether she can be honest about her feelings while helping the person she loves pursue someone else. Harij's visits give the two characters opportunities to learn about each other, turning a seemingly straightforward fantasy request into an awkward, slow-building romance. The anime's appeal rests on their conversations and changing relationship rather than a large-scale battle or quest. How to follow the series after the premiere The October 5 date identifies the first episode, not the release date of the entire season. Subsequent episode times should be checked against Crunchyroll's current simulcast calendar, which can display schedules according to a viewer's region. A listing on the Fall 2026 lineup also does not guarantee identical language options or availability in every country. New viewers can begin with Episode 1 without watching an earlier anime installment. Readers interested in the source material can look for Eiko Mutsuhana's original novels; the television adaptation introduces the premise through Rose and Harij rather than assuming viewers already know their relationship. AniNextUp: Streaming availability and displayed release times can vary by region. entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · UPDATED OCTOBER 13, 2026 Hirayasumi Anime: January 2027 Release, Trailer and New Cast Hirayasumi is set for January 2027 on NHK General in Japan. The production announced five additional voice cast members on October 13. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official key visual via the anime production's September 29 announcement ; Hirayasumi anime © Keigo Shinzo / Shogakukan / production committee. Release at a glance Premiere January 2027 (exact day unannounced) Broadcaster NHK General (Japan) Animation Production +h. International streaming Not yet announced Official anime website Release date and broadcaster Hirayasumi is confirmed for January 2027 on NHK General in Japan. The exact day and international streaming platform remain unannounced. What is confirmed about the January 2027 release? The official announcement confirms a January 2027 television broadcast on NHK General in Japan. That is a release month and broadcaster, not a specific episode date or a worldwide streaming agreement. Readers outside Japan should wait for an international distributor announcement before assuming that a local service will carry the series on the same day. What to expect from Hirayasumi Hirayasumi is adapted from Keigo Shinzo's slice-of-life manga, which follows Hiroto and the people around him through everyday encounters and changes in their lives. Its appeal lies in relationships and ordinary routines rather than a tournament or fantasy conflict. The anime's teaser introduces the adaptation, but it does not establish an episode count or confirm how much of the manga will be covered. Official teaser trailer ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER Five new voice cast members announced October 13 The official anime team announced five additional performers: Daisuke Namikawa as Hideki Noguchi, Yoko Hikasa as Yomogi Tachibana, Yume Miyamoto as Akari Yokoyama, Yuichiro Umehara as Ryo Ishikawa, and Yuko Naito as the narrator. See the October 13 official cast announcement . Cast and staff Yuma Uchida voices Hiroto Ikuta, Mayu Takahashi voices Natsumi Kobayashi and Rikako Aikawa voices Hanae Wada. Production +h. animates the series. Kei Suezawa directs and writes the scripts, Naoyuki Asano designs characters, Mika Nishimura is art director and Kaori Sawada composes music. How the preview differs from the premiere The October 7 New York screening was an early preview event, not the start of the Japanese television broadcast or a confirmed worldwide streaming launch. NHK's January 2027 window remains the public broadcast plan, with an exact day and overseas platform still to be announced. What is Hirayasumi about? The story follows carefree Hiroto and his cousin Natsumi as they navigate ordinary life, friendships and family around the house Hiroto inherited from a neighbor. Where to watch NHK General is confirmed in Japan. Streaming platforms and territories outside Japan are not confirmed. FAQ Is the exact January date known? No, only the month is confirmed. Is the trailer official? Yes, the production teaser above is for this adaptation. Is international streaming confirmed? Not yet. Why Hirayasumi is a different kind of anime premiere Rather than following a tournament, fantasy adventure or mystery, Hirayasumi focuses on everyday relationships. Hiroto's relaxed outlook contrasts with the worries of people around him, including his younger cousin Natsumi. Their shared life in a modest house provides the setting for a story about work, friendship, family and the uncertainty of growing up. The adaptation is based on Keigo Shinzo's manga, serialized in Shogakukan's Weekly Big Comic Spirits . Its official introduction places the story in Tokyo neighborhoods including Asagaya and Koenji, with the house Hiroto receives from an older neighbor at the center of the narrative. Sources: VIZ Media anime update and VIZ production announcement (background only; January 2027 broadcast confirmed separately by the official anime site) . October 13 official casting update The October 13 official production announcement identifies five new performers. The release month is unchanged; the announcement does not establish an exact January premiere date or overseas simulcast. Watch the production teaser directly on YouTube if the player is unavailable. entries.content: OCTOBER 10, 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE HORROR COLLECTOR Release Date & Where to Watch HORROR COLLECTOR premieres October 10, 2026. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases RELEASE October 10, 2026 STREAMING Crunchyroll STUDIO Studio Palette What makes the premise distinctive? Rather than introducing a single monster as the central mystery, HORROR COLLECTOR builds its premise around rumors that become tangible. Fushigi’s search provides a continuing thread, while each new legend can raise a different question: who started the rumor, why did it spread, and what happens when people encounter it? This is an interpretation of the announced premise, not a claim about scenes or storylines that have yet to be confirmed. What to check before watching The announced 12-episode run describes the season length; it does not tell viewers how many legends will appear in each installment. Likewise, the October 10 date is the Japanese NHK television premiere, not a universal streaming release time. For a practical viewing plan, check the episode listing in your own Crunchyroll region and distinguish the Japanese broadcast schedule from the platform’s local availability. When does HORROR COLLECTOR premiere? HORROR COLLECTOR premieres October 10, 2026. The Japanese television broadcast begins on NHK General TV, bringing the children's horror novel series to television animation. Where to watch HORROR COLLECTOR is included in Crunchyroll's Fall 2026 international lineup. Streaming availability and exact episode timing can vary by territory, while the Japanese broadcast is handled by NHK. Japan streaming: The official anime website schedules Episode 1 for October 15, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. JST on Japanese services including ABEMA Premium, DMM TV, Hulu, U-NEXT, d Anime Store and FOD Premium. This is separate from the October 10 NHK television premiere and does not establish a Crunchyroll release time outside Japan. See the official Japanese streaming announcement . How many episodes? The first television season is confirmed for 12 episodes . That gives the adaptation a defined single-cour run for its first collection of supernatural stories. What is HORROR COLLECTOR about? Fushigi, a mysterious boy in a red hood, travels from place to place collecting urban legends that have taken physical form. He pursues Himitsu alongside his unusual partner Jimmy as the series explores frightening rumors and phenomena that may be much closer to everyday life than they first appear. How to approach an urban-legend anthology The published premise gives viewers two ways to follow the story: Fushigi's ongoing pursuit of Himitsu and the individual rumors that take physical form. Those are different kinds of narrative questions. The first concerns a continuing character goal; the second concerns the fear attached to a particular legend. This is a reading guide based on the synopsis, not confirmation that each of the 12 episodes will adapt exactly one legend. Opening and ending themes Japanese singer-songwriter Shikao Suga wrote and performs both the opening and ending themes. The official announcement notes his own interest in J-horror and describes the anime as a fusion of urban legends and Japanese horror. Who is making the anime? Studio Palette handles the animation production. AniNextUp will continue tracking the weekly schedule and any regional streaming updates after the October 10 premiere. Viewer guide: The October 10 date refers to the Japanese television premiere on NHK General. The 12-episode count describes the announced first season, not a promise that all episodes are available on launch day. International viewers should check their regional streaming catalog for individual episode availability. AniNextUp: Release times and streaming availability can vary by region. entries.content: ANIME NEWS · OCTOBER 15, 2026 I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World Season 2 Sets January 2027 Premiere, Reveals Trailer and Cast I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World Season 2 starts in January 2027. See the official trailer news, new cast, returning staff and what remains unconfirmed. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · October 15, 2026 · Editorial policy Official Season 2 key visual © Miku, Rein Kuwashima / KADOKAWA / Iseleve 2 Production Committee. Source: official anime website . I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World and Became Unrivaled in the Real World, Too will return for Season 2 in January 2027 , according to the anime's official website. The October 15 announcement also unveiled the first promotional video, a new key visual and two additional cast members. The exact premiere day and international streaming platforms have not yet been announced. When does I Got a Cheat Skill Season 2 release? The confirmed Japanese broadcast and streaming window is January 2027 . This is a month-long release window, not a specific episode premiere date. The official anime website and publisher KADOKAWA both list January 2027. Viewers should wait for an official platform and regional schedule before assuming where the sequel will stream outside Japan. Who are the newly announced voice actors? The October 15 production update names Ikumi Hasegawa as Iris Noublade and Sora Amamiya as Mai Kagurazaka. These additions accompany the first Season 2 PV and key visual. They are casting confirmations, not a complete episode schedule: the official site still identifies January 2027 as the broadcast and streaming window without an exact day or international platform list. Check the official production news. Related reading: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers: Premiere, Cast, Streaming and Official Trailer . Official Season 2 trailer and key visual The production unveiled its first Season 2 promotional video (PV 1) on October 15 alongside the first key visual. You can access both directly through the official Iseleve anime website . Watch the official first promotional video below, or open the original video on YouTube if embedding is unavailable. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Official PV 1 Video and artwork: official production website . New characters and voice actors Two newcomers are now confirmed. Ikumi Hasegawa voices Iris Noublade , a powerful swordswoman known as the Sword Saint. Sora Amamiya voices Mai Kagurazaka , a mysterious shrine maiden from the real world who was summoned to another world and possesses a power to purify evil. The characters expand the story's connection between Yuya's two worlds. The official Season 2 staff and cast page also lists returning leads Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Yuya Tenjo, Akari Kito as Kaori Hojo and Kaori Maeda as Lexia von Arselia. Who is producing Season 2? Shin Itagaki directs the new season, with Hiromi Kimura handling character design and Millepensee returning for animation production. The series adapts the light novels written by Miku and illustrated by Rein Kuwashima. What happens next in Yuya's story? Yuya Tenjo's adventure continues across the real world and a fantasy world. After confronting the Fist Saint, Yuya faces the challenge of mastering new power while the threat of evil continues to spread. The newly introduced Iris and Mai are positioned to play important roles in that conflict, although the production has not yet published a complete episode-by-episode story outline. What is still unconfirmed? As of October 15, 2026, the official announcements do not provide a specific January premiere day, episode count or confirmed international simulcast schedule. We will update this guide when those details are released. entries.content: OFFICIAL ANIME NEWS · OCTOBER 15, 2026 I Lost My Adventurer's License Anime: January 2027 Premiere, Trailer and Cast The fantasy series about Douglas and Rabi is set to begin airing in Japan in January 2027. A new teaser video, promotional visual and the main cast and staff have been announced. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Previously released official announcement artwork featuring Douglas and Rabi, via Comic Natalie . The October 2026 teaser visual is available on the official anime website . © Manimani Ononata / SB Creative / anime production committee. Release at a glance Japanese premiere January 2027; exact date pending Animation studio studio Palette Main cast Hiroki Yasumoto as Douglas; Yuka Iguchi as Rabi Streaming Not officially announced Verified October 15, 2026 against the official anime website . When does I Lost My Adventurer's License premiere? I Lost My Adventurer's License, but It's Fine Because I Have an Adorable Daughter Now is scheduled to premiere on Japanese television in January 2027. The production confirmed the month in its October 15, 2026 update, alongside a teaser visual and promotional video. An exact broadcast day and time have not yet been disclosed. The January announcement gives fans a confirmed seasonal window, but it should not be confused with a specific worldwide streaming launch. The official production has not confirmed an international platform or regional release schedule. Does the January 2027 announcement confirm a worldwide release? No. The production's October 15 teaser confirms a Japanese television premiere window in January 2027, not a global simulcast schedule. A teaser PV and promotional visual show that the adaptation is being promoted, but neither identifies an international streaming service or an exact episode date. Viewers outside Japan should check a future licensed distributor announcement rather than assume the Japanese broadcast date applies to their region. New teaser trailer and visual revealed The October 15 update introduced a teaser PV and a new promotional visual for the TV anime. Both are available from the official production website , which also links to the anime's official X account . Watch the official teaser embedded below rather than fan-edited or unofficial reuploads. The illustration above is from the earlier anime announcement and is labeled accordingly, not presented as the new October key visual. Watch the official January 2027 teaser trailer The production released its first teaser PV on October 15, 2026. Watch the official video below, sourced directly from the anime's production website. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Teaser PV · October 15, 2026 Watch the official teaser on YouTube · Official production announcement . Who voices Douglas and Rabi? Hiroki Yasumoto voices Douglas , a former legendary magician whose declining strength leaves him without his adventurer's license. Yuka Iguchi voices Rabi , a young girl Douglas encounters while wandering. Their developing father-daughter bond is central to the adaptation. Both performers were announced with comments about their characters and the story on October 15. Additional voice cast members have not yet been detailed in the same announcement. Which studio is animating the series? studio Palette is producing the animation. Yuki Inaba directs and also oversees series composition and scripts. Kaori Yoshikawa handles character design and serves as chief animation director. Ohshu and Daiki Okuno compose the music, with SPACE SHOWER MUSIC responsible for music production. What is the anime about? Douglas was once a powerful enhancement magician, but age and changing circumstances cost him his position in the hero's party and ultimately his adventurer's license. After meeting Rabi, a cursed girl with no family to turn to, he begins a new journey with her. The story mixes fantasy quests and travel with everyday moments as Douglas and Rabi gradually grow closer. It adapts the light novel written by Manimani Ononata and illustrated by Fuzichoco, published under SB Creative's GA Novel imprint. A manga adaptation is also available through Square Enix's Manga UP! service. Where can you watch I Lost My Adventurer's License? No international streaming platform has been confirmed in the October 15 announcement. A Japanese television premiere in January 2027 does not automatically establish a Crunchyroll, Netflix or other international release. AniNextUp will update this guide when a distributor announces official availability. Frequently asked questions Is the January 2027 premiere official? Yes. The official anime website lists January 2027 as the Japanese broadcast window. Has an exact release date been announced? No. As of October 15, 2026, only the month and year are confirmed. Who are the lead voice actors? Hiroki Yasumoto plays Douglas and Yuka Iguchi plays Rabi. Is the anime coming to Crunchyroll or Netflix? Neither service has been confirmed for this title in the announcement covered here. entries.content: FALL 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE I'm Looking For a Zombie: Release Date and Streaming I'm Looking For a Zombie premieres October 3, 2026 on Crunchyroll. Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases RELEASE DATE October 3, 2026 STREAMING Crunchyroll STUDIO studio COMET Release at a glance Release October 3, 2026 Where to watch Crunchyroll; Japanese audio and English dub launch together Region and timing Licensed territories; local catalog times vary. Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Official announcement What drives the story beyond zombie survival Aki's search for her missing father gives the journey a personal goal beyond escaping danger. That changes how to approach the series: the ruined city is not only a threat-filled setting but also a place where the characters must follow clues and make decisions about whom to trust. The same-day dub announcement is useful for viewers deciding which language version to follow from the premiere. When does I'm Looking For a Zombie premiere? I'm Looking For a Zombie premieres October 3, 2026. Crunchyroll begins streaming the series alongside its Japanese release, with the first English-dubbed episode also launching the same day. Where to watch Crunchyroll lists availability across North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS and India. Exact release times and language options can differ by territory. What is it about? Aki travels with her friends through a zombie-ravaged city in search of her missing father. The search gives the group a reason to move through dangerous territory instead of simply finding a safe place to wait. The premise leaves the father's whereabouts unresolved, so readers should not treat his fate as confirmed. What makes this zombie story different? The official Japanese anime site places the story thirteen years after the outbreak known as the “Red Day,” when most survivors live in isolated villages. Aki belongs to a generation without memories of the world before the collapse. That detail changes the journey's perspective: the ruined outside world is frightening, but it is also unfamiliar, expansive and sometimes beautiful to the characters. This is AniNextUp's interpretation of the published premise, not a prediction about future episodes. Why Aki's search matters Aki leaves her village with childhood friends Natsuki and Haru to look for her father, later meeting Yu and Sakura. The official introduction frames the adventure as both difficult and enjoyable. Rather than promising uninterrupted horror, the premise combines an unresolved family search with the discovery of a world the younger characters have never known. Viewers interested in character relationships and exploration may therefore find a different emphasis here from a conventional survival-only zombie series. Japanese cast and English dub are separate credits The official Japanese site lists Kyori Nemoto as Aki, Lynn as Natsuki and Toshiya Miyata as Haru. The English dub performers listed below come from Crunchyroll's announcement. These are different language casts; a same-day English dub does not mean that every other language version or local release hour has been confirmed. Is there an English dub? Yes. Crunchyroll confirmed a same-day English dub. Madeline Dorroh voices Aki, with Arianna Contardo as Natsuki, Blythe Melin as Haru, Giselle Fernandez as Yu and Anairis Quiñones as Sakura. Who is making the anime? studio COMET handles the animation. AniNextUp will continue tracking weekly release information and any changes to regional availability during the Fall 2026 season. See the Fall 2026 anime calendar and where-to-watch guide for more releases. entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 14, 2026 In a World Full of Zombies Anime: January 2027 Premiere, New Trailer, Cast and Music A main promotional video and new character voices bring the January 2027 adaptation into clearer focus, but an exact premiere day and international streaming service remain unconfirmed. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official promotional key visual · © Rokuro Uraji / Frontier Works / Zom-Ore Production Committee. Image distributed with the official press announcement. Release at a glance Japan premiere January 2027; exact day TBA Japanese broadcaster AT-X Animation Acca effe × Frontier Engine International streaming Not announced In a World Full of Zombies I'm the Only One Who Doesn't Get Attacked has a new main trailer, an official key visual and two more confirmed Japanese voice actors. Publisher Frontier Works announced the material on October 10, 2026 , giving viewers a fuller picture of the adaptation before its scheduled January 2027 broadcast in Japan. The update does not establish an exact premiere date, an episode count or an international streaming partner. Those details should remain open rather than be inferred from the release month. When does the zombie anime premiere? The official anime website identifies January 2027 on AT-X as the Japanese broadcast window. AT-X is the named Japanese broadcaster, not a guarantee that the show will appear on a particular international service. Neither a precise broadcast day nor a worldwide simulcast schedule is provided in the October 10 production announcement. Related reading: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers: Premiere, Cast, Streaming and Official Trailer . For a calendar reminder, January is currently the most specific defensible date. AniNextUp will add a day and time only after an official schedule is published. Watch the official October 10 main trailer The new promotional video is a main PV , following the earlier teaser. It is hosted on YouTube and linked directly by Frontier Works, rather than uploaded by an unofficial fan channel. The embedded player below opens the publisher-linked trailer. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Official main promotional video Watch the official main PV on YouTube if the embedded player is unavailable. New cast announced for the anime The October announcement adds Rikako Ito as Tokiko Kurose and Marie Miyake as Sayaka Makiura . They join the previously revealed central performers Wataru Kato as Yusuke Takemura and Yuno Azuma as Mitsuki Fujino . Who is making the adaptation? Kazuya Fujishiro directs the television anime, with Yasushi Hirano overseeing series composition. Kayo Shimoyama and Makuto Okimi are credited with scripts, Megumi Ishihara with character design, and ISAO with music. Animation production is credited jointly to Acca effe and Frontier Engine . These roles come from the official Japanese staff listing; they should not be confused with unannounced English dub credits. Opening and ending songs confirmed The opening song is “No Reaction” by Retbear , featuring the anonymously credited vocalist unknown Vo: 0in . Retbear is a music project associated with producer Kairiki Bear. The ending is “Tsukikage” by the performance group Itsuka Saisei . Both songs were announced alongside the new trailer. Their inclusion in the publicity package is confirmed; a full soundtrack release date was not supplied in the sources reviewed for this guide. What is the story about? Yusuke Takemura discovers that a zombie outbreak has devastated the world around him. Unlike other survivors, however, he appears not to attract attacks from the infected. That unusual advantage changes the usual survival-horror premise: instead of simply fleeing danger, Yusuke must decide what to do with his relative freedom while other people remain at risk. The story originated in novels by Rokuro Uraji , illustrated by Saburo , and also has a manga adaptation drawn by Chihiro Masuda . Official promotional material presents the series as a darker, adult-oriented zombie action story; viewers should not assume it follows the tone of a conventional all-ages adventure. What the new key visual confirms—and why it is not reproduced here An original production key visual was released on October 10 and can be viewed on the official anime website . Its provenance is verified, but a publicly displayed image is not automatically licensed for republication. Until explicit permission or an applicable reuse license is established, AniNextUp is withholding the cover rather than substituting generated artwork, a homemade SVG or an unrelated thumbnail. Copyright attribution supplied by the rights holder: © Rokuro Uraji / Frontier Works / Zom-Ore Production Committee . Attribution does not itself grant permission to reproduce the artwork. Why the protagonist's immunity changes the premise The official synopsis describes Yusuke as someone zombies do not attack while other survivors remain vulnerable. This changes a familiar survival-horror expectation: his challenge is not simply escaping the infected, but navigating a crisis that affects other people differently. That is an interpretation of the premise, not confirmation of how he uses the advantage or who survives. Where can viewers watch it outside Japan? The confirmed broadcaster is AT-X in Japan. No international streaming platform, territory list or local release time is established by the October 10 official announcement. Even though some anime news outlets cover the project, their reporting does not by itself constitute a streaming license announcement. What should fans watch for next? The next material update would be an exact Japanese premiere day, additional broadcast or streaming arrangements, an episode count or new production announcements. If those details emerge, this article should be updated at the same URL rather than creating a duplicate news page. For confirmed schedules and other upcoming titles, browse AniNextUp's anime release calendar , latest anime news and The Fable Season 2 January 2027 guide . Soji Okita calls him Jinsuke Tachikawa, setting him on a path alongside the swordsmen who will become the Shinsengumi. As political turmoil intensifies, Jinsuke's lost memories become central to the story. Japanese late-night schedules sometimes write this as Thursday at 24:26; it is the same slot as Friday at 12:26 a.m. by calendar time. The official website lists the broadcast date and time, but its streaming section currently says “Coming soon.” No international platform or regional streaming date has been confirmed there. What is the anime about? English-language sources use both Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san? and the earlier rendering Are You a Jirai Girl, Chihara-san? . The English manga publisher Seven Seas uses the Landmine title; earlier anime coverage used the Jirai Girl rendering. AniNextUp keeps both names here to make the series easier to find. Related reading: Takopi's Original Sin: Thank You, See You Tomorrow Release Date . The story follows high-school student Kuroki, who is seated next to Mai Chihara at the start of a new school term. Rumors and Chihara’s dark “jirai-kei” fashion make her seem intimidating. As Kuroki gets to know her, he finds that the girl behind the reputation is more unexpected—and often more awkward—than the rumors suggest. The official site describes it as a school comedy about the classmates’ changing impressions of each other. Cast and staff The official cast includes Sayumi Suzushiro as Mai Chihara , Kazuki Ura as Kuroki , Maaya Uchida as Chinatsu Iwakura , Tomokazu Sugita as Hibiya and Daisuke Ono as Kazami . Yasuaki Fujii directs, Keiichiro Ochi handles series composition, and SynergySP produces the animation. Related reading: Walking Home with You Anime . Watch the official teaser The production’s teaser PV is available from the anime’s official channels. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER January 2027 TV anime Watch the teaser on YouTube · Official anime website and broadcast details . What is still unconfirmed? The Japanese premiere date and time are confirmed. An international streaming service and regional availability have not been announced on the official site. AniNextUp will update this page when the production or a licensed distributor confirms more. Explore more confirmed anime news and track scheduled premieres in the AniNextUp release calendar . How to read the Japanese broadcast time The official website lists January 7, 2027 at 0:26 and names the MBS/TBS network of 28 stations. In Japan, programs after midnight are often described as a late-night slot attached to the preceding evening, which can make listings look like they disagree by one date. For a calendar entry using the civil date and clock time, the official page’s notation is January 7 at 00:26 JST. Viewers outside Japan should convert that timestamp to their own time zone rather than copying a “late night” label as a local date. The site currently marks streaming information as coming soon. That is a real boundary on what this guide can promise: the Japanese television schedule is confirmed, while no international platform or regional release time has been named in the source reviewed here. A broadcaster’s 28-station network also does not mean the show is automatically available on a streaming service in those same markets. What makes Mai and Kuroki’s dynamic the hook The official synopsis begins with a class change and a seat beside Mai Chihara, whose appearance has made classmates call her dangerous. Kuroki’s first impression changes as he sees that her reserved look hides a more open, unpredictable and sometimes clumsy personality. The comedy grows from the distance between a rumor and the person sitting next to him, with their ordinary pauses and conversations doing as much work as the bigger gags. The official cast and staff page names Sayumi Suzushiro as Mai and Kazuki Ura as Kuroki; it also credits SynergySP for animation. Those details let readers identify the announced production without inventing a studio or character dynamic from fan assumptions. The official Japanese title, Jirai Nan Desu ka? Chihara-san , and the English publisher’s “Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san?” are both useful search terms. International streaming, an English dub and a regional premiere time remain unconfirmed. entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 12, 2026 Kagurabachi Episodes 1–2 to Premiere March 25, 2027: World Tour Finale Details The anime’s Japan finale will screen two complete episodes before its April 2027 television debut. Here are the confirmed dates, venues and remaining unknowns. By AniNextUp Editorial Team Official Kagurabachi anime promotional art published by Japan Expo for the world tour. © Takeru Hokazono/SHUEISHA, Project Kagurabachi. Release at a glance Release March 25, 2027: episodes 1–2 advance screening Where to watch Kabukiza Theatre, Tokyo; Japanese cinema live screenings planned Applies to Japan event, not worldwide streaming premiere Still pending Start time, participating cinemas and tickets Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Official source When do Kagurabachi episodes 1 and 2 premiere? Kagurabachi will hold the world premiere of its first two complete TV anime episodes on Thursday, March 25, 2027 , at the Kabukiza Theatre in Ginza, Tokyo. The event concludes the production’s international anime world tour. Japanese cinemas will also host live screenings of the finale, allowing audiences beyond the Tokyo venue to see the episodes and the accompanying stage presentation. The official announcement, dated October 12, 2026, confirms the screening date but does not yet specify the starting time, participating cinemas or ticket-sale schedule . Those details will be announced separately. The March event is an advance screening, not the start of the regular television broadcast. Read the anime’s official announcement. Can fans watch the March 25 screening online? The official event announcement confirms a March 25, 2027 Kabukiza screening of Episodes 1 and 2 and a live relay to participating Japanese cinemas. It does not announce a public internet livestream or a worldwide online premiere. The regular anime simulcast is separately scheduled for April 2027 on Crunchyroll. See the official simulcast confirmation. Related reading: Prisma Illya FINALE: 2027 Release, Cast & Broadcast Update . What happens at the Japan world tour finale? The Tokyo finale combines the two-episode premiere with an onstage discussion. Announced guests include Taihi Kimura, who voices Chihiro Rokuhira; Tomokazu Seki, who plays Kunishige Rokuhira; and Katsuyuki Konishi, who voices Togo Shiba. The venue is the Kabukiza Theatre, at 4-12-15 Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo. The expansion from an early 20-minute preview to two full episodes is the key change in this announcement. Earlier tour stops offered a glimpse of the first episode, whereas the finale will let attendees see how the adaptation opens across its first two installments. No public online simulcast of the Tokyo event has been confirmed. Singapore, Seoul and Brazil: world tour Part 3 dates Before the finale, three more destinations will screen the opening 20 minutes of episode 1 . These are previews, not screenings of the complete two-episode premiere: Related reading: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers: Premiere, Cast, Streaming and Official Trailer . Singapore — November 29, 2026: Anime Festival Asia at Suntec Singapore Convention & Exhibition Centre, 4–5 p.m. Singapore time. Taihi Kimura and animation producer Kan Mizoguchi are scheduled to appear. Seoul — December 6, 2026: a preview and cast/staff event, with the venue and start time still unannounced. Kimura and Mizoguchi are listed as guests. São Paulo — December 2026: a preview at CCXP Brazil. The specific day and time have not yet been confirmed. The distinctions matter for fans searching for premiere dates: the Singapore, Seoul and São Paulo appearances feature only part of episode 1, while the March 2027 Tokyo finale features both full episodes. See the official world tour schedule for later updates. Is Kagurabachi still coming in April 2027? Yes. The regular TV anime broadcast and streaming launch remain scheduled for April 2027 . The production lists Crunchyroll, MUSE and SMG Holdings among its distribution partners, but this announcement does not provide an exact April premiere day, episode release times or a complete territory-by-territory streaming schedule. The March 25 screening should not be mistaken for a worldwide streaming release. Related reading: I Got a Cheat Skill in Another World Season 2 Sets January 2027 Premiere, Reveals Trailer and Cast . The adaptation is produced by Cypic , directed by Tetsuya Takeuchi, with character designs by Keigo Sasaki. It adapts Takeru Hokazono’s Weekly Shonen Jump manga about Chihiro Rokuhira, a young swordsman pursuing the group responsible for his father’s death and the theft of powerful enchanted blades. The production has also shared a commemorative illustration by Takeuchi marking the manga’s third anniversary; that illustration is separate from the world tour event art. Watch the official Kagurabachi anime teaser The English-language teaser released by CyberAgent ANIME Global introduces the anime’s visual style and April 2027 broadcast window. It is an earlier official teaser, not a new October 12 trailer . ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER Watch the official teaser on YouTube. The embedded player loads only when selected. What fans should watch for next The most important remaining announcements are ticket details for the March 25 Japan premiere, the Seoul venue, the exact CCXP Brazil screening date, and the April 2027 TV premiere day. None should be treated as confirmed until the organizers publish them. For other announced releases, see AniNextUp’s anime release calendar and latest anime news . Sources: Kagurabachi official October 12 announcement , Japan finale details , official anime site and CyberAgent’s announcement . Reviewed October 12, 2026. entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 14, 2026 The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All Anime: January 8, 2027 Premiere and Trailer The music-centered romance anime has a confirmed Japanese premiere date, a new promotional video and an expanded Japanese voice cast. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official anime promotional video thumbnail via the production trailer . © Sumiko Arai / KADOKAWA / Kinioto Production Committee. Release at a glance Japan premiere January 8, 2027, 11 p.m. JST Studio CloverWorks Broadcaster Nippon TV Streaming Crunchyroll (regional schedule pending) The upcoming adaptation of Sumiko Arai's music-centered romance now has a precise Japanese premiere date, a new full promotional video and an expanded voice cast. Here is what the official announcements establish, and what viewers still need to know before January. When is the anime release date? The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All premieres in Japan on Friday, January 8, 2027. The official anime website lists weekly broadcasts at 11 p.m. Japan Standard Time. This is a new level of precision compared with the earlier January 2027 premiere window announced in July. A Japanese television debut is not necessarily an international streaming time. Crunchyroll has announced that it will carry the series, but the sources reviewed for this article do not confirm exact local release times or a complete list of territories. Those details should be checked closer to launch. Is January 8 the Crunchyroll release date everywhere? No. January 8, 2027 at 11 p.m. JST is the Japanese Nippon TV broadcast time confirmed by the anime production. Crunchyroll has announced that it will stream the series, but the sources cited here do not establish an identical release hour in every country. The Japanese television schedule and the international platform's local availability are two separate details. Related reading: The True Saint Was Banished Anime: January 2027 & Trailer . What is the anime about? Aya Osawa is a high school student who loves rock music. She meets a stylish employee at a CD shop and becomes fascinated by their shared musical taste. The employee is Mitsuki Koga, Aya's quiet female classmate, though Aya does not initially recognize that connection. The central drama comes from the contrast between Mitsuki's two environments: a reserved student at school and a more confident presence among records. Music provides a way for the characters to connect even when they struggle to express their feelings directly. Watch the official first trailer The first full promotional video, released in October, previews the characters' performances and the soundtrack. It is distinct from the earlier teaser released in July. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Official promotional video Watch the official first PV on YouTube → Who is in the cast? Mariya Ise voices Mitsuki Koga and Akari Kito voices Aya Osawa. The October announcement added five Japanese voice actors: Kenjiro Tsuda as Joe, Tasuku Hatanaka as Megumu Narita, Yurina Amami as Chizuru, Fairouz Ai as Mao and Maiko Nomura as Kanna. The reviewed announcements do not confirm an English-language dub cast. Japanese casting should not be presented as an international dub lineup. Studio, director and music Masashi Ishihama directs the series at CloverWorks. Rino Yamasaki handles series composition and Kanna Hirayama designs the characters. Kousuke Noma and Takayuki “Kojiro” Sasaki are credited with the music featured in the new PV. The opening theme previously announced for the anime is “Breed” by Nirvana. Its inclusion fits a story whose relationship begins with a shared love of rock. Music is central to the characters' identity, rather than merely background atmosphere. Where can fans watch it? Nippon TV is the confirmed Japanese broadcaster. Crunchyroll has announced streaming plans for 2027. Exact international release hours, territory-by-territory availability and episode count remain unconfirmed in the sources reviewed here. What information is still missing? Future updates should focus on the precise simulcast schedule, possible dub announcements, episode count and new official promotional material. Any verified changes should be added to this guide instead of creating a second article about the same facts. Readers can explore the anime calendar , news section and The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 on AniNextUp. entries.title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
entries.description: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life premieres October 6, 2026 on Crunchyroll. Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026.
entries.content: FALL 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life premieres October 6, 2026 on Crunchyroll. Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional visual. Artwork source: official release announcement . RELEASE DATE October 6, 2026 STREAMING Crunchyroll STUDIO P.A.Works Release at a glance Release October 6, 2026 Where to watch Crunchyroll; Japanese audio and English dub launch together Region and timing Licensed territories; local catalog times vary. Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Crunchyroll’s English dub announcement What makes Rein's comeback different Rein's strength is tied to the enchantments he already contributed to his former guild. Reclaiming those bonuses exposes how much of the group's success depended on work they undervalued. The premise turns a dismissal into a question about credit and dependence, rather than relying only on a sudden discovery of unrelated powers. Why the support-magic premise stands out Rein's value comes from the enchantments he has already provided to other people, not from suddenly discovering a completely unrelated combat talent. The dismissal exposes how dependent his former guild was on work it failed to appreciate. That gives the story a clear reversal of power and makes it especially relevant to viewers interested in fantasy about overlooked support roles. When does The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage premiere? The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life premieres October 6, 2026. Crunchyroll carries the series as part of its Fall 2026 lineup in supported international territories. What is the anime about? Rein is an Enchanter whose support magic strengthens weapons and armor. After his guild decides his work is no longer necessary and fires him, he recalls the enchantments he previously placed on their equipment and takes those accumulated bonus points back for himself. That unusual mechanic transforms a discarded support character into someone with enormous potential. Rather than joining another elite party immediately, Rein begins again with basic clothes and a copper sword, turning the premise into a second-chance fantasy adventure. How to choose between subbed and dubbed viewing Crunchyroll's English dub announcement establishes a same-day dub launch for the premiere. That is useful if you prefer English audio from the beginning, but it does not establish that every future dubbed episode will arrive at an identical local hour or that every language option is available in every country. The episode's audio selector in your local catalog remains the practical check. Where to watch Crunchyroll lists the anime for North America, Central and South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS and Southeast Asia. Exact release times can vary by region. Watch the official teaser Crunchyroll published promotional footage ahead of the October premiere and confirmed a same-day English dub for October 6, alongside the Japanese-language release. See the Fall 2026 anime calendar for more confirmed October releases. The mechanic behind Rein’s second chance The official series description makes Rein’s support role central to the setup. He is an Enchanter whose work strengthens the weapons and armor of his guildmates. When the party dismisses him, he remembers that those enchantments have accumulated bonus points and takes them back. That premise ties his comeback to work the guild had already benefited from, rather than a sudden unrelated power that appears after he is fired. It is also why “support mage” is a more useful description than calling Rein weak. His contribution was embedded in the party’s equipment; the guild’s mistake was treating a less visible role as disposable. The story turns that imbalance into a fantasy progression hook. This is a reading of the published premise, not a promise that the series will provide a real-world blueprint for workplace disputes. What the dub announcement confirms Crunchyroll’s October 5 announcement says the English dub launches on the same date as the Japanese premiere, October 6. This is helpful for viewers who prefer English audio from episode one. It does not establish that each later dubbed episode will arrive at the exact same hour as the Japanese stream, or that every audio and subtitle combination appears in every market. The original October 6 premiere has now passed, so the calendar date is a reference point for catching up. Crunchyroll’s live series page is the better check for the newest episode and the options available to a specific account. The seasonal lineup confirms Crunchyroll as the announced international service, while the production and publisher pages provide the character and ability descriptions. Readers should keep those separate: one source explains where to watch, another explains the world and characters, and neither should be used to infer an unannounced episode count. Studio and director Studio La Cachette; Ulysse Malassagne Details checked October 13, 2026 · Official Toei Animation announcement Season 2's final trailer arrives before Halloween Le Collège Noir returns for its second season on October 31, 2026 , and Toei Animation has shared a final trailer ahead of the premiere. The French supernatural animated series is created by Ulysse Malassagne and produced by Studio La Cachette in co-production with Toei Animation. The Halloween launch date was announced before the October 13 trailer update, so the new video—not the date alone—is the central news in this report. Does the final trailer announce a new release date? No. The October 13 trailer is a promotional update ahead of the already announced October 31, 2026 Season 2 launch. It provides a new preview of the supernatural story, not a separate premiere or an additional season announcement. Viewers should consult the distributor's regional listing for the local streaming time and language options rather than infer them from the trailer's publication date. Related reading: Bless Anime Reveals Koki Uchiyama as Akiharu Nakano Ahead of January 2027 Premiere . Watch the official Le Collège Noir Season 2 trailer The player below uses the final trailer published by Toei Animation Europe and linked in its October 13 announcement. The preview artwork is the official season-two visual from ADN. Video availability may vary by region. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Toei Animation Watch the trailer on YouTube if the embedded player is unavailable. When does Le Collège Noir Season 2 come out? The confirmed French premiere is Saturday, October 31, 2026 . ADN lists the season for that date, and Toei Animation's announcement independently confirms it. Neither of these October 13 announcements establishes a precise time of day, so no release hour should be assumed. Where can viewers stream Season 2? ADN is the confirmed French streaming home. Toei Animation also identifies RTS for Switzerland and says Peppermint Anime has licensed the show for German-speaking territories, including Germany, Austria, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, German-speaking Switzerland and South Tyrol in Italy. A license announcement does not by itself confirm a streaming platform or simultaneous October 31 launch in each territory. An English-language streaming release has not been confirmed in these announcements. What is Le Collège Noir about? Based on Malassagne's French comic, the story follows five young students at an isolated boarding school in the Cantal mountains. A supernatural encounter involving a missing classmate draws them into mysteries rooted in French folklore, including frightening creatures and an ancient curse. Season two continues the show's blend of mystery, fantasy and eerie adventure; specific new plot turns should not be treated as confirmed without further official details. Who is making Season 2? Ulysse Malassagne created the property and directs the animated adaptation. Studio La Cachette produces the animation, with Toei Animation involved as a co-production partner. ADN lists French as the original audio language. Toei Animation confirms six episodes per season, and France Télévisions lists Season 2 as six 15-minute episodes. What remains unannounced? The October 13 sources do not establish a global English-language streaming platform, an international release timetable or a universal launch hour. AniNextUp will update this report if the rights holders publish those details. Official sources Toei Animation — October 13 season-two final trailer and distribution announcement ; ADN — October 13 trailer and French premiere details ; Toei Animation — earlier renewal announcement ; France Télévisions — Season 2 format ; Toei Animation — six episodes per season . entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · 2026-10-09 Live-Action Firefly Wedding TV Drama Announced for 2027 Firefly Wedding, the historical romance manga by Oreco Tachibana, will receive a live-action Fuji TV drama in Japan in 2027; casting and a precise premiere date remain unannounced. By AniNextUp Editorial Team Firefly Wedding is getting a live-action television drama Firefly Wedding will be adapted into a live-action Japanese television drama scheduled for 2027. The adaptation is planned to air on Fuji TV, adding another screen version of Oreco Tachibana's historical romance manga. The announcement was reported on October 9, 2026, as the television anime adaptation made its debut. What has been confirmed about the 2027 drama? The broadcaster and planned year are confirmed, but the announcement did not specify a premiere day, episode count, director or cast. Those details are expected to be revealed later. A promotional announcement video accompanied the news, although access to the video is restricted in some regions; readers can find the source coverage linked below rather than an unverified embedded player. How the drama relates to the anime and manga The upcoming live-action drama is a separate adaptation of the manga, not a second season of the anime. The animated Firefly Wedding series premiered in Japan in October 2026 on Fuji TV's Noitamina programming block, with Crunchyroll carrying the anime for streaming. Both adaptations draw from the original manga, which was created by Oreco Tachibana and published through Shogakukan's MangaONE and Ura Sunday platforms. What is Firefly Wedding about? The story follows Satoko Kirigaya, a young woman from a prominent family who becomes entangled with the assassin Shinpei Goto. Their dangerous arrangement develops into an unconventional romance against a historical Japanese backdrop. The premise makes the story particularly suited to a live-action interpretation, but no specific casting choices or creative changes have been announced for the drama. Does the anime's streaming deal also cover the drama? No such connection is confirmed. The 2027 Fuji TV live-action drama and the October 2026 anime are separate adaptations of Oreco Tachibana's manga. Crunchyroll's availability for the animated series does not establish distribution rights for the live-action production. A premiere month, cast and international streaming service for the drama remain unannounced in the cited broadcaster report. Related reading: Firefly Wedding Anime Release Date, Streaming & Where to Watch . What viewers should not confuse The 2027 Fuji TV drama announcement is separate from the October 2026 anime premiere. A confirmed Japanese broadcaster does not by itself establish international streaming rights for the drama, even though the anime has its own distribution arrangements. Where to follow the announcement For confirmed developments, consult Crunchyroll's announcement and ORICON's report . The announced 2027 broadcast window does not establish a specific premiere month, day or international streaming platform. Those details remain unconfirmed. Explore the anime release calendar and latest news . Primary broadcaster announcement: Fuji TV, updated October 10 in Japan: 2027 drama, original manga and anime premiere . The October 9 date above refers to Crunchyroll’s coverage. Updated: October 16, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error
