entries.content: Home › News › Love Live! Hasunosora Release Guide OCTOBER 20, 2026 · NEW ANIME Love Live! Hasunosora Release Date: January 10, 2027 & Episodes Love Live! Hasunosora Girls’ High School Idol Club begins its seven-episode TV anime on January 10, 2027. The Japanese schedule is confirmed, while an international streaming service remains unannounced in the sources below. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official TV anime key visual · ©2026 Project Love Live! Hasunosora Girls’ High School Idol Club. Source: Bandai Namco Filmworks / V-STORAGE . Release at a glance Premiere January 10, 2027 · Japan First broadcast TOKYO MX · Sundays at 22:30 JST Episodes 7 · 106th-class April–June story Animation / planning Sublimation / Sunrise International streaming Not yet announced in the cited sources Verified October 25, 2026 · Official broadcast schedule When does the Love Live! Hasunosora anime come out? The Japanese premiere is January 10, 2027. TOKYO MX starts the series at 22:30 JST on Sundays. Sun TV lists 23:30 the same evening. BS11 lists “January 10 at 24:30,” which means Monday, January 11 at 00:30 on a standard calendar. Japanese schedules sometimes use times above 24:00 to keep a late-night program attached to the previous evening. The official schedule also names these stations. All times below are JST: KBS Kyoto: Sundays at 24:00 from January 10 (Monday, January 11 at 00:00). TV Aichi and RKB Mainichi Broadcasting: Sundays at 25:20 from January 10 (Monday at 01:20). Shizuoka Broadcasting: Sundays at 25:50 from January 10 (Monday at 01:50). Hokkaido Broadcasting: Mondays at 25:29 from January 11 (Tuesday, January 12 at 01:29). Hokuriku Broadcasting: Sundays at 16:00 from January 17. These are Japanese television times, not an international streaming timetable. The official notice says broadcast times can change, so check local listings near the premiere. Related reading: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion! Release Date & Where to Watch . How many episodes will there be? The official schedule lists seven episodes , covering April through June of the project’s 106th-class story. Those months describe events within the story; they are not an April-to-June broadcast window. The announcement does not give a dated episode calendar, runtimes, or a finale date. The short episode count confirms the season’s scope, but it is not enough to calculate the final broadcast date. Where can you watch Hasunosora outside Japan? No international streaming platform is identified in the official release information cited here. The confirmed outlets are Japanese broadcasters. Check back for a distributor announcement before assuming that Crunchyroll, Netflix or another service will carry the series in your country. Dub and subtitle availability also remain unconfirmed. Related reading: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Is Out on Netflix: Episodes & Trailer . What is the story about? The setting is the private Hasunosora Girls’ High School in Kanazawa, Ishikawa. The official introduction describes a girl once known for her smile arriving with spring. New meetings and partings bring the girls' pasts into their present, as they pursue the changes they hope to make in themselves. The school-idol setting ties music and shared ambitions to everyday school life. For newcomers, the useful distinction is that this announcement concerns the television series. The broader Hasunosora project also includes music, live performances and other animation, so a film screening or concert date should be checked separately. Bandai Namco Filmworks separately notes that the Hasunosora theatrical film Bloom Garden Party opened in May 2026. The film and this TV anime are distinct releases within the same project. The cited announcements do not say that the film is required viewing before the January series, so a watch order should not be assumed. Related reading: The Detective Is Already Dead Season 2: Release Date, Episodes & Where to Watch . Cast and animation staff The newly introduced students include Maika Kinjo, Aoi Reisawa and Mion Shinowa. Their Japanese cast members are 星宮じゅりあ, 朝陽花菜 and 湯浅かなえ, respectively. The official credits also list returning club members and their performers. The announcement also names Haruna Sakurai as Ginko Momose, Fuka Hayama as Kosuzu Kachimachi, Rin Kurusu as Hime Anyoji, Miu Miyake as Ceras Yanagida Lilienfeld, and Amane Shindo as Izumi Katsuragi. Together with the three new students, these are the Japanese cast members identified in the release. Related reading: Dreamland Anime: Release Date, Episodes & Where to Watch . Go Kurosaki directs, with a screenplay by Fumiaki Maruto and character designs by Haruko Iizuka. Sublimation handles animation, Sunrise is credited for planning and production, and Yoshiaki Fujisawa composes the music. Watch the official announcement livestream The October 18 presentation introduced new cast members and TV anime information. The video below is the official announcement program, not a dedicated TV trailer. The official account scheduled the livestream for 20:00 JST. entries.content: FALL 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE Magic Knight Rayearth 2026: Official Creditless Ending, Hoshiakari & Streaming The new Magic Knight Rayearth anime began airing October 7, 2026. On October 15, the production released its creditless ending sequence featuring Kawaguchi Yurina’s “Hoshiakari” (星灯). By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Magic Knight Rayearth — artwork from the classic anime, used to illustrate the franchise; not a 2026 key visual. Image source: Amazon Prime Video. RELEASE DATE October 7, 2026 STREAMING Crunchyroll STUDIO E&H production October 15 update: Official creditless ending video released The production behind Magic Knight Rayearth has published a creditless version of its ending animation, set to “Hoshiakari” (星灯) by Kawaguchi Yurina . The sequence begins with Hikaru, Umi and Fuu looking toward the waves at night, then moves through atmospheric scenes featuring Princess Emeraude and other characters. It is a new official music-video release for the anime already airing—not an announcement of another season. What does a creditless ending release mean? A creditless ending video shows the ending animation without the usual on-screen production credits, allowing viewers to see the sequence and its music more clearly. The October 15 release is a promotional update for the existing anime; it does not confirm an additional season, a new premiere date or a change in streaming availability. The announced ending song is Hoshiakari by Kawaguchi Yurina. Watch the official Magic Knight Rayearth creditless ending Magic Knight Rayearth 2026 — Official Creditless Ending — watch on YouTube → If the embedded player is unavailable, watch the ending on the official video page . The anime production also links the clip in its October 15 announcement . Who sings “Hoshiakari,” and when was it released? Kawaguchi Yurina's fifth digital single launched on October 15, 2026 . The anime's official music page credits Katsuhiko Sugiyama with lyrics and Gary Jeon with composition and arrangement. The artist's record-label announcement separately confirms the release date and music-video rollout. Related reading: Paw & Palaces Releases Creditless Ending Video Featuring “Chill Choose!” . Watch Kawaguchi Yurina’s separate “Hoshiakari” music video Alongside the anime’s creditless ending, Kawaguchi Yurina released a separate artist music video on October 15. Directed by MONA (VeAble), it is distinct from the animated ending sequence. Universal Music Japan describes a visual journey from isolation toward renewal, including a symbolic haircut. This artist video should not be mistaken for another anime trailer. Kawaguchi Yurina — Hoshiakari Official Music Video — watch on YouTube → Source: Universal Music Japan’s official announcement . Watch directly on YouTube . Additional episode-two narration credit On the same date, the production confirmed Keiko Han as the narrator of episode two. The official casting announcement describes this as an additional episode-specific credit, not a replacement of the main cast. What returning viewers should expect This production revisits Hikaru, Umi and Fuu rather than introducing an unrelated story under the same title. That makes the central question for returning fans how the new adaptation presents the classic material, not simply which episode follows the older television series. The confirmed October 7 start establishes a premiere date; region-specific streaming times remain a separate question. Related reading: Sasaki and Peeps Season 2 Anime Shares Creditless Opening and Ending Videos . Is the 2026 anime a continuation? The announced production revisits Hikaru, Umi and Fuu in a new adaptation of the familiar story, rather than following the older television anime with a newly numbered season. Returning viewers can compare the treatment of the original material, while newcomers should not assume that prior television episodes are a required direct lead-in. When does Magic Knight Rayearth 2026 come out? The new Magic Knight Rayearth anime began October 7, 2026 . Crunchyroll lists it among its new Fall 2026 simulcasts, with E&H production handling animation. What to expect The new production brings Hikaru, Umi and Fuu back in a retelling of the classic Magic Knight Rayearth story. E&H production is the animation studio. What viewers should check about streaming times The October 7 date refers to the start of the new anime, not a guarantee that the episode appears at the same hour on Crunchyroll in every country. The Japanese broadcast schedule and the international streaming schedule are separate; viewers should use the official anime site for broadcast details and the regional Crunchyroll listing for their local release time. No universal simulcast hour is confirmed in this guide. Related reading: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2 . Magic Knight Rayearth 2026 episode schedule The series starts October 7. Crunchyroll's updated Fall 2026 lineup lists subtitled episodes on Wednesdays at 8:15 a.m. Pacific Time. Check your local episode listing for regional availability. Where to watch Crunchyroll lists availability across the Americas, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, parts of the CIS, Southeast Asia and Korea. Watch the official Magic Knight Rayearth trailer Official main PV 2 announced on September 20, 2026; the video is linked in Universal Music's announcement. entries.title: Manchuria Opium Squad Anime: Release Date, Story and Latest News
entries.description: Manchuria Opium Squad is getting an anime adaptation. See confirmed story details, the 2026 announcement and what remains unannounced.
entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 5, 2026 Manchuria Opium Squad Anime: Release Date, Story and Latest News The 1937-set crime manga is getting an anime adaptation. Its first visual is out, but release and production details remain unannounced. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official announcement visual. © Tsukasa Monma, Shikako, Kodansha / “Manchuria Opium Squad” Production Committee. Source: Pony Canyon . Release at a glance RELEASE DATE Not announced FORMAT Anime adaptation confirmed; format TBA STUDIO / CAST Not announced STREAMING Not announced What is confirmed about the anime? The anime adaptation of Manchuria Opium Squad was officially announced on October 5, 2026, alongside a first visual. Pony Canyon’s announcement identifies the project as an adaptation of Kodansha’s crime-suspense manga, but stops short of naming a release window or production team. This is an announcement of a project in development, not a premiere announcement: the format, studio, director, cast, broadcaster and streaming services are still unconfirmed in the official materials checked for this update. The original story is by Tsukasa Monma. The manga artwork is now by Tsurushima, while Shikako is credited for the original art concept. The series returned to Kodansha’s Weekly Young Magazine in the same October issue that carried the anime news, so readers encounter two related developments at once: the comic is continuing with its new artist, and an animated adaptation is in the works. They are separate releases with separate schedules. What is Manchuria Opium Squad about? Manchuria Opium Squad is set in Manchuria in 1937. Its protagonist, Isamu Higata, is a soldier in the Kwantung Army who loses sight in his right eye during battle. He is reassigned to an agricultural unit, where he discovers poppies being grown as a source of opium. When his mother falls ill, his need to help her pushes him into illegal production. The official manga synopsis describes the choice as the turning point that sends both Isamu’s life and Manchuria’s fate in a new direction. That setup gives the title its crime-suspense engine: a personal emergency becomes entangled with a dangerous trade and the people and powers that try to control it. The story’s appeal is not simply the historical backdrop or a lone criminal protagonist. It puts family duty beside the harm and danger attached to an illegal business, then follows the consequences of that decision. Those are story stakes, not a guide to producing or selling drugs; the official materials provide no technical how-to detail. Related reading: Anime News: October 2026 — Releases, Sequels & Streaming Updates . Historical setting and adaptation scope The year and setting are confirmed by the publisher, but the manga is a work of fiction. Readers should not treat its characters, dialogue or individual events as a documentary account of real people. The official Japanese synopsis emphasizes the frontier setting and the way Isamu’s decision changes his fate and the region around him; it does not present a historical textbook or claim that his fictional case represents every person living in Manchuria at the time. Is there an official trailer? The announcement visual is a static image that assembles character drawings and production artwork around the series logo. It confirms an anime project, but it is not a trailer and does not reveal how the animation will look in motion. As of October 24, the official materials reviewed still do not provide a verified PV or trailer link. There is consequently no official video upload time to report, and no confirmed animation footage, theme song or episode count. How popular is the manga? What does the project’s popularity look like? Pony Canyon reported that the manga had exceeded 3.5 million copies in circulation by the announcement. That is a cumulative circulation figure supplied by the publisher, not a promise about anime audience size or a count of paid digital reads. It does explain why an adaptation announcement is a significant new milestone for a series that has already built a substantial readership. Related reading: Granite Waves Anime: Story, Cast, Episodes & Where to Watch . Manga continuation and anime staff For manga readers, the continuation is especially relevant. Young Magazine’s official listing says serialization has resumed and credits Monma for the original story, Tsurushima for the manga, and Shikako for the original art concept. The anime’s staff and format have not yet been confirmed. That distinction matters: the person drawing the continuing comic is named, but that alone does not tell readers which animation studio will adapt it or who will voice Isamu. Is the manga suitable for younger readers? The English-language digital listing is available from Kodansha USA. It labels the manga Mature 18+ and warns readers about graphic violence and drug abuse. That rating applies to Kodansha USA’s manga listing; it is not an announced age rating for the anime. The note is useful for readers choosing a series to start and for anyone deciding whether its subject matter is suitable for a younger or sensitive audience. Release date and where to watch When will the anime come out, and where can it be watched? Those are the two most practical questions, and neither has an official answer yet. No premiere month or year, Japanese broadcaster, international distributor, streaming platform or cast has been announced in the official notice. Avoid sites that attach a season or service to the title without linking a dated production announcement; a series page appearing in an anime database does not establish a release plan. Related reading: Red Riding Hood: A Detective Story Premieres January 2027 on Crunchyroll . Where to follow official updates For reliable updates, use the official anime site and official X account, and compare them with Pony Canyon’s announcement and Young Magazine’s series page. A dated broadcast notice, staff list, casting release, official video, or streaming partner announcement would be new information. Until one appears, the confirmed facts remain the adaptation, the announcement visual, the manga’s return under Tsurushima, and the story’s 1937 setting. The existing manga is the way to read the story now; the anime is a separate adaptation whose format and release remain open. If you are new to the series, start with Kodansha’s official English listing for the premise and content advisory. If you already follow the manga, watch Young Magazine’s listing for its new chapter releases and the anime site for a future cast, staff or broadcast update. Confirmed: anime adaptation announced October 5, 2026, with an announcement visual. Not announced: release date, studio, cast, staff, broadcaster, streaming service and trailer. Updated: October 24, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error Sources: Pony Canyon announcement ; Weekly Young Magazine series page ; Kodansha USA English listing and content advisory . entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 13, 2026 Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO: January 2027 Release Date, Trailer and Cast The Gundam SEED prequel arrives in Japanese theaters on January 15, 2027, followed by North America in February. Here is what Bandai Namco Filmworks has confirmed. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official teaser visual via Bandai Namco Filmworks / Gundam . © SUNRISE. Release at a glance Japan theatrical release January 15, 2027 North America February 2027; exact date pending Director Mitsuo Fukuda International streaming Not announced Official release announcement When does Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO release? Mobile Suit Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO opens in Japanese theaters on Friday, January 15, 2027. Bandai Namco Filmworks has separately confirmed a North American theatrical release in February 2027, but has not announced a specific North American opening day or theater list. These are different regional release windows. What is the story about? Set in Cosmic Era 74 between Mobile Suit Gundam SEED DESTINY and the 2024 film SEED FREEDOM, the new movie follows Shinn Asuka after the collapse of the Destiny Plan. As Cagalli and her allies work to establish the international peacekeeping organization COMPASS, Shinn is still searching for a direction. When the Strike Freedom Gundam is stolen from a temporary base on Onogoro Island, Shinn and his companions must respond before the crisis escalates. The film draws on a screenplay developed by Chiaki Morosawa, Shigeru Morita and director Mitsuo Fukuda during the planning of SEED FREEDOM. Where does FREEDOM ZERO fit in the viewing order? The film is set after Mobile Suit Gundam SEED DESTINY and before SEED FREEDOM, making it a story between existing installments rather than a sequel set after the 2024 film. Its focus on Shinn and the formation of COMPASS helps bridge those events. The announced placement does not mean every earlier Gundam series is required viewing. Related reading: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers: Premiere, Cast, Streaming and Official Trailer . Are Japanese and North American release dates the same? No. January 15, 2027 is the announced Japanese theatrical opening. North America has a separate February 2027 theatrical window, without a confirmed day or theater list in the cited announcement. Neither date establishes a global streaming release. Watch the official Gundam SEED FREEDOM ZERO trailer The new teaser accompanies the October 2026 announcement and introduces the story linking DESTINY and FREEDOM. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Official Gundam channel Watch the official trailer on YouTube . Japanese and English voice cast The Japanese cast includes Kenichi Suzumura as Shinn Asuka, Maaya Sakamoto as Lunamaria Hawke, Houko Kuwashima as Agnes Giebenrath, Daisuke Ono as Leonard Valway, Soichiro Hoshi as Kira Yamato, Akira Ishida as Athrun Zala and Tomokazu Seki as Yzak Jule. The announced English cast includes Matthew Erickson as Shinn Asuka, Matt Hill as Kira Yamato and Sam Vincent as Athrun Zala. Other English-language roles have not all been detailed in the announcement. Who is producing the movie? Mitsuo Fukuda directs, with character designs by Hisashi Hirai and music by Toshihiko Sahashi. SUNRISE is credited with planning and production; Bandai Namco Filmworks is among the film's producers and distributors. Where can you watch it? Theatrical releases are confirmed for Japan and North America. Streaming platforms, additional territories and home-video dates have not yet been announced. Check the official Gundam channels for confirmed updates rather than assuming availability on a particular streaming service. entries.content: OFFICIAL ANIME NEWS · OCTOBER 17, 2026 MURCIÉLAGO Anime Sets January 2027 Premiere; Cast Announced The TV adaptation of Kana Yoshimura’s manga is scheduled to begin in January 2027. The official site now lists three voice cast members, while HIDIVE has announced exclusive streaming in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Ireland, Australia and New Zealand. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional visual. Source and artwork credit: official anime website . Release at a glance Premiere window January 2027; exact date pending Streaming service HIDIVE; U.S., Canada, U.K., Ireland, Australia and New Zealand Animation production SATELIGHT × Staple Entertainment Voice cast Hitomi Ueda as Kuroko Koumori; Minori Suzuki as Hinako Tozakura; Sumire Uesaka as Chiyo Yanaoka Confirmed by the official anime site and HIDIVE / AMC Global Media . When does the MURCIÉLAGO anime premiere? MURCIÉLAGO is scheduled to begin airing and streaming in January 2027. The production announced the month during HIDIVE’s panel at Anime NYC 2026. The official anime website confirms a January broadcast and streaming start, but does not yet list an exact day or time. AMC Global Media’s announcement lists the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia and New Zealand for HIDIVE’s exclusive simulcast. Viewers elsewhere should check their local catalog closer to release, since the announcement does not confirm availability in every country. What is MURCIÉLAGO about? The story centers on Kuroko Koumori, a former death-row inmate selected to serve as a state-sanctioned executioner under extraordinary legal measures. Her partner and watchdog, Hinako Tozakura, is a driver with exceptional skills. Together, they confront violent crimes and the people behind them. The official description presents the show as a dark buddy-action series built around the duo. Related reading: Dengeki Daisy Anime Sets January 2027 Premiere, Reveals Trailer and Cast . Cast, studio and staff The official site now lists Hitomi Ueda as Kuroko Koumori, Minori Suzuki as Hinako Tozakura and Sumire Uesaka as Chiyo Yanaoka. These are the three characters named in the current cast announcement. SATELIGHT and Staple Entertainment are producing the animation. Takashi Naoya is chief director and handles series composition, while Matsuo Asami directs. Kiyoshi Tateishi is credited with character design. The official site lists music by Masanori Akita and Yuichi Tsuchiya . Watch the official teaser ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER January 2027 TV anime Watch the teaser on YouTube · Official anime website . What is still unconfirmed? The January 2027 window, streaming plans and three cast members are confirmed. The official site has not announced an exact premiere date or a territory-by-territory streaming schedule. AniNextUp will update this guide when those details are announced. Follow more official anime news and use the release calendar to track dated premieres. What the January announcement tells viewers The official website sets January 2027 as the start of the television broadcast and streaming, but gives no exact day or episode time. That distinction matters for a seasonal calendar: “January” is a release window, not a weekly slot. AniNextUp will add a precise schedule only after the production or distributor publishes one. The three cast names currently highlighted on the official site are Hitomi Ueda as Kuroko, Minori Suzuki as Hinako and Sumire Uesaka as Chiyo; additional roles should not be inferred from promotional images. The adaptation’s central pairing also explains why the announcement describes it as a dark buddy-action story. Kuroko’s legal status and role as an executioner put her inside the justice system in an unusual way, while Hinako’s driving skills make her an active partner in the cases rather than a bystander. The official synopsis describes their work against violent offenders; it does not identify a season-long antagonist or explain how each case will be adapted. Streaming details are regional HIDIVE’s announcement identifies the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia and New Zealand for its exclusive simulcast. That is a named territory list, not a guarantee that the service carries the series in every country where it operates. Viewers in Latin America, continental Europe and other unlisted regions should check local platforms closer to the premiere instead of assuming that the Japanese streaming announcement applies worldwide. The original manga has a long-running story and a more mature tone than a typical school comedy. Readers who are new to the title may want to check the publisher’s description and the anime’s own trailer before deciding whether its violent material suits them. The available announcement does not provide a formal international age rating. AniNextUp will report one only when a local distributor or ratings body publishes it. The original video upload metadata previously verified for this teaser is August 30, 2026, at 20:00:10 UTC−07:00, equivalent to August 31 at 03:00:10 UTC. That upload time is separate from the specials’ premiere. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER KADOKAWAanime · Official specials teaser Watch the official teaser on YouTube → Are these Season 3 or three special episodes? Netflix labels the release “Season 2 — Special Episodes,” and the official Japanese announcement confirms three episodes. The 90-minute television slot groups them into one broadcast event; it does not turn them into a newly announced full season or establish how every streaming service will package them. Story and cast updates The specials continue Miyo and Kiyoka’s relationship as their wedding approaches. The production introduces Kimio Nagaba, Miyo’s former school classmate, voiced by M・A・O. Reina Ueda and Kaito Ishikawa voice Miyo Saimori and Kiyoka Kudo. What should I watch before the specials? Watch the existing anime seasons before starting this continuation. The specials return to Miyo and Kiyoka after the relationship and supernatural conflicts established in the television series; they are not a fresh adaptation that introduces the couple from the beginning. Netflix groups the new release with Season 2, which helps distinguish it from the first season’s earlier bonus episode. If your catalog displays several entries or season selectors, check the episode descriptions rather than choosing by the word “special” alone. How do these differ from the earlier OVA? The official on-air page separately lists an OVA identified as Episode 13. That older episode and the three new October 2026 specials are different releases. This distinction matters when searching for “My Happy Marriage special episode”: an older streaming listing or review may describe Episode 13 rather than this new three-part event. The October 25 announcement is the relevant notice for the new continuation. It confirms three episodes, while leaving international catalog presentation to each streaming service. What does the story focus on? The romance begins with an arranged engagement between Miyo, a young woman mistreated by her family, and Kiyoka, a military officer with a forbidding reputation. Their growing trust sits alongside inherited supernatural abilities and family expectations. For returning viewers, the specials bring the wedding and the couple’s future into focus. Kimio’s arrival adds a connection to Miyo’s school years: the official character description says she welcomes their reunion but carries a troubling shadow beneath that reaction. The announcement does not reveal how her involvement resolves. Returning production team and music Netflix names Takehiro Kubota as director and Kinema Citrus as the animation studio. Reina Ueda returns as Miyo, opposite Kaito Ishikawa as Kiyoka, with M・A・O joining as Kimio Nagaba. The production also announced Kashitaro Ito’s ending theme, “Prelude no Temae ni ~for me&you~.” Its music-service rollout begins October 26 at midnight in Japan. That is the song’s release schedule, not an alternative premiere time for the episodes. How to read the time-zone information Japan uses JST, UTC+9. The October 25 television start at 19:00 JST corresponds to 10:00 UTC; the domestic streaming start at 20:30 JST corresponds to 11:30 UTC. Those conversions describe the Japanese schedule only. They do not promise that your Netflix catalog will update at either converted time. The official domestic notice says distribution begins progressively and cautions that schedules can change. For international viewing, the confirmed Netflix date and your local title page remain the useful references. What is still unconfirmed for international viewers? The cited Netflix announcement confirms a date, but does not list a worldwide launch hour, the language options for every territory, or whether all local catalogs will display the specials identically. The Japanese TV block lasts 90 minutes, including the broadcaster’s scheduling allowance; it should not be reported as a verified 90 minutes of uninterrupted animation. Until episode listings appear, avoid treating that slot as the combined exact runtime. The practical check on release day is the new episode list under the local series page, together with its available subtitle and audio menus. The cited announcements also do not specify a separate English-dub timetable. Naming the Japanese cast confirms those performances, but does not establish which dubbed tracks will be available on October 25 in your country. Check the local audio menu when the episodes appear. Official sources Production announcement: date, three episodes, teaser and new cast Japanese broadcast and streaming schedule Netflix’s October release confirmation Plan the rest of your watchlist with the weekly anime schedule and AniNextUp’s Netflix anime guides . More anime to watch next Find the specials alongside this week’s other confirmed releases , then browse November’s anime premieres for your next viewing plans. entries.title: Naruto × Ninkū Anime: Four Episodes, Official Teaser and Release Status
entries.description: Naruto × Ninkū is a four-episode crossover supervised by both creators. Explore its story, staff and official teaser, with release and streaming status.
entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · 2026-10-11 Naruto × Ninkū Anime: Four Episodes, Official Teaser and Release Status Team 7 meets Fūsuke in a creator-supervised crossover announced at New York Comic Con. Here is what the official sources confirm—and which release details are still unannounced. By AniNextUp Editorial Team Official visual supplied in TV Tokyo’s press release. © Masashi Kishimoto Scott, Koji Kiriyama / SHUEISHA TV TOKYO PIERROT. Four episodes bring Naruto and Ninkū together Naruto has a new anime project: a four-episode crossover with Ninkū , the ninja adventure created by Koji Kiriyama. VIZ announced the project at New York Comic Con on October 10, 2026, alongside a first teaser. Masashi Kishimoto and Kiriyama are supervising the episodes, with Noriyuki Abe directing and Tetsuya Nishio handling character design and chief animation direction. The announcement establishes a specific, limited project rather than an open-ended new television season. For viewers looking for a release date, however, the launch details are still missing: the official announcements reviewed on October 11 do not give a premiere date or name a streaming service. Source: VIZ’s New York Comic Con announcement. Team 7’s mission takes Naruto into another world The production’s official project page describes a mission assigned to Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura. With Kakashi unable to accompany them, Naruto takes the lead. Their assignment becomes something much stranger when Naruto loses his way into another world and encounters Fūsuke, the central character of Ninkū . Related reading: Dr. STONE TERRAFORMING Anime Announced: Official Artwork, Trailer and Release Status . That premise gives the crossover a clear starting point: a familiar Team 7 assignment becomes an encounter between two different approaches to ninja adventure. The announcement does not establish where these episodes belong in Naruto’s continuity, so a watch-order placement would be premature. For readers unfamiliar with the other half of the title, Ninkū began as Kiriyama’s manga in Weekly Shonen Jump in 1993 and received an anime adaptation in 1995. Its fighting style combines ninjutsu and karate. The new project’s official materials also identify it as an influence on Kishimoto’s work, giving the pairing a documented creative connection. Related reading: Naruto: Shadow Rising — Kishimoto's New Manga Announced, Official Teaser and Release Updates . Is Naruto × Ninkū a new Naruto season? No. The announced project consists of four crossover episodes featuring Naruto characters alongside Fūsuke from Ninkū . That fixed scope is different from an announcement of a full new season of the main Naruto television series. VIZ and the official project page do not specify a premiere date or streaming partner, so viewers should not treat an unofficial calendar listing as confirmed. Who is making the crossover? The project page credits PIERROT FILMS with animation production. Its lead cast includes Junko Takeuchi as Naruto and Rica Matsumoto as Fūsuke, with Noriaki Sugiyama as Sasuke, Chie Nakamura as Sakura and Kazuhiko Inoue as Kakashi. Related reading: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Is Out on Netflix: Episodes & Trailer . Both original creators are involved in supervising all four episodes. That is the confirmed scope of their participation; it should not be expanded into claims that they personally animate the project or write every scene. The official credits distinguish supervision, direction and character design as separate responsibilities. Watch the official Naruto × Ninkū teaser The NARUTO / BORUTO Official Channel published NARUTO×NINKŪ | Teaser | NARUTO on October 10, 2026. This is the teaser linked by VIZ’s announcement and corresponds to the crossover, rather than a preview for an unrelated Naruto season. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER Watch the official teaser directly on YouTube. The player loads after a click and does not start automatically. Release date and streaming: what remains unannounced As of October 11, 2026, the reviewed official sources have not specified the premiere date, episode release schedule, broadcaster, streaming platform or country-by-country availability for the crossover. There is consequently no confirmed US viewing service to recommend yet, nor evidence for a simultaneous worldwide anime release. TV Tokyo’s Project Rasengan announcement does contain a June 2027 date, but that belongs to the Naruto card game. It is not the release date for these four anime episodes. Its statement about global distribution of a mobile game likewise should not be read as an anime streaming agreement. The crossover and Naruto Shadow Rising are separate projects The official Naruto announcement roundup also introduces Kishimoto’s new Naruto Shadow Rising manga. That announcement sits alongside the crossover under the broader Project Rasengan initiative; it does not turn the crossover into a Shadow Rising anime adaptation. The next announced Project Rasengan information point is Jump Festa 2027, scheduled for December 19–20, 2026. Despite the event’s name, those dates fall in December 2026. The promised follow-up concerns the broader project, so it is not a guarantee that an anime premiere date will be revealed there. Until a distribution announcement appears, treat this as a confirmed four-episode production with a released teaser and an unannounced launch. For other titles with established dates, consult AniNextUp’s anime release calendar ; this crossover should not receive a guessed calendar entry. Official sources: VIZ announcement , anime production page , Naruto announcement roundup and TV Tokyo press release . Last reviewed October 11, 2026. entries.title: Naruto: Shadow Rising — Kishimoto's New Manga Announced, Official Teaser and Release Updates
entries.description: Naruto: Shadow Rising is a new Naruto manga drawn by Masashi Kishimoto. See the official teaser, announcement artwork and what is confirmed about its release.
entries.content: OFFICIAL MANGA NEWS · OCTOBER 12, 2026 Naruto: Shadow Rising — Kishimoto's New Manga Announced, Official Teaser and Release Updates Masashi Kishimoto is returning to draw a new Naruto manga. The first teaser reveals familiar faces and hints at a later era of the Hidden Leaf Village, but major publication details are still under wraps. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official super teaser thumbnail via the NARUTO Official YouTube channel . © Masashi Kishimoto / Shueisha. Release at a glance Release Publication date pending Where to watch Manga publication and English availability pending Applies to New manga; separate from the Naruto × Ninkū anime Still pending Serialization date and publication details; follow-up at Jump Festa 2027 Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Official source What is Naruto: Shadow Rising? During the “NARUTO: What's Next?” panel at New York Comic Con on October 10, 2026, the franchise announced a new Naruto manga drawn by original creator Masashi Kishimoto . The reveal appeared at the end of a special promotional video, and the official announcement graphic carries the Shadow Rising name. This is a manga announcement, not a new anime season or a confirmed adaptation of the manga. The announcement is notable because Kishimoto created and illustrated the original Naruto manga. The sequel series Boruto has involved a different core art team, making a newly drawn Naruto story from Kishimoto himself a distinct development for the franchise. Does the manga teaser confirm a new Naruto anime? No. The October 10 reveal is presented as a manga announcement associated with Masashi Kishimoto, and the promotional footage should not be treated as evidence of an animated adaptation or a new television season. The appearance of familiar characters in a teaser also does not establish a publication date, a complete story chronology or a streaming platform. Those details require separate official announcements. Related reading: Anime News: October 2026 — Releases, Sequels & Streaming Updates . What does the official teaser show? The teaser opens with the stone faces of six former Hokage overlooking the Hidden Leaf Village and a seventh monument under construction. It then shows Naruto holding a Hokage hat, Kakashi smiling, Sasuke standing alone, Sakura gazing at a baby, and a confrontation between Naruto and Sasuke. These are images from the teaser , not a complete plot synopsis. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER NARUTO Official Open the official teaser on YouTube if the embedded video does not play. When will Shadow Rising be released? No precise serialization start date or publication schedule has been announced in the franchise's official October 11 recap. Some news outlets have discussed a 2027 release, but the official announcement directs readers to the Naruto Jump Super Stage at Jump Festa 2027, held December 19–20, 2026 , for additional information. Until a publisher confirms a schedule, a month or day would be premature. Where does the story fit in the Naruto timeline? The teaser's images have prompted speculation about a story set between the end of the original manga and the era depicted in Boruto . The unfinished Seventh Hokage monument and Sakura's scene with a baby offer clues, but the production has not published a confirmed timeline or full plot summary . Fans should distinguish these visual hints from official story details. Is Shadow Rising the same as Naruto × Ninkū? No. The New York Comic Con panel announced two separate projects. Shadow Rising is a new Naruto manga drawn by Kishimoto , whereas Naruto × Ninkū is a four-episode crossover anime supervised by Kishimoto and Ninkū creator Koji Kiriyama. See our Naruto × Ninkū announcement guide for the crossover's teaser and staff. What remains to be announced? Readers are still waiting for the manga's official publication date, magazine or distribution details, chapter count, complete story premise and English-language availability. We will update this report when Shueisha or the official Naruto franchise confirms those specifics. Official sources Japanese official announcement confirming the SHADOW RISING title . Naruto official website — NYCC 2026 announcement · Official super teaser · More AniNextUp anime and manga news . Updated: October 22, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.content: NETFLIX · OCTOBER 2026 New Anime on Netflix in October 2026: What to Watch AniNextUp’s guide to notable anime releases on Netflix during October 2026. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases WHERE TO WATCH Netflix Release at a glance Release October 2026; dates and time zones are title-specific Where to watch Netflix; regional catalog availability applies Region and timing Weekly series and special episodes have separate release formats. Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Netflix’s October anime lineup · Ranma ½ official broadcast schedule · Netflix Japan’s Anime NYC 2026 announcement This October guide compares weekly Netflix anime releases with special-episode and one-off launches; check the linked title guides for confirmed territory and episode timing. Netflix has announced The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 for October 1 PT / October 2 JST, Blue Box Season 2 for October 4 with weekly episodes, and My Happy Marriage Season 2 Special Episodes for October 25. October highlights The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 — October 1 PT / October 2 JST, new episodes weekly Ranma 1/2 Season 3 — Japanese broadcast begins October 3 (late-night slot); Netflix follows the Japanese broadcast Blue Box Season 2 — October 4, new episodes weekly Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 — October 20 My Happy Marriage Season 2 Special Episodes — October 25 Which Netflix titles release weekly? The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 and Blue Box Season 2 have weekly episode rollouts in the cited Netflix announcements. Their October premiere dates mark the first release, not the arrival of every episode. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 has an October 20 launch date, but this guide does not infer a batch-release format without a separately confirmed schedule. What to watch first Blue Box Season 2 is one of the month’s major weekly returns, while The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 opens the month with another romance-focused sequel. Later in October, My Happy Marriage adds special episodes on October 25. Related reading: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? Release Guide . Weekly releases vs. one-day drops Not every Netflix anime follows the same release model. Blue Box Season 2 and The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 are confirmed for weekly episodes, while specials and other titles can use different schedules. AniNextUp tracks each title separately so a monthly Netflix list does not imply that every show drops its full season at once. Where to check next For titles outside Netflix, use the AniNextUp streaming hub . For date-by-date premieres across services, see the Fall 2026 anime calendar . AniNextUp: Release dates and streaming availability can vary by region. This guide will be updated when new official information is confirmed. October’s release pattern, checked against Netflix By October 23, the first two weekly premieres in Netflix’s romance lineup have already begun. The Ramparts of Ice Season 2 started October 1 in Pacific Time (October 2 in Japan) and is listed with weekly episodes; Blue Box Season 2 began October 4 and also follows a weekly schedule. Those dates refer to the first episode, not a full-season drop. For a viewer planning a weekend watch, the distinction changes whether the series can be binged or needs a week-by-week follow-up. My Happy Marriage Season 2 — Special Episodes is scheduled for October 25. Netflix labels these as special episodes, so they should not be confused with the start of a new numbered season. Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 arrived October 20 as a separate Netflix title; its official listing describes a standalone ten-episode story. The anime releases on different dates and formats even though all appear under the month’s anime searches. How to use this guide without mixing schedules Check the linked title guide for the exact service and episode status, then compare the date with the Netflix catalog in your country. Netflix’s newsroom can announce a global plan, while the local title page is the practical check for playback, audio and subtitles. The October 1 / October 2 notation is a time-zone difference around the same release moment, not evidence of two separate premiere events. For fans choosing between the weekly romances, the official descriptions offer a simple distinction: The Ramparts of Ice follows a group of classmates whose relationships shift, while Blue Box combines school romance with badminton and basketball ambitions. My Happy Marriage’s October entry is a set of specials rather than a weekly new season. This guide keeps those formats separate so the month’s list is useful as a schedule, not just a collection of titles. We will mark dates as past and update the page when Netflix changes a listing. entries.content: OCTOBER 6 · 2026 Nia Liston Anime Release Date, Schedule & Where to Watch Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden premieres October 6, 2026 in Japan, with a two-cour broadcast planned. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases RELEASE DATE October 6, 2026 STUDIO KONAMI animation FORMAT Two consecutive cours Release at a glance Release October 6, 2026 Where to watch HIDIVE in supported territories; Japanese services have their own schedule Release details checked October 12, 2026 · HIDIVE October schedule · Official Japan site What a two-cour commitment tells viewers Two consecutive cours indicate a longer planned television run than a typical single-cour premiere, but they do not establish an exact episode count without a separate announcement. The 9:25 p.m. TOKYO MX broadcast and 9:55 p.m. Japanese advance-streaming window also refer to different distribution methods. Neither is evidence that the series is available internationally on those same services. When does Nia Liston premiere? Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden premieres October 6, 2026 on TOKYO MX, MBS and BS Nippon TV. The official site says the anime will run for two consecutive cours. Japan broadcast and streaming schedule TOKYO MX begins the series October 6 at 9:25 p.m. JST. MBS and BS Nippon TV also begin October 6 on their respective late-night schedules. ABEMA and d Anime Store receive the earliest domestic streaming window from 9:55 p.m. JST, with U-NEXT and Anime Hodai following October 9 and additional Japanese services from October 12. Related reading: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Schedule & Where to Watch . Is international streaming confirmed? HIDIVE’s official October schedule lists Nia Liston as a Tuesday simulcast starting October 6. That confirms HIDIVE in its supported territories; it does not establish worldwide access. Japan’s ABEMA, d Anime Store and other service dates remain separate. What is Nia Liston about? A legendary warrior who once defeated a god is reincarnated as the frail noble girl Nia Liston. Rather than settling into a quiet second life, Nia continues searching for powerful opponents while also becoming involved in school life and the fantasy world’s “Magic Vision” entertainment business. Related reading: Black Clover Season 2 Schedule & Where to Watch . Studio and staff KONAMI animation produces the series. Motoki Nakanishi serves as director, Haruta Segi as assistant director, Gigaemon Ichikawa handles series composition, and Yuki Ito and Kana Tosaoka are credited with character design. Naoki Endo composes the music. What the official Blu-ray listing confirms The official Japanese anime website lists Blu-ray BOX 1 for March 24, 2027 and specifies that it contains episodes 1–12. That establishes the contents of the first home-video box, but it does not establish the total number of episodes across both cours. Readers should not turn a two-cour broadcast announcement into an unsupported full-series episode count. Related reading: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode Schedule & Where to Watch . Why the premise combines combat and entertainment Nia's desire to challenge strong opponents sits alongside her involvement in the world's Magic Vision entertainment industry. Those two interests create a contrast between a warrior's appetite for battle and the public-facing life of a young noblewoman. This is AniNextUp's interpretation of the official synopsis, not a claim that any unannounced storyline or outcome is confirmed. What the opening and ending songs add The official production identifies Watame Tsunomaki's “Respawn!!” as the opening theme . It also identifies “Tokimeki Un Deux Trois♪” as the ending theme , performed by the character unit featuring Nia, Hildetora and Reliared. These credits provide a useful distinction between the show's action-oriented premise and its in-world Magic Vision entertainment motif, without implying anything about future episodes. entries.content: OFFICIAL ANIME NEWS · OCTOBER 12, 2026 Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend Anime: 2027 Release, Main Cast and First Visual The workplace comedy from Weekly Young Jump is heading to television in 2027. Its first key visual and two lead voice actors have been unveiled, bringing the unusual friendship between Noa and Rihito one step closer to the screen. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official Noa Saotome character artwork from the anime website. The separate first key visual was revealed October 11. © Enma Akiyama / Shueisha / Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi Production Committee. Release at a glance Release 2027; month and day pending Where to watch International streaming partner pending Applies to Japanese television announcement Still pending Broadcast season, episode count and streaming platforms Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Official source When will Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend premiere? The television anime Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend ( Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi. ) is scheduled to air in 2027 . The production confirmed the year in an October 11, 2026 update alongside its first key visual and the two main voice actors. No exact month, day, television channel or international streaming service has been announced. A more precise release date would be speculation. Meet the two confirmed lead voice actors The official cast announcement puts the central coworkers in focus: Rina Kawaguchi voices Noa Saotome , an accomplished art director at a video game company who hides a more vulnerable side behind her professional reputation. Tomoya Ito voices Rihito Otsuka , a second-year employee who tries to conserve energy and avoid unnecessary drama. These are the two announced leads as of October 12. Other characters may appear in the series, but no additional voice cast should be treated as confirmed until the production announces it. What does the new key visual show? The first key visual depicts Noa and Rihito sitting together, emphasizing the unlikely friendship at the center of the story. It is different from the earlier teaser visual released when the anime adaptation was announced in July 2026. The image above is official character artwork sourced from the production website; to see the newly announced full key visual, visit the official anime website . Studio and production staff feel. is animating the series. Shinsuke Yanagi is directing, Keiichiro Ochi is responsible for series composition, and Yumiko Yamamoto is designing the characters. The core staff were identified with the original adaptation announcement, and the October cast update provides a clearer sense of the show's lead performances. Related reading: Expelled from Paradise Sequel Reveals Main Trailer and Beyond the Night Theme Song . What is the story about? Noa Saotome seems to have her career under control. As an art director at a game development company, she earns the respect of managers and younger colleagues alike. Rihito Otsuka, meanwhile, is in his second year at the company and approaches daily life with a determinedly low-energy attitude. One day, he accidentally discovers a side of Noa she has carefully concealed at work. That encounter begins an unusual after-hours friendship. Rather than centering on a fantasy world or a high school, Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend explores how two very different adults negotiate workplace expectations, personal boundaries and the meaning of being friends. Where did the original manga come from? The anime adapts Enma Akiyama's manga , which began running in Shueisha's Weekly Young Jump in July 2023. Eleven collected volumes had been released in Japan by July 2026, and Volume 12 was scheduled for October 19, 2026. The manga's continuing serialization means the anime is adapting an established ongoing story rather than an original television screenplay. Is the first key visual the same as a trailer? No. The October 11 update introduced a still promotional image and the voices of Noa and Rihito, not a confirmed animated trailer. The official announcement establishes a 2027 television broadcast window, but no exact season, episode count or international streaming partner. Readers should treat a fan-made video or an unrelated manga promotion differently from a production-released anime trailer. Related reading: Inherit the Winds Anime: January 2027 Premiere, November Theater Preview and New Visual . Is there a trailer? The latest October 11 announcement focuses on the first key visual and the lead voice cast. An official trailer associated with this update has not been independently confirmed , so this article does not embed or label an unrelated video as an official trailer. Readers can check the production's website and social channels for future promotional videos. Where will the anime stream? As of October 12, 2026, no international streaming partner has been confirmed. The anime's broadcast season and episode count are also unannounced. We will update this page when the production or a licensed distributor releases those details. Frequently asked questions Is Noa Is My Senior an anime? Yes. The manga's television anime adaptation was announced in July 2026, with a 2027 broadcast window confirmed in October. Who voices Noa Saotome? Rina Kawaguchi voices Noa Saotome. Related reading: The Fable Season 2: January 9, 2027 Premiere, Cast and Visual . Who voices Rihito Otsuka? Tomoya Ito voices Rihito Otsuka. Which studio is animating it? feel. is responsible for animation production. Official sources Noa Is My Senior official anime website · Crunchyroll News: cast, key visual and 2027 broadcast . For other confirmed series, browse the AniNextUp anime calendar and latest news . Updated: October 16, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.content: OFFICIAL ANIME NEWS · OCTOBER 17, 2026 Now That We Draw Anime Sets January 2027 Premiere The TV adaptation of Kakunaru Ue wa begins in January 2027. Its official website has revealed the first promotional video, character visuals and two lead cast members; an exact day and streaming platform have not been announced. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional visual. Source and artwork credit: official anime website . Release at a glance Premiere window January 2027; exact day pending Lead cast Ayumu Murase as Yuki Uehara; Sayumi Suzushiro as Niina Miyamoto Animation studio ROLL2 Streaming Not announced Verified against the official anime website . When does Now That We Draw premiere? Now That We Draw is scheduled to begin in January 2027. The official anime website confirms the month, but it does not list an exact broadcast date, time or television network. The site also does not name an international streaming service, so platform availability remains unconfirmed. The series is based on the manga Kakunaru Ue wa . Its first promotional video and character materials were unveiled alongside the January broadcast window. What is the story about? Yuki Uehara dreams of becoming a manga artist and loves two-dimensional characters. After an editor criticizes his romantic comedy manga for lacking realistic romance, he considers giving up. Classmate Niina Miyamoto discovers his work and reveals that she also wants to become a manga artist. The pair start a “secret pretend relationship” to help with their manga, setting up a youth romantic comedy about two aspiring creators. Related reading: Dengeki Daisy Anime Sets January 2027 Premiere, Reveals Trailer and Cast . The original manga is written by Kyū Takahata and illustrated by Yūji Kaba ; it is serialized in Hakusensha’s Young Animal . Those source credits are listed on the official anime site . Cast and staff Ayumu Murase voices Yuki Uehara, while Sayumi Suzushiro voices Niina Miyamoto. ROLL2 is producing the animation. Shunsuke Ishikawa directs, Deco Akao handles series composition and scripts, and Hiromi Nakagawa designs the characters. The official site lists “Kimiiro Hirari” by shallm as the opening theme. Watch the official first PV ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL PV January 2027 TV anime Watch the PV on YouTube · Official anime website . What has not been confirmed? The production has confirmed the January 2027 window, two lead cast members and principal staff. An exact premiere day, broadcast time and streaming service have not been announced. AniNextUp will update this guide when the official site publishes those details. See other confirmed anime news and browse the release calendar . What the first PV establishes for the adaptation The official site gives readers a useful dividing line between what is known and what is still marketing language. The anime adapts Kyū Takahata and Yūji Kaba’s manga, published in Hakusensha’s Young Animal. Its central setup is not simply “two classmates fall in love”: Yuki wants to draw romantic comedy, Niina wants to become a manga artist too, and their pretend relationship is a practical arrangement that feeds their work. That makes the creative partnership part of the premise, not just a backdrop. That distinction gives the first PV more context. The video and character materials introduce the leads and the show’s romantic-comedy premise, while the official announcement confirms the January 2027 broadcast window and the principal cast and staff. It does not establish a particular January premiere day, a Japanese network, or an international streaming service. Viewers should treat those as open questions until the production publishes a schedule. Why the creators’ premise matters A story about people trying to write romance can play with the gap between what a character thinks is romantic and what another person actually feels. In this case, that is an interpretation of the announced setup, not a confirmed plot summary of later episodes. It is a more useful expectation than promising a specific romantic outcome the official materials have not disclosed. For viewers deciding whether to follow the series, the confirmed staff list is also practical: ROLL2 handles animation, Shunsuke Ishikawa directs, Deco Akao oversees series composition and scripts, and Hiromi Nakagawa designs the characters. The opening theme, “Kimiiro Hirari” by shallm, is listed on the official site. AniNextUp will add the exact Japanese broadcast slot and regional streaming details only when they are announced. Season 3 follows the struggle between the Hero Association and the Monster Association, with Garou's role becoming increasingly important. J.C.STAFF is the animation studio behind Season 3, following its work on Season 2. The October 11 announcement focuses on the release month, promotional video, key art and opening theme; it does not announce a studio replacement for Part 2. entries.content: NEW ANIME · OCTOBER 6, 2026 The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival Anime Premieres July 2027 The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival has locked in a July 2027 TV premiere. The latest announcement also reveals its teaser PV and visual, lead voice actor and core production staff. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases RELEASE WINDOW JULY 2027 · EXACT DATE TBA What makes Alia's premise distinctive Alia's story begins by challenging the role that an otome-game setting appears to assign her. Rather than following a prescribed romantic route, she chooses survival and agency, shifting the emphasis toward decisions made under pressure. The July 2027 announcement establishes the planned broadcast month, while the exact premiere day and platform availability still require separate confirmation. When does The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival anime release? The TV anime is officially scheduled to begin broadcasting in July 2027 . An exact premiere day has not been announced yet. Who voices Alia? Fuka Izumi voices protagonist Alia, the orphan who rejects the fate assigned to her as an otome-game heroine and chooses to survive on her own terms. Related reading: The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop Anime Premieres January 2027 . Studio and staff Noriyoshi Sasaki directs the anime, with Toko Machida handling series composition and Hiroyuki Miseki credited for character design. Music is by KOHTA YAMAMOTO, Shun Narita and Yuki Furuhashi . Animation production is shared by STUDIO CLUTCH × Animation Studio Seven . What is the anime about? After learning that she is supposed to be the heroine of an otome game, Alicia rejects that predetermined role. Taking the name Alia, she builds her survival skills, learns to fight with weapons and magic, and carves out her own path through a dangerous fantasy world. Related reading: Haru to Gen Anime Premieres January 4, 2027: Cast and Teaser . What distinguishes this from a typical otome-game adaptation? The premise uses knowledge of an otome game's intended heroine role as something Alia actively resists. That makes the announced conflict less about choosing a romance route and more about learning to survive after rejecting a prescribed future. This is an editorial reading of the official story description, not a promise that the anime will omit romance or follow a particular sequence of events. What readers should wait for next A July 2027 broadcast window is useful for seasonal planning, but it is not an exact episode-one date. entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · 2026-10-09 Pokémon Horizons Anime Unseals Treasures of Ruin in Latest Wonder Voyage Arc Trailer A new Pokémon Horizons: Wonder Voyage trailer highlights the Treasures of Ruin—Wo-Chien, Chien-Pao, Ting-Lu and Chi-Yu—as the anime's Paldea storyline continues. By AniNextUp Editorial Team Release at a glance Release October 16, 2026: episode 153 Where to watch TV Tokyo in Japan Region and timing Wonder Voyage began May 22 in Japan. The U.S. Season 4 Netflix milestone is February 27, 2027. Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Pokémon Horizons official TV Tokyo page · Pokémon Japan official announcement · Pokémon’s Season 4 Netflix announcement New Wonder Voyage trailer spotlights the Treasures of Ruin A new trailer for Pokémon Horizons: The Series puts four Legendary Pokémon from the Paldea region in the spotlight. Wo-Chien, Chien-Pao, Ting-Lu and Chi-Yu, collectively known as the Treasures of Ruin, appear in the latest preview for the anime's continuing Wonder Voyage storyline. Crunchyroll reported the trailer on October 9, 2026. Who are the four Treasures of Ruin? The quartet first appeared in the Pokémon Scarlet and Violet games. Wo-Chien is a Dark/Grass-type Pokémon, Chien-Pao is Dark/Ice, Ting-Lu is Dark/Ground, and Chi-Yu is Dark/Fire. The games associate the four with ancient objects and seals, providing background for why their appearance is important to a Paldea-centered story. The trailer's release does not by itself establish the outcome of their role in the anime. Where does the trailer fit in Wonder Voyage? The Wonder Voyage arc began airing in Japan on May 22, 2026. Its story continues the journey of Liko, Roy, Dot and Ult alongside the Rising Volt Tacklers. Earlier official promotional material introduced the arc's new adventures and characters; the October preview shifts attention toward the consequences of the Treasures of Ruin being unsealed. Related reading: Pokémon Horizons Season 4: February 27 Netflix Date, Story and Trailer . What does the new trailer leave unanswered? The official promotional material shows the Treasures of Ruin entering the Wonder Voyage storyline, but it does not establish how the conflict will end or whether the four Pokémon will play equal roles. The October 16 Japanese story date is also not the same as the separately announced February 27, 2027 U.S. Netflix release for Wonders Ahead . Keeping those two schedules distinct helps avoid misleading international viewers. When did the Paldea story begin? The Japanese Paldea story began on October 16, 2026. TV Tokyo’s official listing records a 6:55–7:25 p.m. broadcast that day. As of this October 26 update, that date is in the past. It is a Japanese broadcast date, not a simultaneous worldwide streaming launch. Watch the official announcement Find the preview through Crunchyroll’s October 9 trailer coverage . The existing article also links the Pokémon YouTube upload and official anime announcement . For episode dates and the premise of the Paldea investigation, consult the broadcaster’s listing below. A promotional video and a television schedule answer different questions about the same story. Explore the anime release calendar and latest news . What the official episode synopsis establishes TV Tokyo places the October 16 story at Orange Academy's school festival. Liko and her companions receive a request from Raifort to investigate unusual phenomena around Paldea. The incidents appear to be occurring near shrines associated with an ancient calamity. The synopsis also says Navie meets Team Star during the visit. These are details from the broadcaster's advance description, rather than a claim that the trailer reveals every event in the episode. This makes the shrines the useful starting point for understanding the news. The story connects a familiar Paldea location with a mystery affecting several places across the region. It does not follow that the anime will reproduce the games' quest in exactly the same order. A synopsis can establish an investigation and its setting without confirming who resolves it, which Pokémon are caught or how the conflict ends. Wonder Voyage and Wonders Ahead use different release calendars The Japanese arc name and the English season title should be kept distinct when checking availability. The Pokémon Company's October 6 international announcement names the fourth English season Pokémon Horizons: Season 4—Wonders Ahead and sets Part 1 for February 27, 2027, exclusively on Netflix in the United States. It also says further episodes will arrive later. That announcement describes Liko, Roy and the Rising Volt Tacklers continuing their travels, with Dot, Ult, Navie and a stowaway Ditto among the characters mentioned. It provides a season-level introduction rather than a dated list for every Japanese episode. Readers should therefore avoid treating February 27 as a separately confirmed release date for this particular Treasures of Ruin story. The press release does not provide that episode-by-episode mapping. Where the wider arc started The official May 8 Japanese announcement sets the start of Wonder Voyage for May 22 and introduces its new adventures for Liko, Roy, Dot and Ult. Its promotional visual includes Navie, Ditto, Koraidon and Miraidon. That earlier announcement helps place the October trailer inside a continuing arc, rather than presenting it as the start of an unrelated Pokémon series. For viewers catching up, choose the regional edition you are actually watching before comparing dates or episode numbers. Japanese broadcast information, a trailer's upload date and a Netflix season launch describe different releases. Use the linked official announcements for their respective territories, and check your local service for the episodes currently available to your account. Updated October 26, 2026. entries.content: 2027 · RETURNING SERIES · OCTOBER 24, 2026 Prisma Illya FINALE: 2027 Release, Cast & Broadcast Update Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya FINALE will begin Japanese television broadcasts in 2027 on TOKYO MX, ABC TV and AT-X. The October 18 announcement confirms the broadcasters, while an exact premiere month, episode count and international streaming service remain unannounced in the cited materials. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases ©2027 Hiroshi Hiroyama, TYPE-MOON / KADOKAWA / Fate/kaleid liner Prisma Illya FINALE Production Committee. Official promotional image from the production website . Release at a glance Release window 2027 · exact month and day TBA Japan TOKYO MX, ABC TV and AT-X Studio SILVER LINK. International streaming Not confirmed in the cited announcements Official sources checked October 24, 2026 · Official website What changed in the October 18 announcement? The franchise revealed the named Japanese broadcasters during its Machi Asobi stage event on October 18. The official broadcaster notice confirms a 2027 television start on TOKYO MX, ABC TV and AT-X. It does not give an opening day or weekly airtime. The 2027 television project was already announced in July. The October update therefore adds broadcast destinations rather than a new premiere date. Readers should keep that distinction when comparing older announcement stories with the latest schedule information. Is FINALE a television series or another movie? FINALE is a television production. The July announcement from KADOKAWA presents it as the anime series' conclusion. The official site connects the project to the previously announced continuation of Prisma Illya Licht: The Nameless Girl . This is a continuation of the Prisma Illya story, rather than an announced standalone reboot. Viewers looking for a first entry should distinguish the earlier television installments and films from the forthcoming FINALE release. Returning studio, staff and Japanese cast The official FINALE website lists SILVER LINK. as the animation studio. Shin Oonuma returns as director, with Ken Takahashi as series director, Kenji Inoue and Hazuki Minase on scripts, and Kazuya Hirata on character design. Mai Kadowaki as Illyasviel von Einzbern Kaori Nazuka as Miyu Edelfelt Chiwa Saito as Chloe von Einzbern Sumire Morohoshi as Pandora Natsuki Hanae as Julian Ainsworth Katsuyuki Konishi as Darius Ainsworth These are Japanese voice credits. They do not establish an English dub cast or a dubbed release schedule. What is the final story about? The official introduction places Illya, Miyu and Chloe against Darius as the consequences of opening Pandora's box threaten their world. The continuation builds on the Ainsworth storyline and the mystery surrounding Pandora. That framing is also why FINALE should not be presented as an unrelated new Fate adaptation. Official visuals and promotional videos The official site displays the FINALE promotional artwork, including its second teaser visual. The image above is the production's official social preview for this specific project, rather than artwork from an older film. Related reading: Kagurabachi Episodes 1–2 to Premiere March 25, 2027: World Tour Finale Details . For current promotional materials, use the official FINALE site . No FINALE-specific playable YouTube trailer has been verified for this guide; a video for an earlier Prisma Illya installment should not be relabeled as a trailer for the new series. Where will Prisma Illya FINALE stream? The October announcement identifies Japanese television channels. It does not announce worldwide streaming, subtitle languages or regional availability. Previous installments' distribution arrangements cannot establish where FINALE will be licensed. What is still unconfirmed? The exact premiere date, episode count, international streaming partner and English dub timetable are not established by the cited announcements. This same guide can be updated when the production or a regional distributor publishes those details. For more confirmed announcements, browse our latest anime news and January 2027 anime guide . A Japanese broadcast announcement does not establish international streaming availability. Should you watch earlier entries before FINALE? Yes, especially if Prisma Illya is new to you. The official announcement calls FINALE the end of the anime series, and KADOKAWA’s July update describes it as a continuation tied to the film Licht: The Nameless Girl . The current synopsis begins after Illya’s battle with the Ainsworth family and centers on Darius, Pandora, Illya, Miyu and Chloe, so the returning conflict matters to the setup. A practical catch-up route is to watch the TV entries in release order— Prisma Illya , Zwei! , Zwei Herz! and 3rei!! —then see Licht before FINALE. The franchise also has other films and specials; the new announcement does not say that every side story is required. Use the official series portal and the official Licht film site to identify those earlier entries. This is a practical viewing route, not a checklist issued by the production committee. How should readers compare the July and October updates? The two announcements answer different questions. KADOKAWA introduced FINALE as a 2027 television project in July; the October 18 notice later named TOKYO MX, ABC TV and AT-X. The newer broadcaster list does not narrow the year to a particular month or day. If another article gives a specific premiere date without a separate production or station notice, that date should be treated as unconfirmed. The same distinction applies to airtime: a confirmed channel list is not yet a weekly schedule. Checking the official FINALE site and the listed Japanese stations is the clearest way to follow a later timetable without confusing a new detail with the earlier announcement. What does the returning cast confirm? The six published Japanese cast credits cover Illya, Miyu, Chloe and Pandora, along with Julian and Darius from the Ainsworth side of the conflict. They confirm returning roles at the center of the announced story, but the production has not described this as a complete cast list. These names also do not confirm an English dub, dubbing studio or overseas schedule. For someone deciding whether FINALE stands alone, the returning characters and the official synopsis point to a direct continuation of the Ainsworth storyline rather than a separate entry. Viewers can treat the July cast notice as a first group of credits and wait for later announcements for additional roles.
