entries.title: SSS-Class Revival Hunter Anime: January 2027 Premiere, New Trailer, Cast and Crunchyroll
entries.description: SSS-Class Revival Hunter premieres January 2027. The second official trailer reveals eight more cast members and an ending theme collaboration. Here is what is confirmed.
entries.content: OFFICIAL ANIME NEWS · OCTOBER 12, 2026 SSS-Class Revival Hunter Anime: January 2027 Premiere, New Trailer, Cast and Crunchyroll The Korean fantasy hit's TV anime arrives in January 2027. A second promotional video brings eight additional Japanese voice actors into focus and reveals the artists behind its ending theme. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official promotional visual. Source and artwork credit: official anime website . Release at a glance Release January 2027; exact date pending Where to watch Crunchyroll in announced territories, including the Americas Applies to Japan broadcast window and licensed international streaming Still pending Exact premiere day and regional episode times Release details checked October 24, 2026 · Official source When does SSS-Class Revival Hunter premiere? January 2027 is the confirmed Japanese television premiere window for SSS-Class Revival Hunter (Japanese title Shishite Ikiru SSS-kyu Hunter ). The official site lists Fuji TV's +Ultra programming block and other channels. An exact premiere day and episode count have not yet been announced. What does the second trailer confirm about the premiere? The October 11, 2026 promotional video introduces more of Kim Gongja's story and its cast, but no exact broadcast date. The production currently specifies January 2027 on Fuji TV's +Ultra block and other Japanese channels. An episode count and international streaming schedule remain unannounced. Related reading: ONE PIECE: Elbaph Arc English Dub Release Date and Crunchyroll Schedule . Second official trailer reveals new characters On October 11, 2026, the production published its second promotional video after a New York Comic Con preview. YouTube’s original metadata credits HAYATE’s channel and records the upload at 6:30:00 p.m. PDT (UTC−07:00) on October 10 — 10:30:00 a.m. JST on October 11 . That is the video’s upload timestamp, not an anime broadcast time. The trailer follows F-rank hunter Kim Gongja as he gains a rare ability tied to his own death and encounters the Sword Emperor, rival hunters and powerful guild leaders. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Opens on YouTube Watch the second promotional video on YouTube . Confirmed Japanese voice cast The latest announcement adds eight performers to the two previously confirmed leads: Takeo Otsuka as Kim Gongja. Satoshi Hino as Sword Emperor. Toshiki Masuda as Flame Emperor. Megumi Han as Witch of the Black Dragon. Sayaka Kinoshita as Paladin. Risa Shimizu as Countess. Makoto Furukawa as Poisonous Viper. Natsumi Fujiwara as Inquisitor. Yuka Iguchi as Master Alchemist. Shunsuke Sakuya as Blade Saint. These names reflect the official October 11 cast announcement, not speculation based on the webcomic's character roster. Who performs the ending theme? The anime's ending theme is a collaboration between THE SPELLBOUND and BOOM BOOM SATELLITES . The artists were announced on October 11, but the song title and full audio were not revealed at that time. No opening theme should be assumed from this announcement. Studio, director and production staff STUDIO fu is producing the anime, with Hiroaki Sakurai directing, Sayuri Oba handling series scripts, and Takahiro Yoshimatsu designing the characters. Ryo Kawasaki and Tomoyuki Kono are credited for the music. These are the announced production roles as of October 2026. Where can you watch SSS-Class Revival Hunter? Crunchyroll has confirmed streaming in North, Central and South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, the CIS, the Indian subcontinent, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and Singapore. This is a distribution plan, not an exact same-day release timetable: the Japanese broadcast date, local episode time and subtitle availability are separate details. Crunchyroll has not published territory-specific launch times, so check the local catalog when the January schedule becomes more specific. What is SSS-Class Revival Hunter about? A mysterious tower filled with monsters attracts hunters chasing wealth and prestige. Kim Gongja begins as an overlooked F-rank hunter who envies the powerful Flame Emperor. When he gains an extraordinary S-rank ability, he discovers a dangerous condition: the power activates only when he dies . Together with the Sword Emperor, he begins a high-stakes climb that challenges the usual rules of the hunter genre. What does Gongja’s death-triggered skill do? Tapas’s official English webcomic listing clarifies the rule behind the hook: Gongja receives a skill that copies another hunter’s ability, but the exchange costs his life. After the Flame Emperor kills him, Gongja copies a second power that sends him back in time on death. The two linked rules explain the revival premise and why each fatal attempt can change his next move. This is source-material context; it does not confirm which chapters the anime will adapt. The anime adapts a Korean fantasy story that originated as a web novel by Sinnoa and later became a popular webcomic. The animated adaptation is a Japanese television production. Where can you read the source material? Tapas hosts the official English webcomic listing and credits Neida, Sinnoa and Bill K; Yen Press lists its English print volumes. These give readers options to start online or collect physical books, but they describe the source comic rather than the anime’s episode order. The production has not said how many chapters or story arcs the January 2027 season will cover, so a volume count is not yet a viewing guide. Frequently asked questions Is SSS-Class Revival Hunter coming out in 2026? No. The confirmed Japanese premiere window is January 2027. Will it stream on Crunchyroll? Yes, Crunchyroll has confirmed streaming in numerous regions, including the Americas and Europe. How many episodes will there be? The episode count has not been officially confirmed. Is there a new trailer? Yes. The official second PV was uploaded by HAYATE at 6:30:00 p.m. PDT (UTC−07:00) on October 10, 2026, which was 10:30:00 a.m. JST on October 11. It adds eight cast members and names the ending-theme artists. entries.content: OCTOBER 3 · 2026 Suikoden: The Anime — Schedule, Cast, Trailer and Game Guide The Suikoden II adaptation began in Japan on October 3, 2026. Check the weekly schedule after its expanded premiere, the official trailer, cast, story and guidance for viewers new to the games. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official Suikoden anime visual. © Konami Digital Entertainment / Suikoden: The Anime Project. Official production site . Release at a glance Japanese premiere October 3, 2026 · TOKYO MX 20:00 JST; expanded first episode Regular TOKYO MX slot Tuesdays 23:30 JST from October 13 Production KONAMI animation Streaming Japan’s listed services; international availability varies Checked October 24, 2026 · Official schedule When did Suikoden: The Anime premiere? Suikoden: The Anime began its Japanese rollout on October 3, 2026, with a 60-minute expanded first episode on TOKYO MX at 20:00 JST. That is 11:00 UTC. The production announced a progressive rollout across 32 Japanese stations, so October 3 is the first broadcast date rather than the start date of every channel. The extended opening also should not be taken as the standard runtime of the later episodes. What is the regular weekly schedule? After the opening special, TOKYO MX moved to Tuesdays at 23:30 JST from October 13. October 6 was reserved for a special program about the Suikoden franchise. BS Asahi began its own run on October 9, with a Friday 23:30 JST slot. The shift from a Saturday premiere to a Tuesday weekly slot is important if you are looking for the next television episode: the opening event does not define the regular broadcast day. How do the late-night Japanese listings work? Kansai TV lists its first episode on October 6 at 25:34 and later episodes from October 13 at 25:19. In ordinary calendar notation, those mean October 7 at 01:34 JST and Wednesdays at 01:19 JST, respectively. Other local stations have their own starting times. Use the official station-by-station table rather than copying a late-night hour without its date convention; otherwise a reminder can end up on the wrong calendar day. Related reading: Ranma 1/2 Season 3: Netflix Schedule, Cast and Watch Guide . Where can you stream Suikoden? Japan’s official on-air page lists streaming services beginning progressively after 20:00 JST on October 3. They include Prime Video, U-NEXT, ABEMA, Hulu, d Anime Store and others. This is a Japanese distribution list, not a worldwide rights map. The page also warns that schedules may change. For viewing outside Japan, check a locally licensed title listing and its episode availability rather than assuming that a familiar service name guarantees the same release in your country. What is the story about? The anime adapts Suikoden II, the Konami role-playing game. Its central figures are Riliu and his childhood friend Jowy, two members of the Highland Kingdom’s youth brigade in the Dunan region. They share a camp and hopes of returning to ordinary life when the fighting ends. Instead, war draws them into events that test what they believe and what they are willing to do with power. The official introduction frames their friendship and choices as the human center of the conflict. Who are the main characters and actors? Toshiki Kumagai voices Riliu, Shimba Tsuchiya plays Jowy, and Ayumi Hinohara voices Nanami, who grew up alongside them. Katsuyuki Konishi plays the mercenary Viktor, Yuichi Nakamura plays Flik, and Taku Yashiro voices Luca Blight. These are Japanese performance credits from the production’s English cast list. They do not confirm an English dub. New viewers can start by following the three childhood companions before trying to memorize every name in the larger ensemble. Related reading: My Happy Marriage Special Episodes: Release Date & Netflix Guide . Who is producing the adaptation? KONAMI animation is credited with production and producing, while NBCUniversal Entertainment Japan handles planning. The official English page names YUZO as chief director, Michihiro Tsuchiya for series composition and Ryo Yamauchi for anime character design. Fumi Ishikawa is credited for the game character designs, and Arata Suzuki for the anime character-design basis. Separating those roles helps explain how the adaptation acknowledges the game’s artwork while having its own animation production team. Do you need to play Suikoden II first? Playing the game is optional preparation, not a requirement established by the broadcast announcement. The anime introduces its own version of the characters and conflict; newcomers can follow it from the opening episode. For existing players, the useful question is how the adaptation presents those relationships, not whether the show reproduces every battle, recruitment option or gameplay system. Avoid later game walkthroughs if you want to experience the political turns without knowing the outcome. Related reading: So What's Wrong with Getting Reborn as a Goblin? Release Guide . Which songs are used? The opening is Kanashimi Sae Otonobite by amazarashi. Koji Nakamura supplies the music and performs the ending, closed eye sun, featuring Honoka Takahashi. The official site separates the creditless opening and ending videos from the promotional trailers. Choose the third PV if you want an overview of the anime’s advertised story and release; choose the creditless theme videos if you are specifically looking for the opening or ending animation without the on-screen production credits. Watch the official third trailer The third PV is linked from the official anime site and published by NBCUniversal Anime/Music. Its original YouTube metadata records September 17, 2026, at 20:03:59 UTC−07:00, equivalent to September 18 at 03:03:59 UTC and 12:03:59 JST. Its duration is 2 minutes 1 second. That date belongs to the trailer upload, not the October broadcast. The official poster below opens the original video directly if an embedded player is unavailable. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER ON YOUTUBE NBCUniversal Anime/Music · Third PV Open the original third PV on YouTube → How does this fit the wider Suikoden series? Konami’s portal identifies the anime specifically as an adaptation of Suikoden II. It separately lists Suikoden I & II HD Remaster and the new game Suikoden STAR LEAP. The portal also links a manga adaptation of the anime. Those are different formats and projects: a game launch trailer is not an anime episode, and STAR LEAP’s updates do not set the television show’s schedule. Start with the anime’s own website when searching for broadcast or casting news. What should viewers check next? The reviewed schedule establishes when the Japanese television and streaming rollout began, but does not guarantee identical worldwide release times or language options. It also does not, by itself, establish which game scenes will make the final adaptation. Check the anime’s current episode listings for viewing order and the relevant local distributor for subtitles or dubbing. A 60-minute opening and a large cast should not be used to calculate the season’s exact episode count. Sources checked October 24, 2026: official Japanese schedule ; official English story, cast and staff ; official Japanese production site and music ; Konami’s Suikoden portal ; original official third PV . entries.content: NOVEMBER 27 · ANIME MOVIE Takopi's Original Sin: Thank You, See You Tomorrow Release Date Takopi returns to theaters in Japan on November 27, 2026. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official main trailer image for the Japanese theatrical film. Source: TBS Animation official trailer . Release at a glance Release date November 27, 2026 · Japanese theaters Format Theatrical re-edit of all six television episodes with newly produced scenes Animation studio ENISHIYA International release Not announced Details checked October 23, 2026 · Official TBS update How the movie differs from the television anime The theatrical version brings the six-episode story together in one cinema presentation and adds newly created scenes. That makes it a different viewing format, not a continuation set after the television ending. Readers who have already watched the series can decide whether the new material and theatrical presentation justify revisiting a story they know; the Japanese cinema date alone does not establish international availability. When does the Takopi movie release? Takopi's Original Sin: Thank You, See You Tomorrow opens in Japanese theaters on November 27, 2026. The theatrical version revisits the complete television anime while adding material created specifically for the movie presentation. Should existing viewers expect a completely new sequel? No. TBS describes the film as a theatrical re-edit of the six-episode anime with additional newly produced scenes. That makes the November 27 Japanese cinema release a different presentation of the existing story rather than a confirmed sequel set after its ending. The announcement does not detail how much new animation appears or which moments it covers. Read the official TBS film announcement. Related reading: Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san? Anime Release Date: January 7, 2027 . What does the theatrical edit include? The film combines material from all six television episodes with newly created scenes. The announcement does not specify the length of that added footage, so it would be premature to describe the film as an entirely new story or to promise particular scenes. What is Takopi's Original Sin about? Takopi is an alien who arrives on Earth hoping to spread happiness. After meeting Shizuka, he uses mysterious Happy Gadgets in an attempt to restore her smile, only to discover that the problems surrounding her family and school life cannot be solved with simple magical tools. Related reading: Walking Home with You Anime . Where to watch The November 27 release is currently confirmed for Japanese cinemas. An international theatrical or streaming release has not been announced. Watch the official movie video ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Takopi’s Original Sin official movie promotional video Watch the official trailer on YouTube. Editorial context: The November cinema version should not be confused with a second television season or a continuation of the original ending. It packages the six-episode adaptation into a theatrical presentation and adds footage specifically for that version. Viewers seeking the existing series can distinguish it from the film by its separate release format; international cinema and streaming arrangements remain unannounced. See all confirmed November 2026 releases → Official production announcement: TBS November 27 theatrical edit and additional footage . What the October 23 trailer and song announcement add TBS released the movie’s full trailer and a newly drawn visual on October 23, then confirmed “らびゅー” by Tele as the theme song. The update gives viewers two concrete pieces of the film’s identity beyond its November 27 Japanese theatrical date: a campaign song and a new visual illustrated by character designer Keita Nagahara. It also confirms that the project’s publicity is now moving from the initial date announcement into the final pre-release period. The trailer is useful for seeing how the six-episode television story is being presented for theaters, but it does not establish how many minutes of new animation the edit contains. TBS has described the film as a theatrical compilation with newly produced scenes; the amount and placement of that material remain unspecified. The trailer and theme song also do not confirm an international cinema or streaming plan. Readers outside Japan should treat November 27 as a Japan-only date unless a distributor announces additional territories. Watch TBS’s October 23 official full trailer . Source: TBS official movie update, October 23, 2026 . What should viewers check before buying a ticket? The official announcement confirms the Japanese cinema date and describes the film as a re-edit of all six television episodes with newly created scenes. It does not specify the movie’s runtime, the amount of new footage, a ticket-sale date or screenings outside Japan. Those details should remain open until TBS or a distributor publishes them. A trailer can show scenes selected for promotion, but it does not establish how much of the finished theatrical cut is new. For readers comparing updates, the safest distinction is between the confirmed November 27 Japan release and the still-unannounced international plan. The official film site is the best place to check for later theater, ticket and distribution notices. Updated: October 23, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.title: A Tale of the Secret Saint: Release Date and Streaming
entries.description: A Tale of the Secret Saint premieres October 3, 2026 on Crunchyroll. Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026.
entries.content: FALL 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE A Tale of the Secret Saint: Release Date and Streaming A Tale of the Secret Saint premieres October 3, 2026 on Crunchyroll. Release date, studio and streaming details for Fall 2026. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional visual. Artwork source: official release announcement . RELEASE DATE October 3, 2026 STREAMING Crunchyroll STUDIO FelixFilm Release at a glance Release October 3, 2026 Where to watch Crunchyroll in licensed territories Region and timing Platform premiere. Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Crunchyroll’s A Tale of the Secret Saint series page Why keeping the heroine's identity secret matters The central tension is not simply whether the heroine can become stronger. Her memories suggest she already possesses extraordinary potential, while revealing it could change her position in the world around her. That makes secrecy and self-restraint part of the story's appeal, especially for viewers who prefer fantasy built around hidden identity rather than straightforward power progression. When does A Tale of the Secret Saint premiere? A Tale of the Secret Saint premieres October 3, 2026. Crunchyroll carries the series internationally as part of its Fall 2026 lineup. Where to watch The announced Crunchyroll territories include North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS, the Indian Subcontinent, Southeast Asia and Korea. Availability and episode timing can still vary by individual market. What is A Tale of the Secret Saint about? The story follows a swordswoman who believes she has little talent until memories of a previous life reveal that she was once a powerful Saint. That knowledge gives her extraordinary magical potential, but openly revealing it would also expose her to enemies connected to her former life. What separates the heroine's present and past lives? The official premise places the heroine's sword training in her current life and her Saint abilities in memories of a former one. Her problem is not only discovering that power but deciding when it is safe to reveal it. This gives viewers a way to follow the central tension without assuming that her companions will immediately learn the truth or that every confrontation will be resolved through magic. Those outcomes are not established by the synopsis. Who is making the anime? FelixFilm is the animation studio for the adaptation. The series combines fantasy adventure with a reincarnation mystery built around the heroine hiding abilities that could completely change how others see her. What viewers can follow as the story develops The heroine's decision to conceal her Saint identity creates two separate questions: how she will train as a swordswoman in her current life, and when her past-life knowledge becomes too important to hide. The official premise establishes that tension but does not confirm which characters will discover her secret. Related reading: The True Saint Was Banished Anime: January 2027 & Trailer . See the Fall 2026 anime calendar for other confirmed October premieres. The release is underway, so check episode availability locally The series premiered on October 3, 2026, and Crunchyroll’s October 5 update confirms it is streaming there as it airs. That update also points readers to creditless opening and ending videos, a useful official extra for viewers who want the songs and animation without episode credits. Those videos are promotional material; they do not announce an episode total or change the series’ weekly broadcast calendar. Crunchyroll’s page lists audio and subtitle options, including Spanish varieties, but those choices can vary by market and account. A show page may display language tracks differently across regions, so the local episode player is the reliable final check. The article’s release date tells viewers when the season began; it does not guarantee that every episode is already available at the moment they read it. What the reincarnation premise actually sets up Fia wants to become a knight despite believing she has little talent with a sword. Near death, she remembers a previous life as the Saint who defeated the Demon King. The story then places two lives in tension: her present effort to become a knight and the powerful abilities she associates with that earlier identity. Her decision to keep those abilities secret gives the premise its practical question—when can she help someone without exposing herself? The official synopsis establishes that the past-life memory also brings back enemies. It does not establish that every friend knows the truth, or that each problem is resolved through the Saint’s power. The anime’s director and studio credits, and the current streaming listing, are more useful confirmed details than trying to predict how the secret will be revealed. Readers can follow the weekly release and revisit the official episode page for current language options; AniNextUp will update the schedule if the distributor announces a break or a new availability region. Updated: October 23, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error Official references: Crunchyroll anime production and premiere coverage and regional availability .

entries.content: OCTOBER 4 · 2026 TANK CHAIR Anime Release Date, Schedule & Where to Watch The dark action anime TANK CHAIR begins October 4, 2026, with new broadcasts scheduled weekly. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases PREMIERE October 4, 2026 Release at a glance Release October 4, 2026; 23:30 JST for advance streaming Where to watch Prime Video in Japan first Region and timing Other Japanese streaming services begin October 7; international dates are separate. Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Tank Chair official announcement How the siblings' relationship drives the premise Nagi's unusual response to murderous intent creates an action-story paradox: the danger Shizuka wants to survive is also what can briefly bring her brother back into action. Her determination to awaken him gives the battles a family motive rather than making them isolated fights. The synopsis does not establish whether the plan will succeed, so that outcome remains an open question. Why the streaming schedule needs a regional check The Sunday 11:30 p.m. Prime Video window is explicitly a Japanese advance-streaming arrangement. It does not establish that Prime Video in every other country carries the show. The Wednesday rollout on other Japanese services is a separate distribution stage. For readers abroad, the most useful question is which local platform has confirmed rights, not merely which Japanese service is first. When does TANK CHAIR premiere? TANK CHAIR premieres in Japan on October 4, 2026. TOKYO MX begins the series Sundays at 11:00 p.m. JST, with BS11 following at 12:30 a.m. Additional broadcasts begin on CBC October 5 and MBS October 6. Related reading: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Schedule & Where to Watch . TANK CHAIR weekly schedule The main TOKYO MX broadcast is scheduled every Sunday at 11:00 p.m. JST. The official anime site says Prime Video begins advance streaming in Japan at 11:30 p.m. on the same day as the main broadcast. Where to watch TANK CHAIR Prime Video has the earliest announced Japanese streaming window, starting Sundays at 11:30 p.m. JST on October 4. The official distribution notice also lists other Japanese subscription platforms starting sequentially on Wednesdays at 11:30 p.m. JST from October 7. These Japanese schedules do not establish availability on Prime Video or other services outside Japan. Related reading: Black Clover Season 2 Schedule & Where to Watch . What is TANK CHAIR about? Nagi Taira was once a powerful assassin. After protecting his sister Shizuka from gunfire, he remains unresponsive until murderous intent is directed toward him. Shizuka begins taking her brother into battles against increasingly dangerous enemies in an attempt to fully awaken him. What to check before watching outside Japan The confirmed Prime Video advance window and the later Wednesday streaming rollout both describe services in Japan. Neither is proof that a viewer in another country can find the series in the same Prime Video catalog. The practical next step is to check a distributor's announcement for your territory or the episode page in your local service. The official schedule also separates TOKYO MX's Sunday broadcast from BS11's after-midnight airing; these are different channels, not separate episode premieres. Official character teaser ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER TANK CHAIR Official AniNextUp: Streaming availability and times can vary by region. This page will be updated as new official distribution information is announced. entries.title: The Boxer Anime: Release Date, Cast, Studios & Teaser
entries.description: The Boxer anime has a confirmed cast, studios and Crunchyroll streaming plans, but no release date. See the official teaser, story and latest verified details.
entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 13, 2026 The Boxer Anime: Release Date, Cast, Studios & Teaser The acclaimed Korean boxing webtoon by JH is being adapted into a television anime. A teaser, four lead voice actors and key production staff are confirmed, but no premiere date has been announced. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Editorial policy Official teaser thumbnail. Source: LINE Digital Frontier's announcement . Release at a glance Premiere To be announced Format TV anime Animation breccia × STUDIO JEMI Streaming Crunchyroll; territories and launch date pending Official WEBTOON Entertainment announcement Is The Boxer getting an anime? Yes. The Boxer , the Korean webtoon created by JH, has been confirmed as a television anime. The adaptation was announced during the Crunchyroll Showcase at New York Comic Con on October 8, 2026. WEBTOON Entertainment announced the partnership, and LINE Digital Frontier published the Japanese project details the following day, including cast, staff and an official announcement PV. This confirms that the anime is in production; it does not confirm when it will premiere. When will The Boxer anime be released? No premiere month, year, Japanese broadcast slot or episode count has been announced as of October 23, 2026. Crunchyroll has said it plans to stream the series in the future, but that statement is not a launch schedule. It also does not identify every country where the show will be available. Treat a predicted 2027 debut or a claimed weekly schedule as speculation unless the production committee, broadcaster or platform publishes it. For viewers tracking updates, keep three questions separate: when the Japanese broadcast begins, when streaming starts, and which territories receive the stream. A date for one service or country would not automatically answer the other two. AniNextUp will update this guide when an official source supplies those details. Who is in The Boxer anime cast? The first four announced voice actors are Koki Uchiyama as Yu, Kensho Ono as Ryu, Tomokazu Seki as trainer K, and Toshiyuki Toyonaga as J. The Japanese announcement uses the character names Yuki and Ryusanpaku for Yu and Ryu, while English-language coverage commonly uses Yu and Ryu. These are differences in how the names are rendered across editions, not additional characters. The announcement identifies these four roles; it is not a complete cast list for the full webtoon. Which studios and staff are making the anime? Japan’s breccia and South Korea’s STUDIO JEMI are handling animation production. Takehiro Kubota and KANG Wonyeong are the co-directors. Toshiya Ono is credited with series composition and scripts, and Masahiro Suwa is the character designer. BLUE RIGHTS is the creative producer, while HAYATE is named as producer. These are the project’s announced credits; no episode count or production timetable has been released. What is The Boxer about? The story follows Yu, a teenager whose extraordinary reactions and movement catch the attention of trainer K. K is searching for a final prodigy to train when he encounters Yu being attacked. Yu appears emotionally detached, but K recognizes a rare physical talent. The boxing story then places Yu against opponents who have their own ambitions and pressures. That setup gives the series a different question from a conventional underdog story: what happens when ability arrives before motivation or emotional connection? The premise invites readers to watch how Yu, K and the people they meet respond to that imbalance. It does not establish that every opponent is merely an obstacle or reveal how the anime will adapt later developments. This summary stays with the officially introduced setup and avoids spoilers. Where can you read the original webtoon? JH’s The Boxer began serialization on NAVER WEBTOON in 2019. LINE Manga carried its Japanese edition from 2020 through 2022. LINE Digital Frontier reported more than 1.06 billion worldwide views as of September 2026; that is a publisher-reported platform figure, not an independently audited sales total or a count of anime viewers. Readers can find the Japanese edition on the official LINE Manga page . Language options and access depend on the service and region, so check the platform’s listing for your location. Watch the official announcement teaser The video is the project’s official announcement PV, rather than a release-date trailer: no premiere date accompanies it. LINE Digital Frontier linked the teaser from its October 9 announcement. The official YouTube upload metadata lists the upload time as October 8, 2026, at 3:00:27 p.m. PDT. That upload time is distinct from both the announcement date and the date of this article. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER ON YOUTUBE Opens the official HAYATE Inc. video Watch the official The Boxer teaser on YouTube . What is confirmed, and what remains unknown? Confirmed details include the television adaptation, the four named voice actors, the listed production staff, and Crunchyroll’s future streaming plan. Still unknown are the premiere date, broadcast network, episode total, episode length, complete international territory list and timing for another trailer. A platform commitment tells viewers where the anime is expected to stream in some markets; it does not answer when it will appear in each catalog. This distinction helps separate confirmed news from fan predictions. Quick answers Has a 2027 premiere been confirmed? No. The official announcements do not give a year or month. Is the video a full trailer? It is the official announcement teaser PV. No release date is attached to it. Will The Boxer stream on Crunchyroll? Crunchyroll has announced future streaming plans. The start date and market-by-market availability are pending. Official sources WEBTOON Entertainment — The Boxer and the adaptation partnership LINE Digital Frontier — cast, staff, story and teaser announcement Crunchyroll — anime announcement and streaming plans Official The Boxer announcement PV on YouTube Updated: October 23, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.content: OFFICIAL NEWS · OCTOBER 13, 2026 The Fable Season 2: January 9, 2027 Premiere, Cast and Visual The Fable Season 2 starts on Nippon TV in Japan on January 9, 2027 at 24:55 JST (January 10 at 00:55). A new main visual and six additional cast members are confirmed; international streaming remains unannounced. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · Published: October 13, 2026 · Editorial policy Official Season 2 teaser artwork via VAP / The Fable anime production . © Katsuhisa Minami / Kodansha / The Fable production committee. Release at a glance Premiere January 9, 2027 at 24:55 JST (January 10, 00:55) Broadcaster Nippon TV network (Japan) Studio Tezuka Productions Global streaming Not announced for Season 2 Official release information October 14 update: Yamaoka arc cast and main visual The official production has revealed the main visual for The Fable Season 2 's Yamaoka arc and confirmed six additional Japanese voice actors. Koichi Yamadera voices Yamaoka, with Takanori Hoshino as Azami, Hiroyuki Yoshino as Yukari, Satoshi Mikami as Koji Mizuno, Taiten Kusunoki as Jiro and Masayuki Fujiwara as Suzumushi. The official anime homepage now confirms January 9, 2027 at 24:55 JST on Nippon TV. Japanese television listings use the January 9 broadcast day for the slot, which falls on January 10 at 00:55 JST by calendar date. An international streaming service remains unannounced. See the official updated cast list → Related reading: Inherit the Winds Anime: January 2027 Premiere, November Theater Preview and New Visual . When does The Fable Season 2 premiere? The second season of The Fable is scheduled on Japan's Nippon TV network for Saturday, January 9, 2027 at 24:55 JST (technically Sunday, January 10 at 00:55). This is the official Japanese television schedule, not a confirmed international simulcast time. The new season adapts the Yamaoka arc from Katsuhisa Minami's manga. Why does the January 9 listing become January 10 on the clock? Nippon TV's Japanese schedule uses January 9 at 24:55 JST , a late-night television convention. On a standard calendar clock that is January 10 at 00:55 JST . These labels describe the same Japanese broadcast slot, not two separate premieres. No international streaming hour follows automatically from the Japanese television schedule. Confirmed returning voice cast The official anime website currently confirms returning cast including Kazuyuki Okitsu as Akira Sato, Miyuki Sawashiro as Yoko Sato and Kana Hanazawa as Misaki Shimizu. Further cast additions should be checked against the production's latest announcements. Related reading: Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend Anime: 2027 Release, Main Cast and First Visual . Production and official teaser Ryosuke Takahashi directs the adaptation at Tezuka Productions. The September 15, 2026 official announcement unveiled a teaser video for the next chapter of the story. The official production website hosts the promotional materials and the April 2026 teaser visual. Readers can view the authentic artwork and teaser on the official website. Watch The Fable Season 2 official teaser The production's September teaser introduces the darker Yamaoka arc and the returning characters. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER VAP Official Watch the official teaser on YouTube if the embedded player is unavailable. What is The Fable about? Akira Sato is an exceptionally skilled assassin ordered to live a normal life without killing for a year. His effort to stay out of violence is challenged by new conspiracies. The anime adapts Katsuhisa Minami’s manga, published by Kodansha. Where to watch Nippon TV is confirmed for the Japanese broadcast. An international streaming release for Season 2 has not been confirmed in this announcement. Do not assume that a Season 1 streaming service will also carry the new season. What remains unconfirmed? The episode count, international distribution and English dub schedule have not been confirmed in the cited announcements. Official sources and updates Check the official The Fable anime website for the latest production announcements and official promotional artwork. The official news archive covers the earlier teaser announcement; the official anime homepage now displays the January 9, 2027, 24:55 JST broadcast schedule. AniNextUp will update this article when more distribution details are confirmed. Updated: October 16, 2026 · Sources, updates & corrections · Report an error

entries.title: The Moon on a Rainy Night Anime: 2027 Release, Trailer & Cast
entries.description: The Moon on a Rainy Night anime premieres in 2027. Watch the first official PV and see the confirmed cast, staff, studio and streaming status.
entries.content: 2027 · TV ANIME The Moon on a Rainy Night Anime: 2027 Release, Trailer & Cast The Moon on a Rainy Night is officially set for 2027, and its first full promotional video has revealed the two lead voice actors and more of the production team. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases RELEASE WINDOW 2027 · Exact date TBA The Moon on a Rainy Night (Amayo no Tsuki) will premiere as a TV anime in 2027. The October 7 update introduces the first PV, the voices of the leads and additional production details. What changed? Iori Saeki will voice Saki Kindaichi, while Sora Amamiya will voice Kanon Oikawa. Tomoe Makino directs at CompTown, Shogo Yasukawa handles series composition and scripts, Ayumi Nishihata is responsible for character design, and jizue composes the music. What the official synopsis reveals about Saki and Kanon According to the official anime introduction , Saki Kindaichi meets Kanon Oikawa on her way to a piano lesson shortly before entering high school. They reunite as classmates. Kanon is hard of hearing and has kept her distance from others, while Saki questions the assumptions made about her by people at school. Their gradually developing connection gives the story a character-focused premise rather than a mystery about a release-date reveal. This description does not predict how their relationship will develop in later episodes. Related reading: Fool Night Release Date: November 26 on Netflix . What is still unannounced for 2027? The production confirms a 2027 television release window, its lead cast and staff, and a first promotional video. A specific premiere month, episode count and international streaming distributor are not established by those announcements. Readers should avoid treating a speculative date or service as confirmed until the production or distributor publishes it. Why the 2027 window matters The anime adaptation had already been announced, but the new 2027 broadcast window gives viewers a concrete year to track. An exact month and premiere date have not been announced, so any more specific release claim remains unconfirmed. Official trailer ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL PV Official anime promotional video What is The Moon on a Rainy Night about? Based on Kuzushiro's manga, the story follows Saki Kindaichi and Kanon Oikawa, two high-school classmates whose relationship gradually develops after Saki meets Kanon on her way to a piano lesson shortly before high school begins. Kanon is hard of hearing, and the story places particular emphasis on communication, understanding and the distance between people. Where to watch A specific streaming service has not been announced for the 2027 TV broadcast. Kodansha previously said the anime is planned for streaming in various countries worldwide, but platform and territory details remain pending. What is still missing from the release plan? The first promotional video confirms the leads and production team, while 2027 remains the only announced broadcast window. Neither an exact month nor a specific international streaming service has been named. The mention of worldwide streaming plans does not establish which platforms will carry the series. FAQ When does The Moon on a Rainy Night anime come out? It is confirmed for 2027, but there is no exact date yet. Who voices Saki and Kanon? Iori Saeki voices Saki Kindaichi and Sora Amamiya voices Kanon Oikawa. Which studio is making the anime? Animation production is by CompTown. How the manga's central relationship shapes the anime Saki's interest in Kanon begins with a brief encounter before the two become classmates. Kanon's hearing impairment affects how she communicates with others, while Saki gradually realizes that reaching out requires patience and attention rather than assumptions. The adaptation's announced premise emphasizes the small moments through which their friendship and feelings develop. What the first promotional video actually confirms The October 7 promotional update establishes a 2027 television broadcast window and identifies the two principal performers: Iori Saeki as Saki and Sora Amamiya as Kanon. It also names Tomoe Makino as director, Shogo Yasukawa for series composition, Ayumi Nishihata for character designs and CompTown for animation production. These details are confirmed by the official production website . The video is not an episode schedule. No exact premiere day, international streaming platform or territory-by-territory launch timetable has been confirmed. Readers should treat those items as pending rather than extrapolating from the promotional video's publication date. AniNextUp: We distinguish confirmed release information from details that remain unannounced. This page will be updated when the production committee confirms a date or streaming platform. entries.content: NETFLIX ANIME · FEBRUARY 2027 THE ONE PIECE: February 2027 Release Date, Episodes & Trailer THE ONE PIECE sets sail on Netflix in February 2027. The new adaptation will revisit the East Blue Saga in seven episodes released together, with WIT Studio leading animation production. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official teaser image from Netflix Anime. Watch the teaser on YouTube . Release at a glance Premiere February 2027 Exact date Not announced Episodes Seven, released all at once Total runtime Around 300 minutes Where to watch Netflix Animation production WIT Studio Release details checked October 17, 2026 · Netflix Tudum When does THE ONE PIECE come out on Netflix? THE ONE PIECE premieres in February 2027 on Netflix. Netflix has confirmed the month, but not a specific day or time. Its current listing says all seven episodes will arrive at once, so the first season is planned as a complete drop rather than a weekly rollout. The announced season will run for about 300 minutes in total. Netflix has not published individual episode runtimes or a region-by-region release schedule. Viewers should check their local Netflix listing closer to launch for availability and language options. What is THE ONE PIECE about? This new anime adaptation starts at the beginning of Eiichiro Oda’s manga and follows the East Blue Saga. It introduces Monkey D. Luffy’s dream of becoming King of the Pirates and finding the legendary One Piece treasure, along with the early adventures that bring the Straw Hat crew together. Related reading: ONE PIECE: Elbaph Arc English Dub Release Date and Crunchyroll Schedule . Season 1 is set to adapt approximately the first 50 manga chapters. Netflix says the season’s endpoint will be Luffy’s encounter with Sanji at the floating restaurant Baratie. That gives the adaptation a defined starting stretch and destination, though Netflix has not announced how much time each episode will cover. Is this a remake of the original ONE PIECE anime? Netflix describes THE ONE PIECE as a new adaptation of the manga, beginning again with Chapter 1 and the East Blue Saga. It is a separate retelling of the source material, rather than a continuation of the long-running television anime. Netflix has not said that the original series is being replaced or discontinued. Related reading: Pokémon Horizons Season 4: Wonders Ahead Gets February 27, 2027 Netflix Date . The project is produced by WIT Studio in collaboration with Shueisha, Fuji Television Network and Toei Animation. The announced creative team includes director Masashi Koizuka, assistant director Hideaki Abe, series composer Taku Kishimoto, and character designers and chief animation directors Kyoji Asano and Takatoshi Honda. Who is in the voice cast? Mayumi Tanaka is confirmed as the Japanese voice of Luffy for THE ONE PIECE , according to the franchise’s official Japanese announcement. A complete voice cast list has not been published in the Netflix release guide. We will add other performers only when the production confirms them. Watch the official THE ONE PIECE teaser ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TEASER Netflix The teaser introduces the visual direction for Luffy’s journey and the East Blue story. It was published on Netflix’s official YouTube channel on June 24, 2026. Watch it on YouTube if the embedded player is unavailable. What remains unconfirmed? Netflix has not announced the exact premiere day, individual episode runtimes, full Japanese voice cast, dubbed-language cast, or the schedule for any season beyond Season 1. The confirmed information is specific: a February 2027 Netflix premiere, seven episodes released together, about 300 minutes in total and an adaptation of the opening East Blue material. entries.content: OCTOBER 2 · 2026 Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans Release Schedule & Where to Watch Tokyo Revengers is back with the War of the Three Titans arc, airing weekly from October 2. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases WHERE TO WATCH Disney+ / Hulu (U.S.) Release at a glance Release October 2, 2026 on Hulu in the U.S. Where to watch Hulu in the U.S.; Disney+ in announced international territories Region and timing Japan’s October 2 late-night slot occurs October 3 at 01:23 JST; Disney+ Japan follows at 02:00 JST. Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Disney+’s October 2026 programming announcement · Tokyo Revengers official broadcast schedule Why this arc rewards watching the earlier story The War of the Three Titans follows the Tenjiku conflict and continues Takemichi's relationship with Mikey and the competing factions. Knowing how those relationships changed in earlier arcs provides context that a list of newly introduced characters cannot replace. This is a continuation rather than an alternate starting point for the series. Understanding the late-night broadcast date Japanese broadcasters sometimes use an extended late-night clock so a program after midnight remains attached to the previous evening's schedule. This is why a Friday-night anime listing can fall on Saturday by ordinary calendar time. Streaming services publish separate release windows, so use the time shown in your local catalog. When did War of the Three Titans begin? Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titans began October 2, 2026. The official Japanese schedule labels the MBS/TBS slot as Friday late night at 25:23 JST (1:23 a.m. on Saturday in standard calendar notation). CBC, BS-TBS, AT-X and regional stations have their own broadcast schedules. Does Friday 25:23 mean Friday afternoon? No. The Japanese broadcast listing uses an extended late-night clock: Friday 25:23 JST means Saturday at 1:23 a.m. JST on a normal calendar. The separately listed Friday 26:00 streaming time corresponds to Saturday at 2:00 a.m. JST. Viewers should use their own platform's local listing rather than treating these Japanese schedule labels as universal release times. Related reading: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Releases “THE LAST PV” . Where to watch The official anime site announces Disney+ worldwide subscription streaming (excluding mainland China), while Disney's October 2026 U.S. schedule lists the arc on Hulu . Streaming availability depends on your country. The Japanese listing uses Friday late-night 26:00, meaning Saturday at 2:00 a.m. JST in ordinary calendar notation, shortly after the earliest Japanese broadcast. What is the War of the Three Titans arc? The new arc continues Takemichi Hanagaki's time-leap story after the Tenjiku conflict and brings the struggle surrounding Mikey into a new phase. Promotional material introduces major players including Takeomi Akashi, Wakasa Imaushi, Keizo Arashi and South Terano. Opening and ending themes JO1 performs the opening theme “IGNITE,” while go!go!vanillas performs the ending theme “Trickster.” Both songs were announced by the anime's official site ahead of the October broadcast. Related reading: Romelia War Chronicle: Release Date & Where to Watch . What to know before watching War of the Three Titans is a continuation of Tokyo Revengers, not a standalone reboot. It follows the events of the Tenjiku conflict and moves Takemichi's story into the next major struggle surrounding Mikey and the new factions competing for power. New viewers will get much more from this arc after watching the earlier Tokyo Revengers seasons and arcs. Tokyo Revengers FAQ Is War of the Three Titans a new season? It is the next major anime arc in the continuing Tokyo Revengers story. Do I need to watch Tenjiku first? Yes. This arc continues the existing story and assumes familiarity with Takemichi, Mikey and the events leading out of the Tenjiku conflict. Related reading: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Schedule & Where to Watch . Is it on Disney+? Disney+ is listed for international distribution by the anime's official site, while Disney's U.S. October 2026 schedule lists Hulu. New episodes are scheduled weekly; check your regional service for release times. How often are new episodes released? The announced schedule is weekly on Fridays, although the displayed day and time can shift by territory because of time-zone differences. Latest update: October 5, 2026 · Streaming and broadcast information checked against the official Tokyo Revengers site. Related reading: Black Clover Season 2 Schedule & Where to Watch . Weekly release schedule The arc is scheduled as a weekly Friday release. Broadcast times can differ across Japan, and Disney+ and Hulu availability and release times can differ by country and time zone. See the Fall 2026 anime calendar and streaming guide for more releases. entries.content: OCTOBER 10, 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE The Vermilion Mask Release Date, Time & Where to Watch The Vermilion Mask began its Japanese broadcast on October 10, 2026, with Crunchyroll announced internationally. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official anime promotional artwork. © Nabana Naba, Dr. Poro, SHONENGAHOSHA / The Vermilion Mask Production Committee. Official source . RELEASE October 10, 2026 JAPAN TV Saturdays · 17:30 JST STUDIO 100studio Release at a glance Release October 10, 2026 Where to watch Crunchyroll in licensed territories Region and timing Yomiuri TV/Nippon TV network: Saturdays at 17:30 JST; regional exceptions. Release details checked October 24, 2026 · Vermilion Mask production announcement · Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 anime lineup When did The Vermilion Mask premiere? The Vermilion Mask began its Japanese broadcast on October 10, 2026. The production announcement from HIKE sets the regular Yomiuri TV/Nippon TV network slot at Saturdays, 5:30 p.m. JST, with some regional exceptions. This is the domestic television appointment, not a universal streaming upload time. That Japanese slot corresponds to 08:30 UTC. Use the station's current listing if a particular weekend changes, rather than treating the opening date as a guarantee for every subsequent episode. Viewers outside Japan should check their own distributor before converting the television hour into a watch-party reminder. Where can you watch it? Crunchyroll is an announced international streaming home. Yomiuri Telecasting Corporation's English production release explicitly identifies an October Crunchyroll launch. A local episode page remains the practical check for whether the show is available to your account, and which audio and subtitle options it carries. Related reading: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Cour 2 Release Date & Time . The Japanese distribution notice also names domestic services, including TVer, ytv MyDo!, ABEMA and subscription platforms. These are separate market-specific options. A listing for a Japanese service does not establish that the same title is included in an identically named service abroad, or that every platform releases an episode simultaneously. This guide does not assign an English dub date. The confirmed production announcement and the Japanese cast list are not evidence of a dubbed release schedule. Check the language label beside the episode you intend to play instead of assuming all versions share the same availability. What is the story, without later-episode spoilers? Peru d'Arrest is an apprentice to mask maker Gaston Roux. A powerful mask takes control of Peru, and the resulting tragedy kills his companions and his master. Peru's response is to seek out and destroy the masks Gaston left across the world, hoping to prevent another catastrophe. Related reading: DARK MACHINE THE ANIMATION Release Date & Time . That premise gives the journey a different purpose from collecting powerful equipment. Peru is confronting the consequences of objects he once associated with his teacher. Our interpretation is that responsibility and regret provide the emotional stakes of the battles; this is a reading of the official setup, not a review claiming that we have watched every episode. What do the masks actually do? The official introduction establishes that wearing a mask can confer power, with disastrous consequences as well as advantages. The Mask of the Warrior God is central to the opening tragedy. The title therefore refers to objects that drive the conflict, rather than decorative costumes alone. Related reading: PSYREN Anime Release Date, Time & Where to Watch . For a first-time viewer, that is enough background to follow Peru's goal. The introduction does not give a complete catalogue of masks, their rules or the eventual outcome of the hunt. Treat a power shown briefly in promotional footage as a preview, not a full explanation of how every confrontation works. Which voice actors and studio are involved? The official English credits name Taihi Kimura as Peru, Yuuki Yamamoto as Sonarue Maywood and Kazuki Ura as Mok Sharib. Kazuhiko Inoue voices Gaston Roux, while Akio Otsuka voices the Mask of the Warrior God. These are the Japanese performances; they should not be presented as an English dub cast. Tetsuaki Watanabe directs, Gai Hazako is assistant director and Daisuke Ohigashi handles series composition. Hisashi Higashijima designs the characters and serves as chief animation director; Alisa Okehazama composes the music. The animation company is credited as One Double-O studio on the English site and 100studio in the Japanese announcement. Related reading: The World's Strongest Witch Release Date, Time & Where to Watch . What are the opening and ending songs? The announced opening is MAN WITH A MISSION's “Firestarter”; the ending is yutori's “Koe.” Yomiuri's release identifies both tracks in the second main promotional video. This helps distinguish the songs from the instrumental score credited to Okehazama when searching for music from the series. Watch the official second main PV The verified upload is on Yomiuri TV's official animation channel. Its original YouTube metadata records September 10, 2026, at 12:00:12 PDT (UTC−07:00) , equivalent to 19:00:12 UTC. That dates the trailer, not the anime premiere. The official production release links this same video. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL PV ON YOUTUBE Yomiuri TV official animation channel Watch the official PV directly on YouTube . “Second main PV” means a second major promotional video, not episode two of the series. It is a preview for people deciding whether to watch. Begin with episode one on the distributor rather than treating the trailer number as an episode-order guide. Is there a manga, and where should newcomers begin? The anime's official site identifies the source as the manga by Nabana Naba and Dr.Poro, serialized in Shonen Gahosha's Young King OURs. Readers wanting the original should look for those creator credits and the Japanese title, 朱色の仮面, rather than an unrelated novel with a similar English name. The announcements cited here do not provide an episode-to-chapter reading map or establish how much manga the season adapts. Starting at the beginning is the clearest reading option; matching a chapter number to an episode number could skip material. For viewing plans, compare the weekly anime schedule and release calendar , then confirm the current episode on your local service. entries.content: NOVEMBER 20 · ANIME MOVIE Armored Trooper VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1 Armored Trooper VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1 opens November 20, 2026 in Japan. Mamoru Oshii directs the new Sunrise theatrical anime. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Release at a glance Release November 20, 2026; first of two films Where to watch Japanese theaters Applies to Japanese theatrical opening Still pending International release and streaming availability Release details checked October 12, 2026 · Official source RELEASE November 20, 2026 FORMAT Japanese Theaters STUDIO Sunrise Why Ash Vamps is at the center of the mystery Set near the end of the Hundred Year War, the film's investigation begins with an unusual pattern: Ash Vamps repeatedly survives missions that kill her comrades. That makes the question of her survival a narrative hook within the franchise's military setting. The announced synopsis does not explain the cause, so any answer would be speculation rather than a verified plot detail. When does The Gray Witch Part 1 release? Armored Trooper VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1 opens in Japanese theaters on November 20, 2026. It is the first half of a new two-part theatrical project; a release date for Part 2 has not yet been announced. What is The Gray Witch about? The story is set near the end of the Hundred Year War and follows an investigation into Ash Vamps, a soldier nicknamed the Witch because she repeatedly returns alive from missions that kill the rest of her unit. The premise returns VOTOMS to its military science-fiction roots while introducing a new central mystery. Related reading: Ascendance of a Bookworm Part 4 Anime Officially Announced . Who is making the movie? Mamoru Oshii directs the project. Sunrise produces the animation with production cooperation from Production I.G, while Bandai Namco Filmworks handles distribution. Is November 20 the release date for both films? No. The announced November 20, 2026 Japanese theatrical opening applies only to The Gray Witch Part 1 . The project is planned in two parts, but the cited production details do not give Part 2 a date. A planned two-part format also does not establish a streaming release for either film. Related reading: One-Punch Man Season 3 Part 2: January 2027 Release, New Trailer and JAM Project Opening . Where to watch The November 20 date is for the Japanese theatrical release. No international streaming platform has been confirmed, so AniNextUp will not list one until an official announcement is made. Watch the official trailer ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER Official trailer See all confirmed November 2026 releases → New details announced before the premiere The official VOTOMS site has continued to add information since the first May announcement. Its October 23 update names “名も無き詩人のように” by Mika Nakashima as the theme song, with music provided by Toshihiko Takamizawa of THE ALFEE. The same update released a main visual and a final trailer. These are concrete additions to the project’s presentation; they do not change the confirmed November 20 Japanese theatrical opening for Part 1. The official cast announcement names the two central roles: Miyuki Sawashiro voices Ash Vamps, the AT pilot feared as the Witch, and Maki Stauffenberg, the officer assigned to investigate Ash, is voiced by Mabuki Ando. Other announced cast members include Yūichi Nakamura, Satoshi Tsuruoka, Tomokazu Sugita, Kenta Miyake, Chafūrin, Hōchū Ōtsuka and Daisuke Ono. The official site continues to publish character and mechanical details, so this page should be checked against that source as the release approaches. How to read the two-part announcement “Part 1” is important in the title: the production describes this as a two-part theatrical project, but the November date applies to the first film only. No date for the second part appears in the official announcement reviewed here. A ticket for the first film or a trailer for it cannot be used to infer when the follow-up will open. The setting near the end of the Hundred Year War and Ash’s repeated survival give the film a military mystery to follow. The official synopsis leaves the cause of that survival unexplained. Calling her a witch is how other soldiers view her; it is not confirmation of a supernatural explanation. For international viewers, the Japanese theatrical opening is confirmed, while overseas cinema bookings and streaming arrangements remain unannounced. entries.content: APRIL 2027 · TV ANIME Walking Home with You Anime Walking Home with You (Houkago Kitaku Biyori) premieres in April 2027 on Nippon TV. The newly confirmed TV window arrives with the anime's first teaser visual. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases RELEASE April 2027 Official promotional visual. Artwork source: official release announcement . BROADCAST Nippon TV FORMAT TV Anime Release at a glance Japanese release April 2027; exact day TBA Japanese broadcaster Nippon TV Format TV anime Streaming Not announced Release window checked October 23, 2026 against the linked official announcement. Why the April 2027 window is useful but incomplete A confirmed broadcast month gives readers a meaningful planning window without identifying an exact day or streaming service. The story's focus on Shun's interrupted soccer ambitions and his after-school connection with Naoki also suggests a quieter school-life romance rather than a conventional sports comeback. Cast, staff and platform claims should wait for further official announcements. When does Walking Home with You premiere? The anime is officially scheduled to begin airing on Nippon TV in April 2027 . An exact premiere day has not yet been announced. What changed? The adaptation now has both a confirmed television format and release month. The announcement also introduced the first anime teaser visual, turning the earlier adaptation announcement into a concrete Spring 2027 release target. What is Walking Home with You about? Mai Matsuda's school romantic comedy follows Shun Sato, a new high-school student who gave up his soccer dream after an injury, and his unusual upperclassman Naoki Sato. Their relationship develops through the so-called Hyper Going-Home Club and the everyday detours they share after school. Why this is not simply a sports comeback story Shun's abandoned soccer dream is part of the setup, but the announced story centers on the everyday connection he develops with Naoki through their after-school routine. That makes the injury an important piece of character background rather than proof that the anime will focus on competitive soccer. The official teaser announcement does not establish whether Shun returns to the sport, so a comeback arc should not be treated as confirmed. Related reading: Are You a Landmine, Chihara-san? Anime Release Date: January 7, 2027 . Cast, staff and studio Those details remain unconfirmed in the current production announcement for the April 2027 broadcast. AniNextUp will update this guide when the production committee announces the Japanese cast, principal staff or animation studio. Where to watch Nippon TV is confirmed for the Japanese broadcast. No international streaming service has been officially announced yet, so any global platform listing remains pending. Is there an official trailer? No anime PV or trailer specific to the TV series was announced with this update. The official material currently centers on the teaser visual; this page will be updated when an official promotional video becomes available. What the new visual confirms—and what it does not The October 7 update gives the adaptation a useful milestone: the television anime is scheduled for April 2027, with Nippon TV named for the Japanese broadcast. The teaser visual and the creator’s commemorative illustration confirm that the project has moved beyond the original adaptation announcement into active promotion. They are not a full trailer, and the materials reviewed for this guide do not identify a specific April day, broadcast time, voice cast, animation studio or overseas platform. Related reading: Takopi's Original Sin: Thank You, See You Tomorrow Release Date . Keeping those details separate helps readers avoid a common scheduling mistake. “April 2027” is a confirmed month, not a premiere date that can be converted into a day on a calendar. A Japanese network listing also does not tell international viewers where or when the series will stream. AniNextUp will add those details only after the anime’s official channels or a distributor announce them. The manga setup behind the title The Japanese title is Hōkago Kitaku Biyori , and the story starts with a simple after-school choice: whether to go straight home or spend time with someone who wants company. The manga follows a high-school girl known for her “straight-home” habit and a classmate drawn into her routine. That small-scale premise gives the series a different kind of romantic-comedy engine from a competition story or a high-stakes school mystery. The hook is the daily negotiation of time, companionship and personal boundaries. The anime’s April window is therefore useful for readers deciding whether to follow an adaptation of the manga, but the official announcement does not yet tell us how many chapters or volumes the television season will cover. It is too early to promise a particular arc, ending point or episode count. For now, the reliable checklist is short: April 2027 in Japan, Nippon TV, a teaser visual, and further cast, staff and streaming information still pending. entries.content: NOVEMBER 20 · UFOTABLE Witch on the Holy Night Movie: Release Date and Theaters Witch on the Holy Night opens in Japanese theaters November 20, 2026. The ufotable film receives an international theatrical release beginning January 2027. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official final-trailer visual. Source: ufotable . RELEASE November 20, 2026 FORMAT Japanese Theaters STUDIO ufotable A starting point for viewers new to TYPE-MOON Witch on the Holy Night centers on Aoko Aozaki's apprenticeship, her life with Alice Kuonji and the arrival of Soujuurou Shizuki. Those relationships are the clearest introduction to this particular adaptation. Its connection to TYPE-MOON's broader catalog does not make the movie a numbered continuation of a different anime series. Why theatrical and streaming dates must stay separate The November 20 Japanese opening and the announced January 2027 international cinema dates describe a staggered theatrical rollout. They do not establish an online release. Readers should distinguish a confirmed screening in their market from a future streaming announcement that has not yet been made. When does Witch on the Holy Night release? Witch on the Holy Night opens in Japanese theaters on November 20, 2026. The film adapts TYPE-MOON's visual novel and brings another major TYPE-MOON project to animation studio ufotable. Related reading: Aikatsu Stars! Movie: January 22, 2027 Release Date & Trailer . What is Witch on the Holy Night about? Aoko Aozaki appears to be an ordinary high school student, but she is actually an apprentice Magician. She lives with Alice Kuonji while training to become a full-fledged Magician, and the arrival of Soujuurou Shizuki changes the balance of their lives. The official introduction frames the movie as the beginning of Aoko's story. Who is making the movie? The original work is credited to Kinoko Nasu and TYPE-MOON, with ufotable handling animation production and screenplay production. Masaru Takeuchi directs, Moe Tsuzuki serves as character designer, and Hikaru Kondo is chief director. Hideyuki Fukasawa composes the music. Related reading: The Apothecary Diaries Movie: Luoqing and Yinshan Character PV . How to plan a theatrical viewing The Japanese opening on November 20, 2026 and the announced January 2027 dates for certain international markets are cinema dates, not streaming dates. A viewer outside Japan should check the local theater distributor and showtimes rather than assume the Japanese premiere is available online. Likewise, the international rollout does not establish that every country receives the film on the same day. The confirmed information supports planning for theatrical screenings, while home viewing remains unannounced. Theme song The final trailer confirmed supercell for the theme song “Yoru to Ao.” The main cast includes Haruka Tomatsu as Aoko Aozaki, Kana Hanazawa as Alice Kuonji and Yusuke Kobayashi as Soujuurou Shizuki. Related reading: Fool Night Release Date: November 26 on Netflix . Where to watch The November 20 date is the Japanese theatrical release. The international theatrical rollout follows in January 2027, including January 28 in confirmed Latin American markets and January 29 in the United States and Canada, while a streaming date has not been confirmed. AniNextUp will keep theatrical and streaming availability separate so an international cinema announcement is not mistaken for an online release. entries.content: OCTOBER 7, 2026 · RELEASE GUIDE The World's Strongest Witch Release Date, Time & Where to Watch The World's Strongest Witch began its October 7, 2026 release. By AniNextUp Editorial Team · How we verify releases Official promotional artwork from Crunchyroll's official trailer . Artwork belongs to the credited production rights holders. RELEASE October 7, 2026 JAPAN Wednesdays · 22:00 JST STUDIO Bridge / AISLE Release at a glance Release October 7, 2026 Where to watch Crunchyroll in licensed territories; ABEMA and d Anime Store in Japan Region and timing TOKYO MX, ABEMA and d Anime Store: Wednesdays at 22:00 JST. Release details checked October 24, 2026 · The World’s Strongest Witch official broadcast schedule · Crunchyroll’s Fall 2026 anime lineup When did The World's Strongest Witch begin? The Japanese premiere was October 7, 2026. YTE's official programme listing gives TOKYO MX's regular slot as Wednesdays at 22:00 JST. The series has therefore already reached its launch window; October 7 is the opening date, rather than a new date for every episode. For Japanese streaming, YTE lists ABEMA and d Anime Store from the same evening at 22:00 JST. These are domestic distribution options. They should not be confused with an international service's upload schedule or taken as evidence that a Japanese subscription works in another country. How do the late-night Japanese broadcast times work? The listings use television-day notation: Wednesday 24:00 on BS11 means midnight at the start of Thursday, while Wednesday 26:05 on TV Aichi means Thursday at 02:05. Similarly, MBS's Saturday 26:38 slot falls early Sunday by the calendar. This explains why two programme guides can show different weekdays for the same listed broadcast. Keep the station name attached to the time when setting a reminder. A later broadcast on another channel is not necessarily a delayed international episode, and the AT-X repeat slots are reruns rather than additional new episodes. Japan uses JST, UTC+09:00; your own calendar date can differ when converting an overnight slot. Related reading: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion! Release Date & Where to Watch . Japan does not change clocks for daylight saving time. If your country does, the local equivalent of a fixed JST broadcast can shift during the season. Recheck your calendar conversion after a clock change rather than assuming a premiere-week reminder stays correct. Where can international viewers watch? Crunchyroll's official trailer announcement identifies October 7 as its launch date. The platform's Fall 2026 lineup is the linked reference for international scheduling. Availability still depends on the local catalogue; the Japanese television timetable cannot establish access in every territory. Before joining a watch party, check the episode listing in your region and the available audio track. A subtitled release, a dubbed version and a Japanese broadcast are different releases. This guide does not assign a dub date or promise a language option that the cited announcements do not establish. Related reading: Armored Trooper VOTOMS: The Gray Witch Part 1 . What is Lorna's Internet skill? Lorna Hermit is expelled after receiving a skill others consider worthless. Its actual function gives her access to a strategy site for her own fantasy world. The important distinction is that she can look up useful knowledge: the premise is not simply that she has a stronger attack than everyone else. That creates an accessible hook for viewers familiar with game guides. Information can expose a shortcut that brute force misses. Our reading of the setup is that Lorna's freedom and ingenuity matter alongside her power; it is an interpretation of the premise, not a claim about scenes we have reviewed or the outcome of later adventures. Is the source a novel or a manga? The original is a light novel by Mochimaru Sakaki, illustrated by riritto, published under Square Enix's SQEX Novel label. A manga adaptation also exists. The publisher's series page separates the novel volumes from its manga news, which helps readers avoid mixing their numbering. Related reading: Witch on the Holy Night Movie: Release Date and Theaters . Square Enix marks novel volume six as the final volume, released October 7, 2026. That book date coincides with the anime's launch, but the two events do not establish how much material the television adaptation covers. A completed novel series does not automatically mean a complete anime adaptation. If you want to read ahead, choose a format first and start with its first volume. Moving from an anime episode straight to a similarly numbered book or manga chapter risks skipping material. The sources cited here do not supply an episode-to-chapter conversion, so this guide does not invent one. Who voices Lorna, and who makes the anime? The production information reproduced by HoneyWorks credits Azusa Tachibana as Lorna, Fairouz Ai as Erimina, Honoka Inoue as Elna, Kana Hanazawa as Aries, Maria Naganawa as Lulu and Yuto Uemura as Reinhart. These are Japanese voice credits, not an English dub cast. Related reading: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Cour 2 Release Date & Time . Joji Furuta directs, Shoji Yonemura handles series composition and Yuki Morimoto designs the characters. Bridge and AISLE produce the animation. The opening theme is HoneyWorks feat. HaKoniwalily's “Eikyoryoku ∞ Idol,” with an October 7 digital release. A theme-song release is useful for listeners searching for the opening, but it does not establish an album or complete soundtrack schedule. Watch the official trailer The Crunchyroll upload dates to September 15, 2026, at 08:59:51 PDT (UTC−07:00) , equivalent to 15:59:51 UTC. This is the promotional video's upload time, not an episode broadcast time. The poster below opens the original official video. ▶ WATCH OFFICIAL TRAILER ON YOUTUBE Crunchyroll official channel Watch the official trailer directly on YouTube . What should you check before the next episode? Use the local episode page for availability, the named broadcaster for Japanese schedule changes and the publisher for book information. Keep those sources separate when searching for a release date: a book, song and television episode can share a date without sharing a release mechanism. Our weekly schedule and anime calendar provide broader planning links.
